summary_cn: 医疗部门公布2570年健康保障卡（「黄金卡」）预算289亿泰铢，继续推进家庭医生试点计划覆盖1000万人，并联手卫生部解决医院资金流动性问题，推动医疗体系改革。

summary_cn: 今日油价信息更新，10月15日最新版本。涵盖汽油、酒精混合汽油和柴油等多种油品，对接泰国主要油站品牌包括PTT、Bangchak、PT、Caltex、Susco和Shell的最新零售价。该信息直接关系到日常用车出行成本，是消费者和运输企业的重要参考。

title: Grab turns AI into an earnings instrument
desc: Grab and OpenAI are expanding their partnership to provide free access to ChatGPT Plus and artificial intelligence (AI) training to drivers and small merchants, targeting more than 3,000 participants in Thailand and 30,000 across Southeast Asia to help them increase earnings and develop new businesses.
title_cn: Grab联手OpenAI 将人工智能转化为收入增长工具
summary_cn: 打车巨头Grab与OpenAI扩大合作，面向泰国和东南亚地区的司机与小商户提供免费ChatGPT Plus订阅和人工智能专业培训。该项目涉及泰国3000多名参与者，东南亚范围达3万人，旨在帮助提升其收入水平和商业竞争力。
desc_original: Grab and OpenAI are expanding their partnership to provide free access to ChatGPT Plus and artificial intelligence (AI) training to drivers and small merchants, targeting more than 3,000 participants in Thailand and 30,000 across Southeast Asia to help them increase earnings and develop new businesses.

title: Thailand Post weathers economic turmoil
desc: Thailand Post posted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation (Ebitda) of over 100 million baht during the first six months of this year, despite severe macroeconomic and operational headwinds.
title_cn: 泰国邮政逆势增长 上半年利润超1亿泰铢
summary_cn: 尽管面临宏观经济压力和运营困难，泰国邮政公司上半年仍保持稳健表现，税息折折旧摊销前利润（EBITDA）超过1亿泰铢。这一业绩反映出该企业在经济困难时期的运营韧性和成本控制能力。国家邮政服务的持续盈利对物流体系稳定至关重要。
desc_original: Thailand Post posted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation (Ebitda) of over 100 million baht during the first six months of this year, despite severe macroeconomic and operational headwinds.

title: Federation puts flood losses at B6-7bn
desc: More than 2,000 businesses under the Federation of Thai Industries (FTI) suffered losses from severe flooding late last month, with total damage estimated at 6-7 billion baht, according to representatives.
title_cn: 泰国工业联合会估洪灾造成60-70亿泰铢损失
summary_cn: 泰国工业联合会（FTI）公布洪灾经济损失评估报告。联合会旗下超2000家企业在上月严重洪灾中遭受重大损失，总金额估计在60-70亿泰铢之间。此次自然灾害对泰国制造业、出口贸易和中小企业造成严重冲击，凸显防灾减灾的紧迫性。
desc_original: More than 2,000 businesses under the Federation of Thai Industries (FTI) suffered losses from severe flooding late last month, with total damage estimated at 6-7 billion baht, according to representatives.

title: Warning over massive losses from exit tax
desc: Thai tourism could lose between 50-150 billion baht in revenue a year thanks to the proposed departure tax, compared with the 45.9 billion baht it is expected to raise, with airlines opposing the levy due to its poor timing and the likelihood of it undermining the travel sector's competitiveness.
title_cn: 出境税风险评估 泰国旅游业面临巨额损失警告
summary_cn: 针对政府拟议的出境离境税，业界发出严厉警告。据估算，新税收政策可能导致泰国旅游业年收入下滑50-150亿泰铢，远高于预期的45.9亿泰铢税收收入。各大航空公司因实施时机不当和可能削弱国际竞争力而强烈反对该举措。
desc_original: Thai tourism could lose between 50-150 billion baht in revenue a year thanks to the proposed departure tax, compared with the 45.9 billion baht it is expected to raise, with airlines opposing the levy due to its poor timing and the likelihood of it undermining the travel sector's competitiveness.

title: IMF urges Thailand to build up resilience
desc: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has urged Thailand to strengthen its economic fundamentals and deepen regional trade integration as persistently high global borrowing costs threaten to constrain growth and limit policy flexibility.
title_cn: 国际货币基金组织敦促泰国增强经济韧性
summary_cn: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）敦促泰国加强经济基本面，深化地区贸易一体化，应对全球高融资成本威胁。IMF指出当前国际借贷成本高企正制约泰国经济增长，削弱政策灵活性。该组织建议泰国通过深化区域贸易整合、优化经济结构、增强金融韧性等措施，提升抵御外部冲击能力，为长期稳定增长奠定基础。
desc_original: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has urged Thailand to strengthen its economic fundamentals and deepen regional trade integration as persistently high global borrowing costs threaten to constrain growth and limit policy flexibility.

title: มหาดไทยเปิดตัว "นารีรัตน์หัตถศิลป์" สมุดภาพประวัติศาสตร์เฉลิมพระเกียรติ 40 พรรษา
desc: เพื่อเผยแพร่พระวิสัยทัศน์และพระกรณียกิจในการสืบสาน รักษา และต่อยอดภูมิปัญญาผ้าไทยและงานหัตถกรรม ให้สามารถก้าวไปพร้อมกับการออกแบบร่วมสมัยและการพัฒนาอย่างยั่งยืน
title_cn: 内政部推出皇家手工艺纪念画册庆祝40周年
summary_cn: 泰国内政部推出以皇家手工艺为主题的纪念画册，纪念文化传承40周年。该项目旨在弘扬泰国手工艺和传统编织技艺，深化对本民族文化遗产的保护和传承。同时融合当代设计理念，推动传统工艺实现可持续发展，让手工艺技能在现代产业背景下焕发新生，为文化发展与经济创新相结合提供示范。
desc_original: เพื่อเผยแพร่พระวิสัยทัศน์และพระกรณียกิจในการสืบสาน รักษา และต่อยอดภูมิปัญญาผ้าไทยและงานหัตถกรรม ให้สามารถก้าวไปพร้อมกับการออกแบบร่วมสมัยและการพัฒนาอย่างยั่งยืน

title: Stranded Muslim pilgrims to get emergency assistance
desc: The government has arranged emergency assistance for more than 200 Muslim pilgrims stranded at Suvarnabhumi airport after attacks on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh disrupted flights to Saudi Arabia.
title_cn: 被困穆斯林朝圣者获得泰国政府紧急救助
summary_cn: 由于沙特阿拉伯利雅得（Riyadh）国王哈立德国际机场遭受袭击，前往沙特的航班被迫取消。200多名滞留在曼谷素万那普机场（Suvarnabhumi）的穆斯林朝圣者面临困境。泰国政府启动应急预案，为被困朝圣者提供紧急人道主义援助、食宿等必要支持，确保其安全和基本需求得到满足。
desc_original: The government has arranged emergency assistance for more than 200 Muslim pilgrims stranded at Suvarnabhumi airport after attacks on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh disrupted flights to Saudi Arabia.

title: Key bridge projects due to start in Songkhla, Krabi
desc: The Transport Ministry is pushing ahead with two major bridge projects worth 6.38 billion baht in Songkhla and Krabi, with construction scheduled to begin on Nov 14 and completion expected in 2029.
title_cn: 宋卡府和甲米府重点桥梁项目即将启动
summary_cn: 泰国交通部推进宋卡府（Songkhla）和甲米府（Krabi）两项重大桥梁建设工程，总投资额达63.8亿泰铢。项目预计11月14日正式开工，2029年全部竣工。两条关键过境通道建成后将改善南部地方基础设施，加强地区间运输联系，促进区域经济一体化发展，带动当地旅游和产业升级。
desc_original: The Transport Ministry is pushing ahead with two major bridge projects worth 6.38 billion baht in Songkhla and Krabi, with construction scheduled to begin on Nov 14 and completion expected in 2029.

title: Govt makes first B2m disaster insurance payout
desc: The government has made its first 2-million-baht compensation payment under the national disaster insurance scheme to the family of a woman who died in a flash flood in Chiang Mai on Oct 5.
title_cn: 政府首次发放国家灾难保险赔款200万泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国政府首次启动国家灾难保险赔偿机制，向一位在清迈（Chiang Mai）特大洪灾中遇难的女性家属支付200万泰铢赔款。该事件发生于10月5日，标志着政府灾难救助体系的制度化进展。该保险计划旨在为自然灾害受害者家庭提供经济保障，体现政府对灾难防救和民众福祉的重视。
desc_original: The government has made its first 2-million-baht compensation payment under the national disaster insurance scheme to the family of a woman who died in a flash flood in Chiang Mai on Oct 5.

title: Power plant contracts set for extension amid supply crunch
desc: Energy authorities are close to finalising a policy shift that extends the contracts of retiring gas-fired power plants rather than relying solely on constructing new power facilities, addressing equipment scarcity caused by the skyrocketing artificial intelligence (AI) segment.
title_cn: 燃气电厂合同拟延期 以应对芯片供应短缺
summary_cn: 泰国能源部门正筹划政策调整，拟延长现有燃气电厂合约而非仅依赖新建电站，以应对人工智能产业激增导致的设备严重短缺问题。该政策转变将降低新建电站依赖，缓解全球芯片供应紧张对泰国电力部门的冲击，为长期能源稳定奠定基础。
desc_original: Energy authorities are close to finalising a policy shift that extends the contracts of retiring gas-fired power plants rather than relying solely on constructing new power facilities, addressing equipment scarcity caused by the skyrocketing artificial intelligence (AI) segment.

title: Suriya defends B8bn EV harvester scheme
desc: Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Suriya Juangroongruangkit has defended a proposed 8-billion-baht electric harvester scheme, citing long-term savings for farmers and environmental benefits.
title_cn: 农业部长为80亿泰铢电动收割机计划辩护
summary_cn: 农业部长颂里亚为一项80亿泰铢的电动收割机补助计划辩护，强调该计划为农民提供长期成本节约和显著环保效益。方案旨在替代传统柴油收割机，促进泰国农业向绿色、可持续方向转型，预期将显著降低农民运营成本。
desc_original: Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Suriya Juangroongruangkit has defended a proposed 8-billion-baht electric harvester scheme, citing long-term savings for farmers and environmental benefits.

title: Thaksin's lawyer issued warning in amnesty bid
desc: Thaksin Shinawatra's lawyer has urged the amnesty committee to consider the political origins of the former prime minister's cases, warning that excluding him could prolong Thailand's political divisions.
title_cn: 他信律师就特赦案件发出警告
summary_cn: 前总理他信·西那瓦的律师向特赦委员会敦促考虑其案件的政治背景，警告排除他信可能延长泰国的政治分裂局面。该请求涉及泰国长期的政治矛盾，特赦委员会的决定将对泰国政治和解前景产生重大影响。
desc_original: Thaksin Shinawatra's lawyer has urged the amnesty committee to consider the political origins of the former prime minister's cases, warning that excluding him could prolong Thailand's political divisions.

title: No-confidence debate by month's end
desc: A no-confidence debate targeting Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and 17 ministers is tentatively scheduled for Oct 27-29, with a vote expected the following day, according to a Government House source. The actual dates remain subject to discussions between the government and opposition whips and representatives of the cabinet.
title_cn: 不信任案辩论定于月底前进行
summary_cn: 针对总理阿努廷及17位部长的不信任案预计于10月27-29日进行辩论，投票定在随后一天。虽然日期仍需政府与反对派领导人协商确认，但该不信任案反映了泰国政治局势的重大波动，可能成为影响现届政府稳定性的关键事件。
desc_original: A no-confidence debate targeting Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and 17 ministers is tentatively scheduled for Oct 27-29, with a vote expected the following day, according to a Government House source. The actual dates remain subject to discussions between the government and opposition whips and representatives of the cabinet.

title: Russian man dies after big bike crash in Pattaya

title: Thailand weather today, 15 October: heavy rain in 19 provinces, Bangkok showers
desc: Thailand weather today, 15 October: heavy rain in 19 provinces, Bangkok showers Legacy Heavy rain is forecast in 19 provinces today. The Central region, East and South bear the brunt of the downpours. Bangkok can expect scattered thundershowers, with highs reaching 35°C. The Thai Meteorological Department warns that accumulated rain may trigger flash floods. Overflows and landslides are possible near waterways and foothills. A high-pressure system from China covers the upper North, upper Northeast and the South China Sea. Easterly and southeasterly winds draw moisture from the South China Sea toward Thailand and the Gulf. This produces thundershowers with gusts across the North, Central, East and South. Bangkok The capital sees scattered thundershowers through the forecast period. Lows of 25-27°C and highs of 33-35°C are expected. Southeasterly winds of 10 to 20km/h are forecast. North Scattered thundershowers with gusts bring isolated heavy rain to Tak and Kamphaeng Phet. Phetchabun also faces the downpours. Lows of 21-25°C and highs of 33-36°C are forecast, with easterly winds of 10 to 20km/h. Northeast Isolated thundershowers with gusts affect Loei, Chaiyaphum and Nakhon Ratchas

title: Lampang teen beaten over gaming debt, threatened into silence
desc: Lampang teen beaten over gaming debt, threatened into silence Legacy A 17 year old boy in Lampang filed a complaint yesterday, October 13, after a video surfaced showing three teenage boys repeatedly punching, kicking and stomping on him over a debt linked to an online gaming account . The boy, identified by the pseudonym B, went to Mae Mo Police Station with his 33 year old mother, Ae, at about 8pm. The attack had happened more than two weeks earlier, but B said he stayed silent because he was threatened with another beating if he went to the police. The video shows B lying on the ground beside a road as three boys, aged between 15 and 17, attack him. One repeatedly stomps on his face and punches and kicks him in the head and face, while the other two also join in. B can be heard repeatedly apologising as the beating continues. The person filming appears to try several times to stop the group before the three eventually walk away. Another video that surfaced recently shows one member of the group assaulting a student in an incident from about two years ago, with the victim pleading for the attack to stop. summary_cn: 南邦（Lampang）17 岁少年因网络游戏账户债务遭三名少年（年龄 15-17 岁）暴打。受害者被反复拳踢和踩踏，整个过程被录成视频。虽事发于两周前，但受害者因遭威胁再打而一直隐瞒，直至视频近日曝光才于 10 月 13 日向警方报案。涉案暴徒曾有两年前类似暴力案例记录。
desc_original: Lampang teen beaten over gaming debt, threatened into silence Legacy A 17 year old boy in Lampang filed a complaint yesterday, October 13, after a video surfaced showing three teenage boys repeatedly punching, kicking and stomping on him over a debt linked to an online gaming account . The boy, identified by the pseudonym B, went to Mae Mo Police Station with his 33 year old mother, Ae, at about 8pm. The attack had happened more than two weeks earlier, but B said he stayed silent because he was threatened with another beating if he went to the police. The video shows B lying on the ground beside a road as three boys, aged between 15 and 17, attack him. One repeatedly stomps on his face and punches and kicks him in the head and face, while the other two also join in. B can be heard repeatedly apologising as the beating continues. The person filming appears to try several times to stop the group before the three eventually walk away. Another video that surfaced recently shows one member of the group assaulting a student in an incident from about two years ago, with the victim pleading for the attack to stop. title: 泰国未来经济怎么走？阿努廷提出九大发展方向
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 10月14日上午9时30分，泰国总理兼内政部长阿努廷在曼谷暹罗百丽宫购物中心5楼Nex Hall出席“FUTURE-READY ECONOMY 2026”活动，并发表题为“面向未来的泰国”的特别演讲，阐述泰国如何将现有基础和优势转化为新的经济增长引擎，吸引高质量投资，推动国家改革。 阿努廷表示，曼谷时隔35年再次主办国际货币基金组织（IMF）与世界银行集团年度会议，为泰国迎接国际社会、回顾经济发展历程，以及在全球格局不断变化背景下制定未来发展方向提供了重要契机。 他指出，泰国拥有坚实的经济基础，包括工业体系、基础设施、具有发展潜力的企业，以及在东盟地区的战略区位优势。但泰国经济仍有较大增长空间，尤其需要提高生产力，推动企业和劳动力适应技术变革。因此，泰国的发展目标不应仅限于加快经济增长，更应注重提升增长质量、创造更高经济附加值，并实现长期可持续发展。 阿努廷说：“泰国应增强自主塑造未来的能力，而不是一味跟随变化调整自身。这才是真正的‘面向未来’，即让泰国做好准备，迈向未来。” 为此，阿努廷提出九大发展方向，旨在将泰国现有基础和优势转化为新的经济增长动力。 一是推动食品产业升级，迈向未来食品生产中心。泰国以“世界厨房”闻名，下一步将致力于成为全球领先的未来食品生产国，涵盖健康食品、功能性食品以及高附加值农产品。泰国将通过引入技术提高生产效率，帮助农民和企业对接新市场，让产业附加值提升切实转化为农民和经营者收入的增长。 二是推动工业升级，迈向全球价值链高端。随着人工智能（AI）、先进制造技术及未来交通运输系统不断重塑全球工业格局，泰国需要支持本土企业提升竞争力，进入更高附加值市场。同时，泰国将吸引能够带来资本、促进技术转移、推动创新和人才技能提升的投资，为本土制造商及企业参与全球供应链创造更多机会。 三是发挥数字基础设施优势，带动整体经济发展。泰国将进一步推动数字基础设施建设，尤其是数据中心投资，以加快经济数字化转型，提高企业运营效率，并为泰国各经济领域创造新的发展机遇。 四是提升优势服务业附加值。泰国将在医疗与健康服务、旅游业及创意经济等领域进一步挖掘增长潜力，发挥医疗专业能力、服务水平、文化及自然资源等优势。阿努廷指出，各行业应从单纯追求商品和服务生产规模，转向更加注重附加值提升。 五是增强经济韧性，应对全球不确定性。泰国将继续开放国际贸易与投资，同时推动市场、贸易伙伴、技术来源及供应链多元化，并加强粮食、能源、水资源、数字领域及金融安全，提升经济应对外部风险的能力。 六是优化资源配置，着眼长期发展。政府预算及引入的投资应有助于提升国家生产能力，重点投入人才培养、基础设施、技术及创新领域，同时维持财政纪律。此外，政府还将为中小企业、各类经营者及地方社区创造更多参与机会，确保经济转型成果更广泛惠及社会各界。 七是推进“Reinvent Tha

summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷（Anutin）在曼谷暹罗百丽宫「FUTURE-READY ECONOMY 2026」活动上阐述国家经济发展战略。针对泰国现有工业体系、基础设施和战略位置优势，提出九大发展方向，包括食品产业升级、工业进入全球价值链高端、数字基础设施建设、服务业提质增效、经济韧性强化、资源优化配置等。强调泰国应自主塑造未来而非被动适应，通过高质量投资和改革实现可持续发展。

title: Police fire shots during Pattaya drug chase after pickup hits office
desc: Police fire shots during Pattaya drug chase after pickup hits office Legacy A drug chase in Pattaya ended with the arrest of a suspected dealer after he reversed his pickup truck into a petrol station office and fled for approximately six kilometres while police fired at his vehicle. The incident occurred late yesterday, October 13, during an undercover drug operation in Pattaya , Chon Buri. Police reportedly recovered 20 grammes of crystal methamphetamine, commonly known as ice, following the pursuit. Chon Buri Provincial Police’s anti-narcotics unit had received information that a man was allegedly supplying drugs to young people in the area and arranged an undercover purchase at a petrol station. According to Daily News, officers moved in when the suspect arrived in a white Isuzu D-Max pickup truck and stopped to refuel. However, the driver spotted the officers and made an escape, reversing and crashing into the station’s office in the process, which damaged its glass frontage. title: Artwork telling a story of time and memory wins 2026 UOB Painting of the Year (Thailand)
desc: Artwork telling a story of time and memory wins 2026 UOB Painting of the Year (Thailand) Legacy UOB Thailand has announced Weerapong Sansomporn as the winner of the 2026 UOB Painting of the Year (Thailand) for his work Memories From the Forest , a piece crafted from woven copper wire on black velvet fabric. Drawing inspiration from tree rings, cracks, gaps and weathered surfaces, the artwork reflects the traces of growth, loss and time embedded in nature. Through the intricate weaving of copper wire on velvet, a typically rigid industrial material is transformed into a delicate and organic surface. The repetitive handwoven process serves as a metaphor for the passage of time and the cycles of emergence, existence and disappearance. Richard Maloney, president and chief executive of UOB Thailand, said, “We extend our heartfelt congratulations to Mr Weerapong on winning the 2026 UOB Painting of the Year Award (Thailand). summary_cn: 泰国艺术家韦拉蓬·赛松蓬凭借作品《Memories From the Forest》获得2026年UOB泰国年度绘画奖。作品以铜丝手工编织于黑色天鹅绒上，灵感源于树轮、裂纹和风化表面，隐喻时间流逝与生命周期。整个手工编织过程象征自然的生长、衰落与消失，将工业材料转化为精致有机表面，深刻反映时间与变迁的主题。

title: SRT to spend 99 million baht raising platforms for Japanese trains
desc: SRT to spend 99 million baht raising platforms for Japanese trains Legacy The State Railway of Thailand (SRT) is preparing a 99.8-million-baht upgrade of station platforms between Bangkok and Chachoengsao as it expands the use of refurbished Japanese KIHA trains on suburban routes. SRT plans to begin the bidding process in November for temporary platform upgrades along the Bangkok to Chachoengsao Junction route. The platforms currently stand about 50 centimetres high, while the KIHA 40 and KIHA 48 trains require a platform height of around 1.10 metres. Raising the platforms would reduce the height difference and make boarding easier and safer. DailyNews reported that the project has a budget of 99,788,000 baht. Temporary raised sections would be built using prefabricated steel structures or concrete blocks, allowing the work to be completed without major changes to the existing station structures. Photo via DailyNews The upgrades are part of SRT’s plan to expand services using KIHA 40 and KIHA 48 diesel trains donated by East Japan Railway Company , or JR East. title: 泰星闪耀国际时装周！社媒传播价值近百亿，LingOrm领跑
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，近日，泰国明星在国际时尚舞台上的影响力持续攀升。2027春夏时装月期间，泰国演员Orm Kornnaphat与Lingling Kwong（邝玲玲）凭借在巴黎时装周上的亮眼表现，成为本季明星营销的焦点。根据网红营销分析平台Lefty发布的数据，巴黎、米兰、纽约和伦敦四大时装周的媒体传播价值（EMV）合计12.4亿美元，约合396.8亿泰铢，同比增长64%。其中，8位泰国演员在巴黎和米兰时装周创造的EMV合计达3.107亿美元，约合99.424亿泰铢，展现出泰国明星在全球时尚营销领域的强大影响力。 据《Vogue》报道，2027春夏时装月的整体EMV从2026秋冬时装月的7.55亿美元增长至12.4亿美元，增幅达64%。这一变化也反映出国际时尚品牌的营销策略正在调整。品牌不再单纯依赖短暂的网络热度，而是更加重视品牌大使、明星与粉丝之间的持续互动，通过长期合作及多元化内容传播，扩大品牌影响力 据悉，2027春夏巴黎时装周于9月28日至10月6日举行。数据显示，4位泰国演员在本届巴黎时装周创造的EMV合计达到2.39亿美元，约合76.48亿泰铢。 其中，Orm Kornnaphat以1.12亿美元、约合35.84亿泰铢的EMV排名第一；Lingling Kwong以8900万美元、约合28.48亿泰铢排名第二；Namping Napatsakorn以2400万美元、约合7.68亿泰铢排名第三；Keng Harit则以1400万美元、约合4.48亿泰铢排名第四。 Lefty数据显示，本届巴黎时装周整体EMV达到7.956亿美元，约合254.592亿泰铢，同比增长59%。其中，Dior以3.6亿美元、约合115.2亿泰铢的EMV位居品牌榜首，同比增长297%。 Dior的亮眼表现，与Orm和Lingling的持续内容传播密切相关。作为品牌大使，两人并非仅出席时装秀，而是通过一系列与品牌相关的社交媒体内容，持续扩大Dior的曝光度。两人累计发布36条相关内容，涵盖出行造型、活动现场照片、与嘉宾及工作人员的合影，以及幕后花絮等。 报告指出，Orm与Lingling合计为Dior创造超过2亿美元、约合64亿泰铢的EMV，占品牌在本届巴黎时装周期间获得的媒体传播价值约三分之二。 具体来看，Orm为Dior创造1.12亿美元EMV，平均互动率为11.5%；Lingling则创造8900万美元EMV，平均互动率达到10.6%。两人的表现显示，明星的营销价值不仅取决于粉丝数量，还与内容发布的持续性、品牌形象契合度及粉丝互动表现密切相关。 此外，Orm母亲发布的时装周幕后相关内容，也为Dior额外创造890万美元、约合2.85亿泰铢的EMV。这类内容将品牌传播从明星个人账号延伸至其亲友网络，通过更生活化的视角触达粉丝，进一步扩大品牌的传播范围。 20
title_cn: 泰国明星国际时装周创造99亿泰铢社交传播价值 Orm与Lingling领跑

title: 泰国精英签证牵出5亿诈骗大案：39人被捕，8人为中国籍
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，10月13日，泰国国家警察总署反网络诈骗中心公布一起重大跨国网络诈骗及洗钱案件的侦破成果。泰国中央调查局经过长达5个多月的深入调查，在全国11个府的27处目标地点同步展开搜查及抓捕行动，成功逮捕39名嫌疑人，其中包括30名泰国籍、8名中国籍及1名缅甸籍人员，并查扣总价值超过5亿泰铢的房产、豪车、现金、数字资产及奢侈品等财物。 警方调查发现，该犯罪网络不仅涉及虚假股票投资诈骗，还通过企业银行账户、地下换汇渠道、加密货币及房地产交易进行多层洗钱，部分资金与柬埔寨波贝地区的诈骗集团存在关联。值得关注的是，涉案犯罪网络中有9名外国籍相关人员持有泰国精英签证，引发警方对跨国犯罪集团利用长期居留便利开展非法活动的关注。 据泰国警方通报，此次行动由国家警察总署副署长兼反网络诈骗中心负责人伊提蓬警上将及国家警察总署署长助理兼中心副主任吉拉蓬警中将统筹指挥，中央调查局及其下属犯罪打击局负责具体侦办。警方在曼谷、清迈、清莱、北榄、北标、信武里、佛统、春武里、加拉信、陶公及拉廊等11个府展开联合行动，搜查范围涉及27处地点。 案件最初源于泰国反网络诈骗中心对持有精英长期居留签证的外国人开展的一项专项风险排查。警方将相关签证持有者名单与泰国在线报案系统中的诈骗案件数据进行交叉比对，试图识别利用长期居留资格在泰国从事诈骗或洗钱活动的跨国犯罪人员。排查过程中，警方发现一名持有该签证的中国籍人士，其银行账户曾接收来自涉嫌诈骗团伙相关账户的资金，而这些账户此前已收到受害者转入的款项。警方随即指派犯罪打击局第五调查单位深入追查，逐步揭开一个涉及虚假股票投资、企业账户转账、数字货币洗钱及高价值房地产交易的跨国犯罪网络。 调查显示，该案涉及的两名受害者最初通过脸书平台公开发布的股票投资广告接触诈骗团伙。广告以高额回报为诱饵，宣传所谓的股票大宗交易投资机会。受害者点击广告链接后，被引导添加一名LINE昵称为“Admin Kan”的女性账号，对方自称专业投资顾问，通过持续交流获取受害者信任，并诱导其在“eto-th.com”网站注册投资账户，同时下载名为“ETO TH”的投资应用程序。该平台能够显示股票交易分析、账户余额及投资收益等信息，使受害者误以为自己正在通过正规系统进行股票交易。为进一步增强可信度，诈骗团伙还安排受害者通过Zoom参加线上股票投资课程，由一名自称“Toy老师”的男性投资专家讲授交易技巧，但对方始终没有开启摄像头，仅通过语音进行讲解。此外，团伙还安排其他人员假扮共同投资的伙伴，通过LINE与受害者交流所谓的投资经验，制造多人参与、持续获利的假象。在多重诱导下，两名受害者逐渐相信该投资项目，并按照诈骗团伙的指示，先后向13个不同的企业银行账户转入资金，用于购买所谓的股票投资产品。 经过一段时间的“交易”后，平台显示受害者已经获得可观收益，账户中也出现了
title_cn: 泰国精英签证诈骗案破获：39人被捕 其中8人为中国籍 5亿泰铢资产被查扣
summary_cn: 泰国中央调查局历时5个多月调查，在全国11府27处地点同步行动，逮捕39名嫌疑人，其中中国籍8人。该跨国犯罪网络通过虚假股票投资诈骗、企业账户转账、加密货币及房地产交易进行洗钱，涉案资产超5亿泰铢。令人警惕的是，9名外国籍涉案人员持有泰国精英长期居留签证，揭示跨国犯罪分子如何利用长期签证便利从事非法活动。

title: 入境收450、出境收1000？泰财政部回应：考虑二选一征税
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，备受关注的泰国出境旅行税政策再传新消息。近日，泰国财政部就《出境旅行税法案》草案作出进一步说明，明确表示虽然草案规定每次出境最高可征收5000泰铢，但这一数字仅为法律设定的征税上限，实际征收标准初步认为以每人每次1000泰铢较为合理。与此同时，财政部还提出，未来可考虑将出境旅行税直接计入机票价格，并研究将外国旅客纳入征税范围，以简化收费程序。 据悉，泰国财政部税务厅目前正在就《出境旅行税法案》草案公开征求社会意见，征询时间为9月30日至10月29日。草案提出，对从泰国出境的旅客按次征收出境旅行税，具体税率由后续配套法规确定，每次最高不得超过5000泰铢。该政策旨在提高财政资源使用效率，维护财政纪律，并增强政府应对突发事件的财政灵活性。 针对外界关注的征税目的及具体收费标准，泰国财政部次长拉瓦隆近日作出解释。他表示，推动征收出境旅行税的主要考虑，是向具有一定经济能力、能够负担海外旅游支出的群体征收税费，再将相关收入用于支持泰国国内旅游业发展，从而减少旅游发展对政府财政预算的依赖。拉瓦隆指出，这一措施不仅有助于减轻政府财政负担，也符合泰国严格维护财政纪律的政策方向。财政纪律和财政稳定性是国际信用评级机构评估一国信用状况时的重要指标，因此政府希望通过更加合理的税收安排，提高公共财政管理效率。 对于此前引发社会讨论的每次最高5000泰铢征税标准，拉瓦隆特别澄清，这并不意味着未来所有出境旅客都必须缴纳5000泰铢。他解释，5000泰铢只是法律规定的最高征税额度，主要目的是为未来政策调整保留一定空间，同时限制财政部的征税权限，确保实际税额不会超过法律规定的上限。至于真正实施时的具体税率，还需要通过后续配套法规进一步确定。 “财政部认为，征收1000泰铢应该是比较合适的水平。”拉瓦隆表示，泰国早在20多年前就曾征收过类似的出境税，当时的收费标准为每人500泰铢。考虑到当前经济环境及物价变化，将征收标准调整至1000泰铢具有一定合理性。他回忆称，过去旅客需要在机场通过专门的自动售票设备缴纳500泰铢，并取得缴费凭证。随后，移民局工作人员在检查护照时，会收取并撕下相应凭证，以确认旅客已经缴税。不过，随着航空运输及电子支付系统的发展，财政部认为已经没有必要继续采用这种传统收费方式。 拉瓦隆指出，如果未来正式实施出境旅行税，最便捷的方式是将税费直接纳入机票价格，由航空公司或相关票务系统统一代收，类似于目前机票费用中包含部分税费的做法。这样既能够提高征收效率，也可以避免旅客在机场额外排队缴费。 除了收费标准和征收方式，外国旅客是否需要缴纳出境旅行税也是此次政策讨论的重要内容。拉瓦隆表示，泰国过去的相关法律主要针对泰国公民征税，但从国际通行原则来看，无论泰国公民还是外国旅客，在泰国境内活动期间都会使用该国的公共资源，因此原则上可以考虑将所有从泰国出境的人

summary_cn: 国家图书节今年汇聚319家出版社参展，912个展位规模创新高。尽管电子书普及，纸质书阅读热度不减，读者对精美书封的喜爱持续驱动出版业繁荣。行业同时关注今年洪灾对出版生产与销售的潜在影响。

desc: MGC-ASIA ส่งทัพรถหรู–อีวี 260 คัน รับประชุมโลก ปั้นรายได้ครบวงจร
title_cn: MGC-ASIA派出260多辆豪车电动车迎接IMF-世界银行会议
summary_cn: 曼谷即将举办国际货币基金组织（IMF）与世界银行年会，MGC-ASIA公司派出260多辆豪华车和电动车提供接待服务。此举展示泰国汽车产业能力，为本国产业链创造完整的经济效益。
desc_original: MGC-ASIA ส่งทัพรถหรู–อีวี 260 คัน รับประชุมโลก ปั้นรายได้ครบวงจร

title: BoI urges more Japanese high-tech investments
desc: Japanese investors are being encouraged to invest in data and cloud service businesses as the Thai government promotes the development of digital infrastructure and advanced technology.
title_cn: 泰国投资促进委员会促请日本加大高科技投资力度
summary_cn: 泰国投资促进委员会（BoI）向日本投资者发出呼吁，希望吸引更多资本流入数据和云服务领域。这反映泰国政府推进数字基础设施建设和先进技术发展的战略重点，力图利用日本技术优势推动产业升级。
desc_original: Japanese investors are being encouraged to invest in data and cloud service businesses as the Thai government promotes the development of digital infrastructure and advanced technology.

title: “ไอเอ็มเอฟ” ประเมินปี 69 ไทยโต 2.1% ห่วงโซ่ผลิต AI ช่วยหนุนเศรษฐกิจหลุดพ้น “เงินฝืด”
desc: ไอเอ็มเอฟมองเศรษฐกิจไทยหนีพ้นภาวะเงินฝืดแล้ว ปีนี้และปีหน้าโตเท่ากันที่ 2.1% ได้แรงหนุนจาก AI ด้าน “วิทัย” ยันเศรษฐกิจไทยปีนี้ โตไม่ต่ำกว่า 2.3% ส่งออก-ลงทุนพุ่ง ห่วงหนี้ครัวเรือนสูง
title_cn: IMF预估泰国2026年增速2.1% AI产业链助力经济摆脱融资困境
summary_cn: 国际货币基金组织评估泰国2026年经济增速为2.1%，对标明年持平。人工智能产业链被视为关键增长驱动力，政府科技部门预期本年增速可达2.3%，得益于出口和投资增长，但家庭债务居高不下仍需警惕。

title: “ณรงค์ชัย” ชงปล่อยมือธุรกิจ “Zombie” แข่งขันไม่ได้ “ปิดแผลเก่า” ไทยมุ่งไปอนาคต
desc: “ณรงค์ชัย” ชงปล่อย “Zombie SMEs” ออกจากระบบหลังสินเชื่อหดตัว 16 ไตรมาสติด ขุนคลังเตือนคลื่นลงทุนใหม่ดั่ง “รถไฟความเร็วสูงที่มีประตูจำกัด” หากไม่เร่งปรับทักษะคนไทยเสี่ยงตกรถ
title_cn: 泰国财政部长力推「僵尸企业」退市 加速人力资本升级应对投资新浪潮
summary_cn: 泰国财政部长尼隆差建议放手「僵尸中小企业」退出经济体系。他用高速列车比喻预警新投资浪潮：机会有限，企业信贷已连续收缩16个季度。政府欲推进经济结构优化，加快劳动力技能升级以适应产业转变。
desc_original: “ณรงค์ชัย” ชงปล่อย “Zombie SMEs” ออกจากระบบหลังสินเชื่อหดตัว 16 ไตรมาสติด ขุนคลังเตือนคลื่นลงทุนใหม่ดั่ง “รถไฟความเร็วสูงที่มีประตูจำกัด” หากไม่เร่งปรับทักษะคนไทยเสี่ยงตกรถ

title: Warning over outbound tax's potential impact on tourism
desc: The proposed outbound tax may impact budget-conscious foreign travellers, says a member of the Restaurant Association.
title_cn: 「出国税」拟议引发旅游业担忧
summary_cn: 泰国餐饮业协会成员警告，拟议的出国税政策可能对预算有限的外国游客造成冲击，影响泰国作为旅游目的地的竞争力。作为国家经济重要支柱，旅游业的稳定性直接关乎外汇收入和就业。该政策实施前需谨慎评估对游客消费意愿的影响。
desc_original: The proposed outbound tax may impact budget-conscious foreign travellers, says a member of the Restaurant Association.

title: Bad loans pressure banking sector
desc: Fitch Ratings expects continued pressure on Thailand's banking sector from elevated non-performing loans (NPLs) and sluggish loan growth, pointing to a deteriorating industry outlook.
title_cn: 泰国银行业面临不良贷款压力
summary_cn: 国际评级机构惠誉（Fitch Ratings）指出，泰国银行业持续承受高比例不良贷款和信贷增长缓慢的双重压力。不良贷款比例攀升和贷款投放放缓已成为行业的重大挑战，预示着行业前景堪忧，对银行盈利能力和金融系统稳定性都构成威胁。
desc_original: Fitch Ratings expects continued pressure on Thailand's banking sector from elevated non-performing loans (NPLs) and sluggish loan growth, pointing to a deteriorating industry outlook.

title: Suchada faces asset scrutiny
desc: Bhumjaithai MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap must explain suspected discrepancies in her asset declarations and will receive no legal assistance from the party, its secretary-general Chaichanok Chidchob said on Tuesday.
title_cn: 前进党议员苏查达遭资产审查
summary_cn: 泰国前进党（Bhumjaithai）国会议员苏查达·张·坦萨普（Suchada Zhang Thaensap）因资产申报出现可疑差异而被要求作出解释。党秘书长表示党方将不为其提供法律援助，凸显泰国政治中日益严格的廉政监管要求，以及政党对成员廉洁的自律态度。
desc_original: Bhumjaithai MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap must explain suspected discrepancies in her asset declarations and will receive no legal assistance from the party, its secretary-general Chaichanok Chidchob said on Tuesday.

title: PM says text of censure motion hazy
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has criticised the wording of the opposition's no-confidence motion, suggesting it may be why the House speaker has yet to formally notify the government and saying the language may need to be polished to make it more "civilised".
title_cn: 总理指弹劾动议措辞模糊
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷·缮威拉古（Anutin Charnvirakul）批评反对派提出的不信任动议措辞不够清晰，暗示这是众议院议长迟未正式通知政府的原因。总理建议相关动议的措辞需要修改以更加「文明」。此举反映出泰国政治中对程序规范和措辞严谨性的重视。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has criticised the wording of the opposition's no-confidence motion, suggesting it may be why the House speaker has yet to formally notify the government and saying the language may need to be polished to make it more "civilised".

title: Unsit rejects 'shame' jibe over exams
desc: Interior permanent secretary Unsit Sampuntharat on Tuesday defended the ministry's handling of alleged fraud in local recruitment exams, hitting back at criticism from his predecessor.
title_cn: 内务部为招聘考试舞弊处理辩护
summary_cn: 泰国内务部常务秘书乌西特·散普塔拉（Unsit Sampuntharat）为部门在地方招聘考试舞弊问题上的处理进行了辩护，对前任的批评予以回应。此事涉及公务员选拔的廉洁性和程序规范，反映出当前政府对用人制度规范化的强调和改进努力。
desc_original: Interior permanent secretary Unsit Sampuntharat on Tuesday defended the ministry's handling of alleged fraud in local recruitment exams, hitting back at criticism from his predecessor.

title: Minister targets companies linked to contamination
desc: Deputy Interior Minister Polapee Suwunchwee on Tuesday vowed legal action against those responsible for a chemical leak from industrial waste that worsened flooding in Si Maha Phot district of Prachin Buri.
title_cn: 副内政部长出手打击污染企业
summary_cn: 泰国副内政部长坡拉皮·苏旺绸周二宣布，将对造成工业废物化学泄漏、加重美迪帕县（Si Maha Phot）洪灾的责任方提起法律诉讼。该县位于北柳府（Prachin Buri）。为防灾害再现，部长誓言严肃处置污染源头，维护民众生命财产安全。
desc_original: Deputy Interior Minister Polapee Suwunchwee on Tuesday vowed legal action against those responsible for a chemical leak from industrial waste that worsened flooding in Si Maha Phot district of Prachin Buri.

title: Scam crackdowns net 39 suspects
desc: Police arrested 39 suspects and seized assets worth more than 500 million baht in raids across 11 provinces targeting a transnational scam and money-laundering network.
title_cn: 跨国诈骗网络摧毁，39人落网
summary_cn: 泰国警方在11个府的联合突击行动中，成功破获一个跨国诈骗和洗钱网络，逮捕39名犯罪嫌疑人，冻结没收资产超过5亿泰铢。此案涉及多个省份，打击范围广、力度大，是对有组织诈骗活动的重拳出击。这次行动对保护当地和外籍人士的财产安全意义重大。
desc_original: Police arrested 39 suspects and seized assets worth more than 500 million baht in raids across 11 provinces targeting a transnational scam and money-laundering network.

title: Local market moving towards greater maturity
desc: Thailand's e-commerce market is moving towards greater maturity, with increasingly sophisticated online shoppers emerging as a potential source of growth as the industry shifts its focus from attracting new users to deepening consumer engagement.
title_cn: 泰国电商市场走向成熟
summary_cn: 泰国电子商务市场正走向成熟阶段，消费者网购行为日趋理性。在线购物者素质提升，消费深度开发成为行业新的增长动力。业界战略调整——从「广撒网吸引新用户」转向「深化消费者粘性」，反映市场已进入精细化运营和消费升级时代。
desc_original: Thailand's e-commerce market is moving towards greater maturity, with increasingly sophisticated online shoppers emerging as a potential source of growth as the industry shifts its focus from attracting new users to deepening consumer engagement.

title: Thailand urged to build foundations for AI hub
desc: Flexible AI infrastructure, data sovereignty and home-grown talent are the three key priorities required to make Thailand a regional AI hub, says Huawei Thailand.
title_cn: 泰国建设AI中心的三大关键
summary_cn: 华为泰国公司指出，泰国要成为东南亚人工智能（AI）中心，需在三个领域重点突破：灵活高效的AI基础设施、数据主权保护、本土AI人才培养。这三个支柱相辅相成，缺一不可。华为呼吁政府部门与民营企业联手，共同布局泰国的AI生态。
desc_original: Flexible AI infrastructure, data sovereignty and home-grown talent are the three key priorities required to make Thailand a regional AI hub, says Huawei Thailand.

title: Unsit says flood funds 'sufficient'
desc: Interior permanent secretary Unsit Sampuntharat on Tuesday assured that the government had sufficient funds to compensate flood victims, with payments already made to nearly 300,000 households.
title_cn: 政府称洪灾补偿资金充足
summary_cn: 泰国内政部常务秘书乌西特·三蒲谭塔拉周二表示，政府已筹措充足资金用于洪灾受害者补偿，目前已向近30万户受灾家庭发放赔款。政府承诺加快支付进度，确保所有受灾群众都能及时获得帮助和保障。
desc_original: Interior permanent secretary Unsit Sampuntharat on Tuesday assured that the government had sufficient funds to compensate flood victims, with payments already made to nearly 300,000 households.

title: Four held in industrial waste seizures
desc: Authorities in Chon Buri have seized hundreds of tonnes of suspected industrial waste at two sites in the province and detained four people as part of a crackdown on the illegal storage and processing of industrial refuse.
title_cn: 春武里追缴非法工业废弃物 四人被捕
summary_cn: 春武里府（Chon Buri）当局在两个地点查获数百吨疑似非法工业废弃物，并拘捕四人。这是泰国对非法存储和处理工业垃圾的打击行动的一部分，意在加强环保执法和防止污染。
desc_original: Authorities in Chon Buri have seized hundreds of tonnes of suspected industrial waste at two sites in the province and detained four people as part of a crackdown on the illegal storage and processing of industrial refuse.

title: Businesses urged to boost risk management
desc: Thai businesses are advised to strengthen risk management against geopolitical tensions, extreme weather and emerging technology threats, while investing in artificial intelligence (AI) skills rather than laying off employees to deal with the country's ageing population and shrinking workforce, says global consultancy Marsh.
title_cn: 泰国敦促企业强化风险管理
summary_cn: 全球咨询公司美世（Marsh）建议泰国企业增强对地缘政治紧张、极端天气和新兴技术威胁的风险防范。同时应投资人工智能（AI）人才培养而非裁员，以应对泰国人口老龄化和劳动力萎缩的长期挑战。
desc_original: Thai businesses are advised to strengthen risk management against geopolitical tensions, extreme weather and emerging technology threats, while investing in artificial intelligence (AI) skills rather than laying off employees to deal with the country's ageing population and shrinking workforce, says global consultancy Marsh.

title: Business leaders told to adapt or fall behind
desc: Leaders and organisations need to embrace continuous transformation and develop an "unbeatable mindset" to navigate an unpredictable world, says prominent technology figure Ruangroj Poonpol, ex-group chairman of Kasikorn Business-Technology Group (KBTG).
title_cn: 商业领袖需适应变革 否则落后
summary_cn: 卡西柯商务科技集团（Kasikorn Business-Technology Group, KBTG）前董事长鲁昂罗吉·蓬波尔（Ruangroj Poonpol）表示，企业领导者必须拥抱持续变革，培养「无敌心态」以应对不可预测的世界，强调适应能力对企业生存的重要性。
desc_original: Leaders and organisations need to embrace continuous transformation and develop an "unbeatable mindset" to navigate an unpredictable world, says prominent technology figure Ruangroj Poonpol, ex-group chairman of Kasikorn Business-Technology Group (KBTG).

title: SME D Bank set to miss lending target amid sluggish economy
desc: The economic slowdown has affected the lending performance of SME Development Bank of Thailand (SME D Bank), as loans approved during the first nine months of the year totalled 62 billion baht, short of its full-year target of 80 billion baht.
title_cn: 泰国中小企业开发银行难以完成放贷目标
summary_cn: 受经济放缓影响，泰国中小企业开发银行（SME D Bank）今年前九个月批准贷款总额仅62亿泰铢，未达全年80亿泰铢的目标。反映出当前泰国经济增长乏力对中小企业融资的压力。
desc_original: The economic slowdown has affected the lending performance of SME Development Bank of Thailand (SME D Bank), as loans approved during the first nine months of the year totalled 62 billion baht, short of its full-year target of 80 billion baht.

title: Guide to a successful salary conversation
desc: For workers looking for or preparing to begin a new job, the salary conversation can be a challenge. These days, they need to look beyond the question "How much salary should I ask for?", and develop a more structured understanding of their market value, according to the online employment platform Jobsdb by SEEK.
title_cn: 求职薪资谈判指南
summary_cn: 招聘平台Jobsdb（SEEK旗下）建议求职者在新工作谈判中超越「应该要多少薪水」的简单问题，而是建立对自身市场价值的系统化认识，以便在薪资谈判中获得更有利的位置。
desc_original: For workers looking for or preparing to begin a new job, the salary conversation can be a challenge. These days, they need to look beyond the question "How much salary should I ask for?", and develop a more structured understanding of their market value, according to the online employment platform Jobsdb by SEEK.

title: Putting venture capital to better use
desc: Consider a Thai entrepreneur with a problem that looks like a good one to have. She has built a real business. There are customers, revenues and employees. She can see an opportunity to expand, perhaps into another Thai province, perhaps across Southeast Asia and knows how much capital she needs.
title_cn: 如何更好地利用风险投资
summary_cn: 一位泰国女创业者已有实际业务基础，拥有客户、收入和员工，现寻求扩张到泰国其他省份甚至东南亚地区的机会，需要了解融资渠道和资本运用策略。
desc_original: Consider a Thai entrepreneur with a problem that looks like a good one to have. She has built a real business. There are customers, revenues and employees. She can see an opportunity to expand, perhaps into another Thai province, perhaps across Southeast Asia and knows how much capital she needs.

title: Hlun Solo autopsy finds alcohol but no signs of assault
desc: Hlun Solo autopsy finds alcohol but no signs of assault Legacy New autopsy and toxicology results in the death of Thai travel YouTuber Hlun Solo found no signs of physical assault and detected ethyl alcohol , but Georgian authorities have still not determined what caused his death . The 26 year old YouTuber, whose real name was Boworatat Pengsuk, was found dead inside a hotel in Georgia earlier in July. His brother shared the latest update on his Facebook page, Klose Mos, yesterday, October 12, after receiving additional information from Georgian authorities through the Thai Embassy in Ankara . According to the update, the medical examination found no signs of physical assault, while blood tests detected ethyl alcohol at a concentration of 0.33% but no methyl alcohol, isopropyl alcohol or acetone. Laboratory tests also returned negative results for the drugs, psychoactive substances and organochlorine and organophosphorus pesticides included in the examination. title: Finance Ministry defends 1,000-baht departure tax amid backlash
desc: Finance Ministry defends 1,000-baht departure tax amid backlash Legacy Thailand’s Finance Ministry has defended its proposed 1,000-baht departure tax after mounting opposition from the tourism industry , arguing that the measure would strengthen government finances and help support tourism. Finance permanent secretary Lavaron Sangsnit said the tax would target people with the means to travel overseas, with the revenue going to the state to ease budget pressure and support tourism recovery. He said the 5,000-baht figure contained in the draft legislation is only the maximum permitted rate. The actual charge expected under secondary legislation would be 1,000 baht per person. The tax would apply to both Thai and foreign travellers leaving the country by air and would be included in airline ticket bookings rather than collected separately at departure. title: 泰国新星Nene将出席IMF-世行年会献唱成名曲
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 10月13日12点40分，泰国总理兼内政部部长阿努廷前往Santi Maitri大楼视察，为即将于明天（10月14日）举行的2026年国际货币基金组织（IMF)）和世界银行集团年会财长及央行行长晚宴做准备。为了迎接来自全球的贵宾，现场布置得十分精美。 据悉，本次晚宴以“泰国欢迎世界”（Thailand Welcome The World）为主题，准备了冬阴功等极具泰式风情的知名菜品，并由“Serao Ground Symphony Orchestra”交响乐团在场演奏，旨在营造令人难忘的晚宴氛围。 阿努廷透露，明天的晚宴还有一大亮点，今年《美国达人秀》的冠军“Nene”将到场带来特别演出，以此欢迎全球金融领袖。他表示，非常感谢Nene抽出时间出席，她现在已经是享誉世界的知名艺术家了。在昨天（10月12日）和多位金融领袖会面时，他发现大家都认识Nene，并且对能亲眼观看她的演出感到十分期待和激动。 在演出曲目方面，Nene特意挑选了大家耳熟能详的英文名曲，包括让她一战成名的《Zombie》，另外还有泰国经典歌曲《ซมซาน》（迷惘）。当被问及是否会与这位知名歌手合唱时，阿努廷幽默地回应说，音乐早已融入他的内心，仅仅是聆听就已经让人感到非常快乐了。 （编译：KA；来源：thestandard） The post 泰国新星Nene将出席IMF-世行年会献唱成名曲 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 他信提交大赦申请，盼清白履历安度晚年
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 10月13日，泰国前总理他信的律师维尼亚透露，近日他信授权他通过总理府办公室次长综合服务中心，向社会和平促进委员会主席提交申请，请求依据2025版《社会和平促进法案》判定他信享有大赦及免除一切责任的权利。虽然最终结果取决于委员会，但维尼亚表示，他希望委员会能作宽泛解释、一视同仁，并切合法律初衷进行全面考量。 这次申请涵盖了他信所有涉及大赦范围的案件，没有按单起案件进行拆分，其申请的理由是为了履历清白。维尼亚称，他信想证明自己过去所做的一切都是为了人民和国家，全属于政治层面的事件，他已经服过刑了，现在年纪大了，不会再干涉政治，也不打算再参政，只想澄清针对他的指控，再做点生意，平静地生活。 对此，总理府办公室次长兼社会和平促进委员会秘书长查柴回应说，他需要先核实是否已经收到了他信的申请，如果确定收到了，申请将交给司法部次长担任主席的筛选小组委员会审议。他信有权提出申请，而且一旦收到此类申请，筛选小组委员会必须开会讨论其内容是否符合受理条件，若符合则会进一步提交至由副总理巴功担任负责人的委员会大会再次审议。 针对他信提出申请的理由“希望恢复清白，因为当下国家需要团结和解”是否成立这一问题，查柴表示，提交申请有既定原则，必须审查是否存在政治动机，如果是普通刑事案件、不涉及政治，则不属于受理范围，很多案例都可能需要举证或说明政治背景。根据法律规定，委员会须在180天内处理完毕，虽然预计近期将召开会议，因为目前正处于收集申请的阶段，但委员会还没有预定开会的时间，之后他会再询问司法部次长。 （编译：KA；来源：pptvhd36） The post 他信提交大赦申请，盼清白履历安度晚年 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Foreign selling curbs SET momentum
desc: The Stock Exchange of Thailand moved sideways for most of September, with selling by foreign investors picking up the pace and continuing into October.
title_cn: 外资抛售拖累泰股涨势
summary_cn: 泰国股市（SET）9月走势震荡，外资卖出力度加大，延续至10月。外资净卖出现象加剧，压制了股市的上升动能。这反映出国际投资者对泰国股市的谨慎态度，可能受到全球经济不确定性和地缘政治因素影响。泰股涨势受限，投资者需关注后续外资流向变化。

title: Language institute under fire after China study trip collapses
desc: Language institute under fire after China study trip collapses Legacy Parents and students have filed complaints against a private language institute after a Chinese-language course in Chongqing was disrupted days before departure, leaving dozens seeking refunds and claiming losses of more than 1.13 million baht. Eleven representatives from a group of more than 50 affected people went to the Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) complaint centre yesterday, October 12, to meet Consumer Protection Police Division investigators. One complainant, identified only as A, said she had signed up after seeing the institute advertise a short Chinese-language course in Chongqing scheduled for October 10 to 24. Participants were charged between 30,000 and 50,000 baht per family. As the departure date approached, parents said they had still not received flight tickets or invitation letters needed for the trip. On October 8, the institute informed participants that the programme would instead run from October 12 to 26 and also changed the destination university at short notice. title: 泰国游热度不减，第四季度国际航班预计增长5.8%
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 10月12日，泰国开泰研究中心（KResearch）的报告显示，2026年第四季度入境泰国的航班量增长了5.8%，但增速仍低于同区域内的多个国家和地区。在全球范围内，国际航班计划整体保持扩张态势，总航班量同比增长2.5%；而入境泰国的国际航班增长5.8%，反映出以“泰国”作为出行目的地的需求依然强劲。不过，泰国的入境航班增长率仍低于区域内的多个目的地，如越南、马来西亚和中国，表明各国各地区在吸引国际游客方面的竞争越来越激烈。 另外，来自不同客源地的入境航班增长并不均衡，这可能会导致不同客源地的游客复苏步伐出现差异。从客源市场来看，从中国、马来西亚和欧洲飞往泰国的航班持续增加，特别是来自中国和欧洲的航班，分别增长了28.6%和21.6%，预计将有助于支撑今年年底阶段的赴泰旅游。而部分主要客源地的航班走势却较为疲软，其中，来自印度、俄罗斯和韩国的航班分别下降了4.6%、22.5%和20.5%，说明这些市场的游客复苏仍有压力，且导致了外国游客的整体增长不均衡。 入境泰国各大重要旅游城市的国际航班也存在差异，绝大多数航班依然集中在曼谷和普吉岛，反映出旅游业复苏带来的红利在国内各个地区之间的分配并不均匀。 开泰研究中心认为，尽管2026年年底入境泰国的航班趋势向好，但仍需密切关注地缘政治风险、部分地区的水灾局势以及居高不下的航空燃油成本。这些因素可能会促使航空公司放缓增加航班的步伐，或对部分航线进行削减。同时，竞争对手的航班增长速度快于泰国，也可能会影响航空公司的航班和运力分配，给泰国未来维持游客市场份额带来更多挑战。 （编译：KA；来源：thebangkokinsight） The post 泰国游热度不减，第四季度国际航班预计增长5.8% appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Bangkok and UK explore cleaner transport and climate plans
desc: Bangkok and UK explore cleaner transport and climate plans Legacy Bangkok governor Chadchart Sittipunt met UK climate representative Rachel Kyte yesterday, October 12, to discuss public transport, flood prevention, air pollution and other measures aimed at making the capital more resilient to climate change . The pair travelled by BTS from National Stadium station and visited the Pathumwan Skywalk while discussing Bangkok’s transport network and plans for development around mass-transit stations. Their talks covered flood management, including improvements to drainage systems, water-retention areas, flood-absorbing parks, permeable pavements and early-warning systems. They also discussed preparations for extreme heat , including the expansion of Bangkok’s 15-minute parks and designated cooling spaces for vulnerable groups. On transport, the discussions included better connections between different modes of travel and transit-oriented development around stations, including areas such as Rama IX and the Thailand Cultural Centre. title_cn: 曼谷与英国携手探讨清洁运输和气候适应方案
summary_cn: 曼谷市长查差察与英国气候代表Rachel Kyte讨论应对气候变化的措施。双方乘坐BTS视察曼谷运输网络，重点包括改善排水系统、建设蓄水区和透水路面、拓展「15分钟公园」和避暑空间、推广低排放区和拥堵收费、发展以地铁站为中心的城市设计。此举显示曼谷正加强国际合作，推进气候韧性和清洁运输建设。

desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 10月12日，泰国罗勇府府尹代蓬透露，之前有村民举报称，一家中资公司涉嫌走私进口电子垃圾，用集装箱从国外经林查班港口运入，并转运至罗勇府Nikhom Pattana县Nikhom Pattana镇1村某公司14号仓库。在综合分析各项证据后，府事务处理中心负责人塔宁协调相关部门前往现场核查。 据悉，涉事地点为罗勇工业有限公司的出租区域，位于罗勇府Nikhom Pattana县1村99/13号。执法人员首先要求该区域的负责人丹恩（化名）打开14号仓库，以便进行检查，因为这里极可能是电子废料卸货后进行分类的第一个仓库。 经过搜查，14号仓库内发现了分拣和粉碎电子垃圾的大型机器，工业废料堆积如山，比人还高出不少。一名执法人员表示，这里发现的电子垃圾数量估计是全国最多的。然而，丹恩没有打开其他仓库的权限，因此无法入内检查，但从玻璃外向内望，里面同样堆满了电子垃圾。目前，执法人员依法先行查封了14号仓库，且严禁将垃圾运出场地。 （编译：KA；来源：thaipost） The post 一中资仓库涉嫌走私电子垃圾被查，数量全泰最多 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Rare leopard cat killed while crossing road near Khao Yai
desc: Rare leopard cat killed while crossing road near Khao Yai Legacy A leopard cat was found dead after apparently being hit by a vehicle on a road about two kilometres from Khao Yai National Park in Nakhon Ratchasima today, October 13. The animal was found on a highway near a school in Pong Ta Long subdistrict, Pak Chong district. A Mu Si police officer spotted the animal while travelling back to the station after finishing duty in the morning and contacted Khao Yai National Park rangers to inspect it. He said he initially thought the spotted animal lying on the road might be a tiger cub, but realised after looking more closely that it was a leopard cat. Park officials believe the animal was struck by a vehicle while crossing the road during its nighttime search for food. Photo via Wetchayan Fah Khao Yai National Park chief Chaiya Huaihongthong said the leopard cat is a protected wild mammal under Thailand’s wildlife protection law . Leopard cats are small wild felines that resemble domestic cats but have slightly longer legs and distinctive spots across their bodies. They are primarily active at night. title: IMF-世行年会特展开幕，传达皇室倡议推动国家发展
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 10月12日17点，泰国总理兼内政部部长阿努廷在诗丽吉王后国家会议中心为“皇室愿景：赋能人民，增强韧性以应对变革”（The Royal Legacy: Empowering People, Building Resilience）特别展览揭幕，副总理兼财政部部长艾尼提、国家经济和社会发展委员会办公室秘书长达努查、世界银行集团行长彭安杰（Ajay Banga）、国际货币基金组织总裁克里斯塔利娜（Kristalina Georgieva）及多位贵宾出席。 阿努廷在致辞中表示，本次特别展览的主题表明了泰国将人民置于发展中心、增强社会应对全球不确定性能力的坚定决心，这一理念与拉玛九世先王普密蓬·阿杜德陛下倡议的“适度经济哲学”紧密相连。在长达70多年的时间里，九世先王陛下以“知识、美德”为基础，秉持“适度、合理、具备应对变化能力”三项原则，始终致力于促进国家发展，直到今天，这些原则依然是泰国的重要核心。衡量进步不应仅局限于经济增长，还应涵盖社区的坚韧度、环境保护以及人民应对未来挑战的能力，“适度经济哲学”正是一条促进平衡、包容和可持续发展的指导路线。 2027年，泰国将迎来九世先王陛下诞辰100周年纪念，这次的特别展览也是为了缅怀九世先王陛下的皇室功绩，并展示可应用于应对当下挑战的皇室理念。在“皇家展馆”内，展出了多个将上述原则转化为具体实践的皇室倡议与发展项目，旨在增强社区实力、提高人民生活质量和建立抗风险能力。阿努廷坚信，本次展览将激励各个领域共同推动“不让任何人落后”的发展，为所有人创造可持续的未来。 （编译：KA；来源：thestandardth） The post IMF-世行年会特展开幕，传达皇室倡议推动国家发展 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: IMF 和世行年会特展开幕，传达皇室倡议推动国家发展
summary_cn: 国际货币基金组织 IMF 和世界银行 World Bank 年会期间，泰国总理主持「皇室遗产：赋能人民，增强韧性以应对变革」特展揭幕。展览突出展示已故九世皇「适度经济哲学」的实践，通过皇室倡议和发展项目阐释平衡、包容、可持续发展理念，为应对全球变局提供发展方案。

title: 泰国公务员5年净增近8千人，军人降幅最大
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 10月12日，泰国众议院秘书处学术办资源开发组引用公务员制度委员会办公室发布的《2021-2025财年政府人力资源报告》称，在2021至2025财年期间，泰国公务员总人数净增7,948人，增幅约0.45%，总数从1,756,703人增至1,764,651人。从总体看，在划分的14类公务员中，有8个类别的编制人数有所增加，6个类别的编制人数有所减少，增减相互抵消后，数量变化不大。 如果按类别细分，教师及教育人员在数量上增加最多，府级行政组织的公务员在比例上增幅最大，而军人则是人数减少最多的群体。其中，人数增加最多的前三个群体依次是： 1. 教师及教育人员：从415,292人增至449,072人，增加33,780人，增幅为8.13%； 2. 府级行政组织公务员：从10,893人增至28,825人，增加17,932人，增幅高达164.62%； 3. 市政工作人员：从66,566人增至74,762人，增加8,196人，增幅为12.31%。 教师及教育人员数量连续多年增长，并在2025财年成为该数据集里人数最多的群体，超越了2021财年中人数更多的普通文职公务员；府级行政组织公务员则是14个类别中增长率最高的群体，2025财年的人数约为2021财年的2.65倍；市政工作人员的数量在此期间有所波动，在2024财年下降后，于2025财年出现回升。 以上三个群体合计增加了59,908人，但由于同一时期有多个类别的公务员人数减少，所以全员净增人数远低于这一数字。其中，人数减少最多的前三个群体依次是： 1. 军人：从400,430人减至370,358人，减少30,072人，降幅为7.51%； 2. 普通文职公务员：从426,108人减至417,319人，减少8,789人，降幅为2.06%； 3. 警察：从219,768人减至211,037人，减少8,731人，降幅为3.97%。 不过，期初与期末的对比趋势与最近一年的动态有所不同。2025财年，军人数量较2024财年回升了1,647人；普通文职公务员回升了3,231人；而警察人数则减少了2,049人。因此，军人与普通文职公务员的人数相比2021财年变少了，并不表示其人数逐年递减，因为这两个群体在2025财年均已止跌回升。 其余8类公务员在2021与2025财年之间的变化如下： -乡镇行政组织工作人员：从78,390人减至74,153人，减少4,237人，降幅为5.41%； -地方教师：从56,008人减至52,483人，减少3,525人，降幅为6.29%； -曼谷市政人员：从34,286人增至36,601人，增加2,315人，增幅为6.75%； -宪法规定的独立机构公务员：从24,158人增至28,181人，增加4,023人，增幅为16.65%； -高等教育机构文职公务员：从12,252人减至8,841人，减少

title: 泰警缴获16万粒印有中文标签的“疯药”
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 10月12日15点，泰国武里南府地方警察召开新闻发布会，通报在“清剿毒品行动”中成功捣毁一个毒品网络，共逮捕14人，涉及8起案件，并缴获“疯药”168959粒、枪支2支、子弹20发，以及价值约20万铢的汽车1辆。 本次行动由武里南府地方缉毒小组联合多个相关部门，于10月5日至7日期间共同执行。行动人员先在Mueng Buriram县和Satuk县抓捕了几名毒贩，并缴获一些“疯药”中间体。经进一步侦查发现，这些毒品来自Satuk县的一个贩毒网络，行动人员随即设伏抓获了该团伙全部6名人员，年龄介于24至41岁之间，并缴获“疯药”168616粒，加上此前缴获的“疯药”中间体共计168958粒，同时扣押一辆涉案皮卡车，全部已移交Satuk警察局依法处理。 据警方介绍，这次缴获的“疯药”上印有中文商标“志远”，前面是数字3，后面是字母A，之前从未出现过，推测是该贩毒团伙按新需求生产的，因为药丸的形状不变，但气味更刺鼻。不过，也不排除是中资犯罪团伙“改行”转做毒品生意。初步调查认为，这批毒品可能从邻国经泰国北部运入，再经乌汶府转运到各府销售。 （编译：KA；来源：thairath） The post 泰警缴获16万粒印有中文标签的“疯药” appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 泰警缴获16万粒印有中文标签的「疯药」
summary_cn: 泰国武里南府警方破获毒品网络，逮捕14人，缴获168959粒「疯药」冰毒、枪支2支及涉案车辆。缴获毒品印有中文标签「志远」3A，为新型配方，警方推测源自中资犯罪团伙，经泰北运入后转运各府。事件反映跨境毒品走私的严峻态势。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 10月12日15点，泰国武里南府地方警察召开新闻发布会，通报在“清剿毒品行动”中成功捣毁一个毒品网络，共逮捕14人，涉及8起案件，并缴获“疯药”168959粒、枪支2支、子弹20发，以及价值约20万铢的汽车1辆。 本次行动由武里南府地方缉毒小组联合多个相关部门，于10月5日至7日期间共同执行。行动人员先在Mueng Buriram县和Satuk县抓捕了几名毒贩，并缴获一些“疯药”中间体。经进一步侦查发现，这些毒品来自Satuk县的一个贩毒网络，行动人员随即设伏抓获了该团伙全部6名人员，年龄介于24至41岁之间，并缴获“疯药”168616粒，加上此前缴获的“疯药”中间体共计168958粒，同时扣押一辆涉案皮卡车，全部已移交Satuk警察局依法处理。 据警方介绍，这次缴获的“疯药”上印有中文商标“志远”，前面是数字3，后面是字母A，之前从未出现过，推测是该贩毒团伙按新需求生产的，因为药丸的形状不变，但气味更刺鼻。不过，也不排除是中资犯罪团伙“改行”转做毒品生意。初步调查认为，这批毒品可能从邻国经泰国北部运入，再经乌汶府转运到各府销售。 （编译：KA；来源：thairath） The post 泰警缴获16万粒印有中文标签的“疯药” appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title_cn: 世界银行会议料释放10亿资金 泰国争取信心与投资
summary_cn: 学者评估泰国担任IMF-世界银行(World Bank)会议东道主，会期为10月12至18日。此次会议预计将为泰国带来短期资金流入超过10亿泰铢，有助于提升国际投资者信心，吸引实际投资项目落地，对泰国经济发展具有重要推动作用。
desc_original: นักวิชาการ ประเมินไทยเป็นเจ้าภาพประชุม IMF-World Bank วันที่ 12-18 ต.ค.นี้ สร้างเงินสะพัดระยะสั้นกว่า 1 พันล้านบาท

title: Act now to avoid next 'great repression', IMF says
desc: Reforms to boost growth, alongside credible tax and spending plans, could help governments avoid a new wave of financial repression, an International Monetary Fund (IMF) official said on Monday.
title_cn: 国际货币基金组织敦促立即改革 防范新一轮「金融压制」
summary_cn: 国际货币基金组织(IMF)指出，各国政府应采取增长改革，配合可信度高的税收和支出计划，以避免陷入新一轮金融压制。这一警告强调了财政透明度与改革的重要性，对泰国等发展中国家而言，明智的财政政策对经济稳定与可持续发展至关重要。
desc_original: Reforms to boost growth, alongside credible tax and spending plans, could help governments avoid a new wave of financial repression, an International Monetary Fund (IMF) official said on Monday.

title: Youth leaders leave for China
desc: A delegation of 40 Thai youths is visiting China's Yunnan province for a 13-day study programme focusing on ethnic cultures, agriculture, community-based tourism and cooperation in the Mekong subregion.
title_cn: 泰国青年代表赴云南参访 聚焦文化农业与湄公河合作
summary_cn: 由40名泰国青年组成的代表团赴中国云南省进行为期13天的文化交流学习。此次访问重点关注民族文化、农业发展、社区旅游和湄公河(Mekong)次区域合作，旨在加强泰中青年之间的理解与合作，推动区域经济文化交流与深化互利发展。
desc_original: A delegation of 40 Thai youths is visiting China's Yunnan province for a 13-day study programme focusing on ethnic cultures, agriculture, community-based tourism and cooperation in the Mekong subregion.

title: Anutin courts Japanese EV manufacturers
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has invited Japanese automakers to use Thailand as an electric vehicle (EV) production base, pledging to protect the existing automotive industry.
title_cn: 阿努廷邀请日本电动车制造商来泰建厂 承诺保护汽车产业
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷(Anutin Charnvirakul)向日本汽车制造商发出邀请，欢迎其以泰国为电动汽车(EV)生产基地。他同时承诺保护现有汽车产业，旨在推动泰国向新能源产业升级，吸引日本投资，维持就业机会，巩固泰国在东南亚汽车制造中心的地位。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has invited Japanese automakers to use Thailand as an electric vehicle (EV) production base, pledging to protect the existing automotive industry.

title: Designers showcase Thai silk
desc: Designers from more than 100 countries are showcasing creations made with Thai silk in Bangkok as Thailand hosts the 2026 annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank Group.
title_cn: 设计师展示泰丝
summary_cn: 来自100多个国家的设计师在曼谷展示了用泰丝制作的精美创意作品。本次展示活动在泰国主办的2026年国际货币基金组织（IMF）和世界银行集团年会期间举行，为泰国传统文化和现代设计创意提供了国际展示平台，有助于提升泰丝这一传统工艺品的国际知名度和市场价值。
desc_original: Designers from more than 100 countries are showcasing creations made with Thai silk in Bangkok as Thailand hosts the 2026 annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank Group.

title: Rice exporters wary of US jasmine
desc: It is too early to assess the potential impact of jasmine rice cultivation in the United States on Thai rice exports to the US, a member of the Thai Rice Exporters Association said.
title_cn: 米商警惕美国茉莉米
summary_cn: 泰国大米出口协会成员表示，美国开始种植茉莉米（jasmine rice），对泰国向美国出口大米的潜在影响目前还难以准确评估。这一言论反映了泰国大米出口商对美国本地产茉莉米可能带来竞争的担忧。泰国大米出口是重要经济支柱，需要密切关注美国市场的动态变化。
desc_original: It is too early to assess the potential impact of jasmine rice cultivation in the United States on Thai rice exports to the US, a member of the Thai Rice Exporters Association said.

title: Energy consulting heats up amid rising power costs
desc: Thailand's energy consulting and solutions market is becoming increasingly competitive as rising electricity costs and growing interest in clean energy drive demand for renewable power systems among households and businesses.
title_cn: 能源咨询市场竞争加剧
summary_cn: 随着泰国电力成本上升和清洁能源需求增长，该国能源咨询和解决方案市场竞争日益激烈。越来越多家庭和企业为应对电费上涨，开始转向可再生能源系统。这股清洁能源转型浪潮为能源顾问和解决方案提供商创造了增长机会，同时也反映了泰国在应对能源成本和环保压力方面的市场需求。
desc_original: Thailand's energy consulting and solutions market is becoming increasingly competitive as rising electricity costs and growing interest in clean energy drive demand for renewable power systems among households and businesses.

title: Regulator to allow crypto ETF trading
desc: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has introduced rules allowing cryptocurrency exchange-traded funds (crypto ETFs) to be established and traded in Thailand, expanding investment options while strengthening investor protection.
title_cn: 泰国证监会批准加密ETF交易
summary_cn: 泰国证券交易委员会（SEC）推出新规则，允许在泰国建立和交易加密货币交易基金（ETF）。这一政策扩大了投资者的投资选择，同时通过相关监管措施加强投资者保护。新政策的出台标志着泰国对加密资产在合规框架下的认可，有助于规范该领域发展，为投资者提供更安全的进入渠道。
desc_original: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has introduced rules allowing cryptocurrency exchange-traded funds (crypto ETFs) to be established and traded in Thailand, expanding investment options while strengthening investor protection.

title: Air force sets out roadmap  for upgrades
desc: Royal Thai Air Force (RTAF) commander ACM Seksan Kantha has unveiled a 2027-2028 roadmap to strengthen the force's capabilities and safeguard Thailand's airspace and sovereignty under the vision of an "Unbeatable Air Force".
title_cn: 皇家泰国空军发布升级路线图
summary_cn: 皇家泰国空军司令塞桑·甘塔中将（ACM Seksan Kantha）公布了2027至2028年的发展路线图，旨在加强空军战力、保护泰国领空和国家主权。该路线图以「不可战胜的空军」为愿景，反映了泰国对国防现代化的承诺。这一战略规划涉及空军能力提升，是泰国重要的军事发展举措。
desc_original: Royal Thai Air Force (RTAF) commander ACM Seksan Kantha has unveiled a 2027-2028 roadmap to strengthen the force's capabilities and safeguard Thailand's airspace and sovereignty under the vision of an "Unbeatable Air Force".

title: สมเด็จพระราชินีองค์ต้นแบบผู้หญิงสายสตรอง ทรงเป็นพระราชินีพระองค์แรกที่ขับเครื่องบินรบ
desc: พระปรีชาสามารถทางด้านการบินของ สมเด็จพระนางเจ้าฯ พระบรมราชินี ได้เป็นที่ประจักษ์แก่สายตาชาวไทยและชาวโลก เมื่อทรงฝึกทำการบินเดี่ยวกับเครื่องบินขับไล่แบบที่ 20 หรือที่รู้จักกันในชื่อ “Gripen”
title_cn: 皇后陛下首次驾驶鹰狮战斗机，成为泰国历史上首位驾驭战机的皇后
summary_cn: 皇后陛下的飞行能力备受瞩目，已为国内外所知。她近日成功驾驶第20型战斗机鹰狮（Gripen）进行单人飞行，成为泰国历史上首位驾驶战斗机的皇后，展现了强势女性的典范风采，获得广泛关注。
desc_original: พระปรีชาสามารถทางด้านการบินของ สมเด็จพระนางเจ้าฯ พระบรมราชินี ได้เป็นที่ประจักษ์แก่สายตาชาวไทยและชาวโลก เมื่อทรงฝึกทำการบินเดี่ยวกับเครื่องบินขับไล่แบบที่ 20 หรือที่รู้จักกันในชื่อ “Gripen”

title: Ekniti pushes AI for all
desc: Better jobs, stronger skills and broader access to the benefits of AI are Thailand's key priorities as the technology transforms work and business, Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas said.
title_cn: 埃克尼蒂推动人工智能惠及全民
summary_cn: 泰国副总理兼财政部长埃克尼蒂（Ekniti Nitithanprapas）表示，在人工智能技术重塑工作和商业的时代，为全民创造更好工作机会、增强技能水平、让更多民众受益于人工智能是泰国的核心优先事项。
desc_original: Better jobs, stronger skills and broader access to the benefits of AI are Thailand's key priorities as the technology transforms work and business, Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas said.

title: Thailand has become 'the sick man of Asia': Korn
desc: Democrat Party deputy leader Korn Chatikavanij warned that Thailand risks falling into an economic trap, saying the country has gone from being an economic success story to the "sick man of Asia".
title_cn: 民主党副领导人警告：泰国沦为「亚洲病夫」
summary_cn: 民主党副领导人科恩·查蒂卡瓦尼普（Korn Chatikavanij）发出严厉警告，泰国正面临陷入经济陷阱的风险，该国已从亚洲经济成功故事演变为「亚洲病夫」，反映出泰国经济前景堪忧。
desc_original: Democrat Party deputy leader Korn Chatikavanij warned that Thailand risks falling into an economic trap, saying the country has gone from being an economic success story to the "sick man of Asia".

title: Korean pornography suspect caught in luxury condo
desc: The Immigration Bureau (IB) has arrested a 42-year-old South Korean man wanted under an Interpol Red Notice for allegedly operating illegal pornography websites and distributing sexually explicit videos involving minors.
title_cn: 韩国色情网站运营嫌犯在曼谷被捕
summary_cn: 泰国移民局在曼谷一处豪华公寓逮捕了一名42岁的韩国男子。该嫌疑人被国际刑警组织通缉，涉嫌非法经营色情网站并传播涉及未成年人的淫秽视频，属于严重的跨国性犯罪案件。
desc_original: The Immigration Bureau (IB) has arrested a 42-year-old South Korean man wanted under an Interpol Red Notice for allegedly operating illegal pornography websites and distributing sexually explicit videos involving minors.

title: BMA deploys health teams to aid victims
desc: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) has deployed 220 Special Health Emergency Response Teams (SHERT) to provide medical and mental health support in 392 flood-affected communities across 29 districts.
title_cn: 曼谷部署医疗应急小组救援洪灾灾民
summary_cn: 曼谷都市区管理局（BMA）已派遣220支特别卫生应急救助队（SHERT）前往29个地区的392个受洪灾影响社区，为灾民提供医疗和心理健康支援，展现政府的应急响应能力。
desc_original: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) has deployed 220 Special Health Emergency Response Teams (SHERT) to provide medical and mental health support in 392 flood-affected communities across 29 districts.

title: Thailand urged to make practical AI a priority
desc: Thailand should prioritise practical artificial intelligence (AI) applications that boost productivity, widen access to services and create jobs, rather than focusing too heavily on attracting large data centres and developing advanced AI models, says the World Bank.
title_cn: 泰国应优先发展实用型人工智能
summary_cn: 世界银行建议泰国重点发展能够提升生产力、扩大服务获取、创造就业机会的实用人工智能（AI）应用，而非过度投入建设大型数据中心和开发尖端AI模型。这一建议旨在帮助泰国在AI领域取得更加务实、高效的发展。
desc_original: Thailand should prioritise practical artificial intelligence (AI) applications that boost productivity, widen access to services and create jobs, rather than focusing too heavily on attracting large data centres and developing advanced AI models, says the World Bank.

title: AIS wins network award amid new tech rollout
desc: Advanced Info Service (AIS) has won the "Autonomous Network Operator Leadership Award" at FutureNet Asia Awards 2026, marking its fourth consecutive year of recognition for advancing intelligent networks through the systematic integration of AI and automation into network management.
title_cn: 泰国AIS通信企业荣获网络创新大奖
summary_cn: Advanced Info Service（AIS）在FutureNet Asia Awards 2026上荣获「自主网络运营商领导力奖」，这是该企业连续第四年获得此项殊荣。AIS通过将人工智能和自动化系统性地整合到网络管理系统中，展现了在网络智能化领域的卓越领导力。
desc_original: Advanced Info Service (AIS) has won the "Autonomous Network Operator Leadership Award" at FutureNet Asia Awards 2026, marking its fourth consecutive year of recognition for advancing intelligent networks through the systematic integration of AI and automation into network management.

title: JTS delays satellite launches to late 2027
desc: Jasmine Technology Solution Plc (JTS), a technology arm of Jasmine International (JAS), has revised its plan with Thai space-technology developer EOS Orbit and will delay the launch of its first set of low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellites from the first half of 2027 to the end of 2027.
title_cn: 茉莉花技术公司推迟卫星发射至2027年底
summary_cn: 茉莉花国际公司（Jasmine International）的技术子公司Jasmine Technology Solution（JTS）与泰国空间技术开发商EOS Orbit调整合作计划，将首批低地球轨道（LEO）卫星的发射时间从2027年上半年延期至年底。项目延期反映了太空产业的技术复杂性和实施难度。
desc_original: Jasmine Technology Solution Plc (JTS), a technology arm of Jasmine International (JAS), has revised its plan with Thai space-technology developer EOS Orbit and will delay the launch of its first set of low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellites from the first half of 2027 to the end of 2027.

title: ช็อก พบร่างตำรวจ สภ.กมลา เสียชีวิตในรถกระบะ เพื่อนร่วมงานเห็นครั้งสุดท้ายเมื่อตอนเช้า
desc: ภูเก็ต ช็อกตลาดกมลา พบร่างตำรวจ สภ.กมลา วัย 37 ปี เสียชีวิตในรถกระบะ พบเตาอั้งโล่ในรถ เจ้าหน้าที่เร่งหาสาเหตุที่แท้จริง
title_cn: 普吉卡玛拉警署警察在车内身亡
summary_cn: 普吉岛卡玛拉警署（Kamala Police Station）一名37岁警察在皮卡车内身亡，车内发现可疑的炭料，官方正紧急调查死亡真相。据警署同事证实，这是他们最后一次在早上看到这位警官。事件引发当地社会广泛关注和震惊。
desc_original: ภูเก็ต ช็อกตลาดกมลา พบร่างตำรวจ สภ.กมลา วัย 37 ปี เสียชีวิตในรถกระบะ พบเตาอั้งโล่ในรถ เจ้าหน้าที่เร่งหาสาเหตุที่แท้จริง

title: “ศุภชัย” จี้ “โรม–รักชนก–ภคมน” 3 กรรมาธิการสภาฯ สอบปม Thai PBS ใช้เงินกว่า 230 ล้านบาท
desc: “ศุภชัย” จี้ “โรม–รักชนก–ภคมน” 3 กรรมาธิการสภาฯ สอบปม Thai PBS ใช้เงินกว่า 230 ล้านบาท หลัง สตง. พบข้อสังเกต เรียกร้องเปิดข้อมูล–ตรวจสอบความโปร่งใส ย้ำสื่ออิสระต้องรับผิดชอบเงินประชาชน
title_cn: 国会敦促调查泰国公共电视台资金使用
summary_cn: 国会议员素帕柴（Supajai）敦促三位国会委员——罗姆（Rome）、乐查农（Ratchanok）、帕克蒙（Phakmon）——调查泰国公共电视台（Thai PBS）使用超过2.3亿泰铢资金的问题。国家审计部门已发现异议，要求该公共媒体机构增加信息透明度并接受严格监督，强调独立媒体必须对公众资金负责。
desc_original: “ศุภชัย” จี้ “โรม–รักชนก–ภคมน” 3 กรรมาธิการสภาฯ สอบปม Thai PBS ใช้เงินกว่า 230 ล้านบาท หลัง สตง. พบข้อสังเกต เรียกร้องเปิดข้อมูล–ตรวจสอบความโปร่งใส ย้ำสื่ออิสระต้องรับผิดชอบเงินประชาชน

title: สภาพัฒน์เตรียมใช้ดัชนี MPI ฉบับอัปเดต เพิ่มส่วนการลงทุนเทคฯ ลุ้นทบทวน GDP ไทยทั้งปี 2569
desc: ล่าสุด ดัชนีผลผลิตอุตสาหกรรม MPI Index ของไทยจะมีการเปลี่ยนแปลงครั้งใหญ่ เรื่องนี้จะส่งผลต่อ GDP ของประเทศแค่ไหน
title_cn: 泰国国家发展委员会准备采用更新版 MPI 指数，加强科技投资部分
summary_cn: 泰国制造业产出指数（MPI Index）将进行重大更新，增加科技投资权重。此举意在更准确反映国家经济结构变化，对泰国全年 GDP 重新评估有重大影响。该举措旨在更好适应数字经济时代的发展需求。
desc_original: ล่าสุด ดัชนีผลผลิตอุตสาหกรรม MPI Index ของไทยจะมีการเปลี่ยนแปลงครั้งใหญ่ เรื่องนี้จะส่งผลต่อ GDP ของประเทศแค่ไหน

title: IMF ชี้โลกยังต้องการ "คน" ทำงาน แต่ต้อง “ใช้ AI เป็น” พร้อมเปิด 3 ทักษะที่ตลาดต้องการ
desc: IMF ชี้ AI กำลังเปลี่ยนตลาดแรงงานเอเชีย ความต้องการจ้างงานบางกลุ่มลด 10% พร้อมเปิด 3 ทักษะ AI ที่นายจ้างต้องการ ย้ำมนุษย์ยังจำเป็น แต่ต้องใช้ AI ให้เป็น
title_cn: IMF 警示：全球仍需要劳动力，但必须掌握 AI 应用能力
summary_cn: 国际货币基金组织指出，AI 正在重塑亚洲劳动力市场，某些行业用人需求下降 10%。在 AI 浪潮冲击下，雇主更看重员工的三项关键技能。IMF 强调人类劳动力仍不可或缺，但工作者必须学会有效利用 AI 工具以适应市场需求。
desc_original: IMF ชี้ AI กำลังเปลี่ยนตลาดแรงงานเอเชีย ความต้องการจ้างงานบางกลุ่มลด 10% พร้อมเปิด 3 ทักษะ AI ที่นายจ้างต้องการ ย้ำมนุษย์ยังจำเป็น แต่ต้องใช้ AI ให้เป็น

title: Call for adventure tourism accountability after 2 tourists injured
desc: PHETCHABUN - Phetchabun authorities face calls to review adventure tourism safety rules and compliance after two foreigners were injured in a fall from a cliff while abseiling over the weekend.
title_cn: 碧差汶冒险旅游安全问责制遭质疑 两名游客绳降坠崖受伤
summary_cn: 碧差汶当局因两名外国游客周末绳降时从悬崖坠落受伤一事面临审查压力。相关部门被要求重新审视冒险旅游安全规则和合规要求，加强游客保护措施以防止类似事故再次发生。

title: Phuket tourist couple accused of shoplifting in Patong
desc: Phuket tourist couple accused of shoplifting in Patong Legacy Two foreign tourists have been accused of shoplifting at a convenience store in Patong, Phuket , after a Thai woman reportedly noticed them hiding merchandise inside a bag and alerted staff. The pair, described as a couple, have also been linked through social media allegations to a separate theft at a clothing shop in Rawai, where trousers worth 1,595 baht were reportedly taken. The allegations were shared on The Phuket Times Facebook page, which published an account from a Thai woman who claimed she witnessed suspicious behaviour while shopping at a convenience store in Patong. According to the woman, she noticed the tourists placing several products inside a bag while browsing the store. She discreetly alerted an employee as the pair approached the checkout counter. When staff questioned them about the merchandise, both tourists allegedly denied taking anything. However, the woman claimed that a subsequent search uncovered unpaid products concealed inside their bag. Phuket Times subsequently published another theft allegation involving two tourists believed to be the same couple, this time at a clothing shop in Rawai.

title: Jealous Loei man accused of torching car while partner at funeral
desc: Jealous Loei man accused of torching car while partner at funeral Legacy A Thai man was arrested in Loei province after allegedly setting fire to his partner’s stepfather’s car and threatening to kill her family when he returned home to find her and their baby absent while she was attending a funeral. According to Amarin TV, the incident occurred on October 10 in Phu Kradueng district. His partner, a 16 year old girl, sought help from the media today, October 12, fearing that he could harm her family if released on bail. The suspect, identified as 32 year old Saksit, was arrested by Phu Kradueng police following the incident. In an interview with the outlet, the teenager said she had informed Saksit that she would attend a funeral in their village, which he initially agreed to. However, when he returned from work at around 8pm and found neither her nor their baby at home, he allegedly became angry and began calling her with threats. She claimed he initially threatened to sell her stepfather’s car before deciding to set it on fire. Saksit reportedly contacted her again and told her to check Facebook, where she discovered footage of the vehicle burning. Photo via Am

title: Chinese man arrested over flight theft, 293,000 baht card fraud
desc: Chinese man arrested over flight theft, 293,000 baht card fraud Legacy Police have arrested a Chinese man at Don Mueang International Airport in Bangkok over an alleged in-flight theft operation targeting passengers’ cash and credit cards, with two victims reporting nearly 293,000 baht in unauthorised transactions . The suspect allegedly searched bags stored in overhead compartments while passengers were distracted or asleep, before the stolen cards were used for purchases linked to China shortly after the aircraft landed. Don Mueang Police Station officers, working with airport personnel, arrested a Chinese national identified as Zheng Yu Qlang under a Criminal Court warrant. The 51 year old suspect faces charges of theft at an airport and unauthorised use of another person’s electronic card. Officers seized credit cards, two mobile phones, banknotes from 12 foreign countries and more than 35,950 baht in Thai currency. desc: Thailand claims first Miss Global title with 2026 win Legacy Thailand’s Saffron Maya Snook has made history by winning the Miss Global 2026 title, becoming the first Thai contestant to claim the international beauty pageant’s top prize. The Thai-British contestant was crowned yesterday, October 11, at MCC Hall in The Mall Lifestore Ngamwongwan, Nonthaburi province, after competing against representatives from around the world. Snook secured the crown ahead of Kelly Kirstein from the United States, who finished as first runner-up, and Bianca Nicole Miranda from Puerto Rico, who placed second runner-up. Jayvee Lyn Lorejo of the Philippines finished third runner-up, while Myanmar’s Myo Ma Ma claimed fourth runner-up. Snook had qualified for the international pageant earlier this year after winning Miss Global Thailand 2026, a separate national competition held to select Thailand’s representative. title: Thai actor questions 5,050 baht airport departure tax on flight
desc: Thai actor questions 5,050 baht airport departure tax on flight Legacy A Thai actor has questioned a 5,050 baht charge labelled as an airport departure tax on a flight from Bangkok to Vientiane, Laos, raising concerns about rising travel costs and confusion over Thailand’s proposed new departure tax. However, a breakdown of the booking suggests that the amount includes several airline surcharges and airport-related fees rather than a single government tax. Thai actor Duke Phanudet Watnasuchart reportedly shared details of his December flight booking on social media on October 9, questioning why the additional charges were significantly higher than those for the same route in August. Although the original post appears to have since been removed, several Thai media outlets reported on the complaint and reproduced details of his booking. According to Thai media reports, Duke previously paid approximately 2,365 baht in combined taxes and fees. His latest booking showed a base airfare of 7,040 baht and another 5,050 baht labelled as Airport Departure Tax, bringing the total to 12,090 baht. desc: Queen Suthida to visit Japan for women’s ice hockey championship Legacy Her Majesty Queen Suthida will travel to Japan from 14 to 22 October 2026, where she will attend a women’s ice hockey championship in Sapporo, the Royal Household Bureau has announced. title: Thailand clarifies rules for opening checked bags without passengers present
desc: Thailand clarifies rules for opening checked bags without passengers present Legacy CAAT says suspicious checked bags may be opened without passengers present, with searches recorded and passengers notified afterwards. The Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand (CAAT) has clarified procedures allowing security staff to open checked baggage when screening identifies suspicious items, ahead of the measures taking effect on October 16, 2026. In a clarification reported on October 11, the regulator said additional searches may be necessary if baggage screening detects irregularities or raises security concerns. Inspections must follow established procedures and remain necessary and proportionate to the risk. CAAT’s published guidance allows staff to open a suspicious checked bag without the passenger being present. The opening must be recorded, and a notice explaining the inspection must be placed inside the bag. The authority has stressed that opening bags without advance notification is limited to cases where screening identifies suspicious objects or items that could threaten aviation security. The opening must be recorded, and a notice explaining the inspection must be placed inside the bag. The authority has stressed that opening bags without advance notification is limited to cases where screening identifies suspicious objects or items that could threaten aviation security. summary_cn: 泰国政府公务员早期退休计划已进入最后阶段，即将正式完成。泰国法律事务副总理帕空·尼普劳蓬（Pakorn Nilprapunt）透露，该计划将从 2027 财年起开始实施，目标是逐年减少公务员队伍规模 5%。通过此举优化政府人力资源结构，降低政府运营成本，提高行政效率。

desc_original: The recent discovery of overcrowding, unlicensed operations and mistreatment at care facilities in Kanchanaburi and Nonthaburi has exposed potential weaknesses in the elderly care oversight system, prompting nationwide inspections and calls for tougher enforcement.

title: Govt denies neglecting flood victims

summary_cn: 泰国学术界呼吁选举委员会（EC）解决公众对投票秘密的顾虑，在距下次参议院选举仅两年多的时间内重建信任。投票制度的透明度关乎泰国民主制度的健全性。
desc_original: Academics have called on the Election Commission (EC) to address concerns over ballot secrecy and rebuild public trust ahead of the next Senate election, due in just over two years.

title: Renewable outlays to spike via new plan
desc: The new power development plan (PDP) is expected to unlock trillions of baht in investment in renewable energy projects while creating broader opportunities for private sector participation in the electricity market, according to an energy official familiar with the plan.

title: Squabble puts 2100MHz allocation in question
desc: The expiration of the 2100-megahertz licence on Dec 6, 2027 is an urgent issue for the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) board to consider, yet it remains stuck in a deadlock over the chairman's qualifications.
title_cn: 频谱分配权纷扰延缓 NBTC 决策进程

title: 泰国九皇斋节预计吸金101亿泰铢！曼谷、普吉成旅游热门
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，2026年九皇斋节将于10月9日至18日举行，预计将带动全国旅游市场升温，吸引约132万人次出游，创造约101.4亿泰铢旅游收入。其中，曼谷和普吉预计将成为旅游收入最高的目的地。随着传统节庆活动陆续展开，斋菜消费、宗教文化体验及地方旅游活动有望进一步刺激消费，为餐饮、住宿、交通及零售等行业带来收益。 泰国国家旅游局局长塔佩妮表示，今年九皇斋节期间，全国旅游市场预计将迎来一波消费热潮。根据预测，节庆期间旅游收入有望达到101.4亿泰铢，反映出传统文化节庆对国内旅游经济的带动作用。九皇斋节不仅是民众遵循斋戒传统、参与宗教仪式的重要节日，也逐渐成为融合信仰、文化、美食与健康生活方式的旅游活动。 从地区收入来看，曼谷预计将创造约67.1亿泰铢旅游收入，位居全国首位；普吉预计创造约14.3亿泰铢。与此同时，泰国南部9个府的旅游收入预计合计达到34.3亿泰铢，显示九皇斋节对南部地区旅游经济同样具有重要的推动作用。 曼谷唐人街耀华力路预计将继续成为节日期间的热门区域。每逢九皇斋节，当地都会出现大量斋菜摊位及特色饮食，吸引民众和游客前往品尝。除了传统斋菜，游客还可以体验当地华人社区延续多年的节庆习俗，感受宗教信仰与地方文化相结合的独特氛围。 普吉则是泰国九皇斋节另一处重要目的地。当地拥有历史悠久且独具特色的九皇斋节传统，节日期间通常会举行宗教仪式及相关文化活动，吸引信众和游客参与。对于游客而言，这不仅是体验斋戒饮食的机会，也能进一步了解当地华人社群的历史、文化与信仰传统。 在旅游推广方面，泰国旅游局将继续贯彻“重价值、轻数量”的发展策略，重点从信仰、文化、健康及生活方式四个维度提升旅游体验。通过将传统节庆与地方文化、特色美食及健康生活理念相结合，泰国希望进一步提高节庆旅游的吸引力，并带动游客在目的地的消费。 此外，额外公共假期及国内旅游刺激措施也被视为推动今年节庆旅游市场的重要利好因素。这些因素有望鼓励民众增加国内出游安排，进一步带动住宿、餐饮、交通及其他旅游相关行业的消费，为地方商家创造更多商机。 不过，泰国国家旅游局也提醒，部分地区可能面临强降雨及洪水风险，天气状况仍可能影响节庆期间的旅游活动及游客出行安排。民众和游客应提前关注天气预报及相关部门发布的预警信息，合理规划行程，确保出行安全。 总体而言，泰国国家旅游局看好2026年九皇斋节对国内旅游市场的带动作用，预计节庆期间将创造约101.4亿泰铢旅游收入。随着传统信仰活动与文化、美食及健康旅游体验进一步融合，九皇斋节有望继续成为推动泰国节庆旅游发展、促进地方经济增长的重要活动。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：posttoday） The post 泰国九皇斋节预计吸金101亿泰铢！曼谷、普吉成旅游热门 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 泰国九皇斋节预计吸金101亿泰铢 曼谷普吉成旅游热点
summary_cn: 泰国2026年九皇斋节（10月9-18日）预计吸引132万人次游客，创造101.4亿泰铢旅游收入。其中曼谷预计收入67.1亿泰铢居全国首位，普吉14.3亿泰铢次之。唐人街耀华力路及普吉传统斋节文化活动成为主要吸引点。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，2026年九皇斋节将于10月9日至18日举行，预计将带动全国旅游市场升温，吸引约132万人次出游，创造约101.4亿泰铢旅游收入。其中，曼谷和普吉预计将成为旅游收入最高的目的地。随着传统节庆活动陆续展开，斋菜消费、宗教文化体验及地方旅游活动有望进一步刺激消费，为餐饮、住宿、交通及零售等行业带来收益。 泰国国家旅游局局长塔佩妮表示，今年九皇斋节期间，全国旅游市场预计将迎来一波消费热潮。根据预测，节庆期间旅游收入有望达到101.4亿泰铢，反映出传统文化节庆对国内旅游经济的带动作用。九皇斋节不仅是民众遵循斋戒传统、参与宗教仪式的重要节日，也逐渐成为融合信仰、文化、美食与健康生活方式的旅游活动。 从地区收入来看，曼谷预计将创造约67.1亿泰铢旅游收入，位居全国首位；普吉预计创造约14.3亿泰铢。与此同时，泰国南部9个府的旅游收入预计合计达到34.3亿泰铢，显示九皇斋节对南部地区旅游经济同样具有重要的推动作用。 曼谷唐人街耀华力路预计将继续成为节日期间的热门区域。每逢九皇斋节，当地都会出现大量斋菜摊位及特色饮食，吸引民众和游客前往品尝。除了传统斋菜，游客还可以体验当地华人社区延续多年的节庆习俗，感受宗教信仰与地方文化相结合的独特氛围。 普吉则是泰国九皇斋节另一处重要目的地。当地拥有历史悠久且独具特色的九皇斋节传统，节日期间通常会举行宗教仪式及相关文化活动，吸引信众和游客参与。对于游客而言，这不仅是体验斋戒饮食的机会，也能进一步了解当地华人社群的历史、文化与信仰传统。 在旅游推广方面，泰国旅游局将继续贯彻“重价值、轻数量”的发展策略，重点从信仰、文化、健康及生活方式四个维度提升旅游体验。通过将传统节庆与地方文化、特色美食及健康生活理念相结合，泰国希望进一步提高节庆旅游的吸引力，并带动游客在目的地的消费。 此外，额外公共假期及国内旅游刺激措施也被视为推动今年节庆旅游市场的重要利好因素。这些因素有望鼓励民众增加国内出游安排，进一步带动住宿、餐饮、交通及其他旅游相关行业的消费，为地方商家创造更多商机。 不过，泰国国家旅游局也提醒，部分地区可能面临强降雨及洪水风险，天气状况仍可能影响节庆期间的旅游活动及游客出行安排。民众和游客应提前关注天气预报及相关部门发布的预警信息，合理规划行程，确保出行安全。 总体而言，泰国国家旅游局看好2026年九皇斋节对国内旅游市场的带动作用，预计节庆期间将创造约101.4亿泰铢旅游收入。随着传统信仰活动与文化、美食及健康旅游体验进一步融合，九皇斋节有望继续成为推动泰国节庆旅游发展、促进地方经济增长的重要活动。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：posttoday） The post 泰国九皇斋节预计吸金101亿泰铢！曼谷、普吉成旅游热门 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 泰国假招聘骗局曝光！3名中国人遭绑架运往边境
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，10月10日，泰国中央调查局下属犯罪镇压部门联合达府当地警局在达府Phop Phra县一处民宅前逮捕30岁泰国籍男子Su，其涉嫌参与非法拘禁及未经许可经营非定期客运业务。涉案团伙疑以提供工作为诱饵，诱骗3名中国籍男子入境泰国，随后将其运往达府边境地区。目前，3名受害者已获救，被捕男子否认相关指控。 据悉，案件始于2026年9月7日，警方在达府查获一辆黑色皮卡车，当场逮捕29岁的泰国籍男子Tho，同时解救3名中国籍男子，其被发现时双手遭到捆绑，眼睛被蒙住。 Tho供称，自己受雇于Choi和Ya，负责运送中国籍人员前往边境。其中，Ya负责驾驶车辆在前方引路。警方随后调查确认，Ya的真实身份即此次被捕的Su，警方在收集相关证据后于10月10日将其逮捕。 经调查，3名中国籍受害者原本希望在泰国寻找工作，于是通过互联网联系上一名声称能够安排在泰工作的人员。随后，3人分别于9月5日至6日乘飞机抵达泰国。对方声称将安排车辆接送他们前往清迈府和素可泰府工作，3人并未乘坐同一辆车。当他们抵达达府后，另有车辆前来接应，将他们带往一处不明地点的树林。 受害者表示，随后有人用棕色胶带缠住他们的头部及面部，捆绑双手并戴上手铐，使得他们无法辨认行进路线。之后，警方在泰缅边境附近将3人解救。 警方初步调查认为，涉案团伙疑似以提供工作机会为诱饵，诱骗中国籍人员入境泰国，再将受害者转运至达府边境地区，交由当地其他团伙接手。目前，警方仍在进一步调查案件相关细节。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：fm91bkk） The post 泰国假招聘骗局曝光！3名中国人遭绑架运往边境 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 泰国假招聘诈骗案曝光 3名中国籍男子遭绑架运往边境
summary_cn: 泰国警方破获人口贩运诈骗案。涉案团伙以工作机会为幌子诱骗3名中国籍男子入境，随后将其绑架运往达府（Tak）边界地区。警方已逮捕涉案人员并成功解救受害者。该案揭示了针对外国人的常见诈骗和人口贩运手段。

title: Thailand, Timor-Leste speed up deal for direct flights
desc: Thailand, Timor-Leste speed up deal for direct flights Legacy Thailand and Timor-Leste agreed to speed up an air services agreement that could pave the way for direct flights between Bangkok and Dili during talks in Bangkok on October 9. Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul met Timor-Leste Prime Minister Kay Rala Xanana Gusmão at Government House during Gusmão’s official visit to Thailand. It was the first official visit to Thailand by a Timor-Leste prime minister in 13 years and the first since the country became an ASEAN member last year. The two leaders discussed trade, investment, defence cooperation, online scams and other transnational crimes, as well as regional developments. On economic ties, both sides agreed to promote trade and investment , particularly in food security and rice. They also identified agriculture and food processing, energy, infrastructure, tourism and hospitality as areas for possible Thai investment in Timor-Leste. Photo via Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of Thailand The two governments also agreed to speed up the Air Services Agreement, which would pave the way for direct Bangkok-Dili flights. summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷与东帝汶总理古斯芒在曼谷进行官方会晤，这是东帝汶加入东盟后总理首次访泰。双方同意加快民航服务协议谈判，为曼谷与帝力之间建立直飞航线奠定基础。经济合作方面，两国将着重推进粮食安全、农产品加工、能源、基建、旅游和招待业等领域的投资与贸易。

title: 10月12-18日曼谷出行尽量避开这些路段！
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，10月11日，泰国总理府副发言人普洛伊表示，2026年国际货币基金组织-世界银行年会将于10月12日至18日在曼谷诗丽吉国家会议中心举行。届时，来自世界各地的各国领导人、国际金融机构负责人及会议代表将陆续抵达，相关部门将加强安保措施，根据贵宾车队通行安排对部分道路实施交通管制或调整。 政府呼吁民众提前安排出行计划，尤其是需要经过会议中心周边及曼谷市中心商业区的民众，应留意最新交通公告，在出发前确认道路封闭信息及绕行路线。 以下5个区域建议特别留意： Ratchadaphisek路 从Rama 4交叉口至Asok–Sukhumvit交叉口路段以及Benjakitti公园周边区域。 Sukhumvit路 Nana、Asok及Phrom Phong一带，该区域分布着多家酒店，也是高级别会议代表的重要住宿及通行区域。 Rama 4路 尤其是Khlong Toei地区及会议中心正门前方路段，民众应提前规划行车路线。 Benjakitti公园 公园部分区域将临时调整开放时间或暂停开放。相关部门还将根据公告设置出入口，限制汽车及自行车进入部分区域。 机场至酒店及市中心商业区的连接道路 包括素万那普国际机场和廊曼国际机场通往市中心商业区的道路以及Sukhumvit路、Rama 4路周边部分路段。为配合会议代表车队通行，相关道路可能实施特别交通管理措施。 泰国政府提醒，民众驾车出行时应预留充足时间，密切关注交通警察、曼谷市政府及相关部门发布的最新信息。由于交通管制措施可能根据会议安排及安全保障需要进行调整，建议民众出发前再次确认道路通行情况，尽量选择公共交通工具，以减少出行延误。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：thaipost） The post 10月12-18日曼谷出行尽量避开这些路段！ appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

summary_cn: 国际货币基金组织与世界银行年会将于10月12日至18日在曼谷诗丽吉国家会议中心举行。全球各国领导人、国际金融机构负责人和与会代表陆续抵达。政府加强安保措施，对拉差达菲色克路、素坤逸路、拉玛4路等主要区域实施交通管制。建议公众提前规划行程，优先乘坐公共交通，避开会议中心周边和市中心商业区。

title: Thailand orders checks on all 1,203 elderly care facilities
desc: Thailand orders checks on all 1,203 elderly care facilities Legacy Thailand has ordered inspections of all 1,203 registered elderly and dependent-care facilities nationwide following complaints of confinement and abuse at some centres. Deputy government spokesperson Ploythalay Laksameesaeng said today, October 11, that the Public Health Ministry had been instructed to strengthen oversight of facilities and ensure they operate within the conditions of their licences. Public Health Minister Pattana Promphat has ordered the Department of Health Service Support, its 12 regional centres and provincial public health offices to inspect every registered facility within two months. The inspections will focus on three areas: premises, safety and services. Facilities must provide clean and safe surroundings, suitable access and service areas for elderly people, and necessary amenities. They must also have emergency prevention and response systems, appropriate equipment and measures to protect residents. title_cn: 泰国下令检查全国1203家养老机构
summary_cn: 泰国公共卫生部下令对全国1203家注册养老和照护机构进行为期两个月的全面检查。这一决定源于多家机构因虐待和强制隔离老人引发的投诉。检查将聚焦设施环境、安全系统和服务质量三个方面。各机构必须确保提供清洁安全的居住环境、符合资质的工作人员和完善的紧急应对措施。

title: Chinese tourist jumps into water at Chiang Mai attraction
desc: Chinese tourist jumps into water at Chiang Mai attraction Legacy A 23 year old Chinese tourist was taken to hospital after jumping into a body of water at a Chiang Mai tourist attraction on the evening of Saturday, 10 October. Hang Dong Police are investigating why. Police received a report of the incident at about 7.20pm and sent patrol officers to check the scene. Rescue workers from Nong Khuai gave the man first aid before taking him to Chiang Mai Klaimor Hospital, where doctors could check his condition and safety. His condition has not been reported. No relatives were at the scene. Officers found his passport and a business card from his accommodation, and contacted the accommodation to help trace his family and inform them. Police have not given a reason for the jump and are still establishing the facts. The attraction was not named in the report. If you or someone you know is struggling with depression or thoughts of self-harm, help is available. In Thailand, the Department of Mental Health hotline is 1323 (24 hours, Thai language). title_cn: 中国游客在清迈景点跳入水中受伤
summary_cn: 一名23岁中国游客于10月10日晚在清迈一处旅游景点跳入水中。宫邦警察局接警后迅速出警，救援人员进行急救后将游客送往清迈克莱莫医院救治。警方正在调查跳水原因，已通过游客护照和住宿卡片与其家人取得联系。案发地点景点名称和游客目前状况尚未披露。

Rescue workers from Nong Khuai gave the man first aid before taking him to Chiang Mai Klaimor Hospital, where doctors could check his condition and safety. His condition has not been reported. No relatives were at the scene. Officers found his passport and a business card from his accommodation, and contacted the accommodation to help trace his family and inform them. Police have not given a reason for the jump and are still establishing the facts. The attraction was not named in the report. If you or someone you know is struggling with depression or thoughts of self-harm, help is available. In Thailand, the Department of Mental Health hotline is 1323 (24 hours, Thai language). title: Two Nigerian men arrested after cocaine found in Pattaya condo
desc: Two Nigerian men arrested after cocaine found in Pattaya condo Legacy Two Nigerian men were arrested at a condominium in Pattaya on October 9 after immigration officers found about six grammes of cocaine hidden inside a cooker hood . Chon Buri Immigration officers searched the room after receiving information that one of the men was allegedly staying in Thailand illegally and might be involved with drugs . Officers found two Nigerian men, aged 25 and 29. Immigration checks showed that one was staying in Thailand illegally, while the other had entered the country on a tourist visa . Photo via Chon Buri Immigration The room was searched for more than 20 minutes before officers found five small packages of cocaine wrapped in black tape and hidden inside the cooker hood. The drugs weighed around six grammes in total and were seized as evidence. Preliminary urine tests found traces of drugs in one of the men, while the other tested negative. During questioning, both men claimed they had obtained the cocaine from an acquaintance around Walking Street in Pattaya and had not yet paid for it. They said the cocaine was intended for their own use and denied planning to sell it. Photo via Chon
title_cn: 两名尼日利亚人在芭提雅被捕 缴获可卡因
summary_cn: 移民局在芭提雅一公寓内逮捕两名尼日利亚籍男子（年龄分别为25岁和29岁）。其中一人非法滞留泰国。警方搜查时在抽油烟机内发现并缴获约6克可卡因。两人供称从芭提雅步行街附近的熟人处获得毒品，尚未支付费用，声称仅供个人使用。尿检结果显示其中一人呈阳性，另一人呈阴性。
