title: Dental clinic warning issued
desc: The Department of Health Service Support has urged patients to verify dental clinics and practitioners before seeking treatment, following the arrest of a woman accused of running an unlicensed dental service from her home in Ayutthaya.
title_cn: 牙科诊所警告声明
summary_cn: 泰国卫生服务支持部门发出警告，要求患者就诊前核实牙科诊所和医生资格。大城府阿育他亚一名女性因经营无执照家庭牙科服务被捕，引发该提醒。患者应提高警觉，避免非正规医疗服务风险。
desc_original: The Department of Health Service Support has urged patients to verify dental clinics and practitioners before seeking treatment, following the arrest of a woman accused of running an unlicensed dental service from her home in Ayutthaya.

title: Rate worries keep Thai shares in check
desc: Thai shares retreated this week amid volatile trade in global equities prior to key central banks' policy meetings, particularly the US Federal Reserve.
title_cn: 利率担忧压低泰国股市
summary_cn: 受全球金融市场波动影响，泰国股市本周下跌。投资者关注美国联邦储备委员会（Federal Reserve）等全球主要央行即将召开的政策会议，担心利率政策调整对市场的冲击。全球股票交易保持高度波动。
desc_original: Thai shares retreated this week amid volatile trade in global equities prior to key central banks' policy meetings, particularly the US Federal Reserve.

title: Small firms eye wider stimulus scheme
desc: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) have called on the government to expand the eligibility criteria for shops participating in the "Thais Help Thais Plus" scheme, raising the annual revenue ceiling from the current 1.8 million baht to 5 million baht.
title_cn: 中小企业争取更广泛的刺激方案
summary_cn: 泰国中小型企业呼吁政府扩大「泰人帮助泰人增强版」刺激方案的参与资格。他们要求将商家年收入门槛从现有的180万泰铢提升至500万泰铢，以惠及更多小微企业，扩大政策覆盖面。
desc_original: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) have called on the government to expand the eligibility criteria for shops participating in the "Thais Help Thais Plus" scheme, raising the annual revenue ceiling from the current 1.8 million baht to 5 million baht.

title: Bond yields escalate  funding costs for businesses
desc: Business operators face higher financing costs as bond yields rise, despite the Bank of Thailand's policy rate being the second-lowest among central banks worldwide.
title_cn: 债券收益率飙升加重企业融资负担
summary_cn: 债券收益率上升正在推高企业融资成本。尽管泰国央行的基准利率在全球央行中处于倒数第二低的水平，但企业仍面临更高的融资压力。反映了本地金融市场流动性和融资成本环境的变化。
desc_original: Business operators face higher financing costs as bond yields rise, despite the Bank of Thailand's policy rate being the second-lowest among central banks worldwide.

title: Stocks gain but oil-driven inflation still a worry
desc: RECAP: Asian stocks rose yesterday, helped by a dip in oil prices, even as investors grappled with efforts by global central ‌banks to rein in oil-driven inflation, with Japan hiking its benchmark interest rate.
title_cn: 股市回升 油价通胀隐忧犹存
summary_cn: 亚洲股市昨日上涨，受油价回落提振。但投资者仍在关注全球央行应对油价驱动通胀的举措，日本央行近日上调基准利率。油价因素对通胀的压力仍是市场的长期关切。
desc_original: RECAP: Asian stocks rose yesterday, helped by a dip in oil prices, even as investors grappled with efforts by global central ‌banks to rein in oil-driven inflation, with Japan hiking its benchmark interest rate.

title: SEC tightens net  on scam networks
desc: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is stepping up enforcement against scam networks and cross-border money laundering, with assets frozen immediately in cases where there is sufficient evidence, while complex securities cases may require more time to trace the ultimate owners of the assets.
title_cn: 泰国证券交易委员会加强打击诈骗网络
summary_cn: 泰国证券交易委员会（SEC）加大力度打击诈骗网络和跨境洗钱活动。委员会在掌握充分证据的情况下立即冻结相关资产，复杂证券案件需要更多时间追溯资产最终所有者。
desc_original: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is stepping up enforcement against scam networks and cross-border money laundering, with assets frozen immediately in cases where there is sufficient evidence, while complex securities cases may require more time to trace the ultimate owners of the assets.

title: British YouTuber reveals cost of living in Pattaya at just £600 a month
desc: British YouTuber reveals cost of living in Pattaya at just £600 a month Legacy A British YouTuber who runs a bar in Pattaya says his rent and household bills come to just over £600 (about 26,000 baht) a month, a fraction of what he would pay at home in the West Midlands. Macauley Haycock, 31, left Wolverhampton three years ago after saving for five years to fund the move. He now runs a bar in the resort city with his girlfriend and documents his life in Thailand for more than 90,000 subscribers on his YouTube channel, MacTV . Speaking to BirminghamLive , he said he had recently moved out of a condominium that cost about £360 (15,500 baht) a month and came with a gym and a 29th-floor swimming pool, into a three-bedroom house for about £580 (25,000 baht). His internet, water and electricity add roughly £25 (1,100 baht), he said. Food is his other main outlay. He said a month’s shopping had just cost him around £131 (5,600 baht), covering steak, chicken, tuna, cottage cheese, fruit and vegetables, drinks and a full set of spices. title: Elderly couple in Buri Ram die hours apart after decades together
desc: A story of enduring love between an elderly couple in Buri Ram has moved many people who read online how the pair, married for decades, died within hours of each other.
title_cn: 武里南老年夫妇相隔数小时先后离世
summary_cn: 武里南府 Buri Ram 一对婚姻长达数十年的老年夫妇以最感人的方式诠释了「白头偕老」之意。这对伉俪在相隔数小时内相继去世的故事在网络传播后引发众多网友感慨，体现了深厚的婚姻羁绊。
desc_original: A story of enduring love between an elderly couple in Buri Ram has moved many people who read online how the pair, married for decades, died within hours of each other.

title: Thailand at heart of Miss Universe turmoil
desc: Miss Universe Thailand and five of her Southeast Asian peers could be barred from competing in the Miss Universe 2026 pageant in November because of a bitter legal dispute over national franchise agreements.
title_cn: 泰国选美皇后陷环球小姐风波
summary_cn: 泰国小姐及五位东南亚选手因国家特许经营权的法律纠纷，可能被禁止参加2026年11月举办的环球小姐 Miss Universe 选美大赛。这场跨境争议引发关于国际选美赛事治理和地区代表权的热议。
desc_original: Miss Universe Thailand and five of her Southeast Asian peers could be barred from competing in the Miss Universe 2026 pageant in November because of a bitter legal dispute over national franchise agreements.

title: Fitch upgrades Thailand outlook to ‘stable’
desc: Fitch Ratings has revised Thailand’s outlook to “stable” ​from “negative”, ‌citing increased confidence that government debt will broadly stabilise over the medium term and that political conditions will improve following the general elections ​held ⁠earlier this year.
title_cn: 标普将泰国评级前景升级至「稳定」

title: 涉东南亚诈骗网络名单牵出泰国前高官！阿努廷：不顾忌谁，一切依法处理
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 美国国会众议院外交事务委员会主席布莱恩·马斯特当地时间9月15日致函美国政府，要求对28个被指与东南亚诈骗网络存在关联的个人和实体展开调查，并评估是否实施制裁。名单中包括泰国前财政部副部长瓦拉帕·坦亚翁（Vorapak Tanyawong）。泰国总理兼内政部长阿努廷当地时间9月18日12时35分在总理府接受采访时就此回应称，相关事项将依法处理。 阿努廷表示，一切都将依法处理。他强调，本届政府正在大力打击诈骗犯罪。每当外国代表来访，或泰方与各国安全机构会面、展开磋商前，对方都会向泰国政府在打击跨国科技犯罪、推动刑事追诉以及查封、没收犯罪资产等方面所做的工作表示感谢。 阿努廷指出，目前泰国警方仍在持续办理多起相关案件，并继续追查及查封涉案人员的资产。此外，泰国反洗钱办公室秘书长也曾向他汇报，目前查扣的一部分资产为股票，且相关股票市值已经上涨。有关部门正就如何依法处置这些资产与法院进行协商，包括能否将其没收并转为国有资产，或通过公开拍卖出售，从而将所得资金收归国库。 当被问及，尽管政府已经全面推进打击行动，但泰国人民党名单制议员朗西曼仍质疑总理究竟“顾忌谁”，为何没有真正严肃处理这一问题时，阿努廷笑着回应：“可以确定的是，我不顾忌谁，也不顾忌朗西曼。” 据了解，马斯特在信中分别向美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥和财政部长斯科特·贝森特提出上述请求，同时抄送美国司法部长及国土安全部长。信件要求美国政府在180天内作出评估，确认名单中的个人和实体是否符合美国相关制裁法律标准。信件称，对符合制裁条件的对象采取行动，将有助于遏制网络诈骗、人口贩运，以及为诈骗产业链提供政治和金融支持的相关活动。 瓦拉帕曾在泰国银行及金融行业担任高级管理职务，此次被列入美国要求调查并考虑制裁的东南亚诈骗网络相关名单。需要特别指出的是，被列入名单仅意味着美国国会议员要求政府展开调查并评估是否实施制裁，并不代表美国政府已经认定其实施了违法犯罪行为。 9月15日的信件共列出26名个人和2个商业实体，具体如下： Benjamin Mauerberger Chou Bun Eng，柬埔寨国家人口贩运问题委员会常务副主席 Deng Pibing Dy Vichea，柬埔寨国家警察副总监、洪森女婿 Edward Lee Eugene Tang Gabriel Tan Honn Sorachna Hun To，柬埔寨商人、洪森侄子 Kuoch Chamrouen，干丹省省长，曾任西哈努克省省长 Li Xiong Long Dimanche，西哈努克省副省长 Ma Dongli Michael Chiam Mote Thun Neth Savoeun，柬埔寨副总理、前国家警察总监 Sar Sokha，柬埔寨内政部长 Su Zhongkian Vorapak Tanyawong，泰国前银行及金融业高级管

title: American child sex offence suspect returned to Alabama after Phuket arrest
desc: American child sex offence suspect returned to Alabama after Phuket arrest Legacy American suspect Lance Michael Beck , arrested in Phuket last month over serious child sex offence allegations, has been returned to Alabama and is now being held without bail , US officials announced yesterday, September 17. Thai police arrested Beck in Phuket on August 29 after US authorities sought assistance locating him. He was detained ahead of his return to the United States, where the case has now moved into the American judicial process. Photo via abc3340 US authorities said Beck faces five charges in St. Clair County involving a child under 12: first-degree rape, first-degree sodomy, sexual torture, facilitating the travel of a child for a sexual purpose and human trafficking . Officials said that after learning Beck had fled to Thailand, US officials obtained a federal warrant for Unlawful Flight to Avoid Prosecution and coordinated with Thai law enforcement to locate him. title: Lisa’s overseas drinking segment did not breach advertising law
desc: Lisa’s overseas drinking segment did not breach advertising law Legacy Thailand’s public health minister has dismissed controversy surrounding Lisa’s appearance with a Thai alcoholic drink on an overseas television programme, saying the incident did not violate Thailand’s alcohol advertising law . Pattana Promphat said the segment was filmed and broadcast abroad, while Lisa’s actions appeared personal and showed no intention to advertise the product. “Thai law does not prohibit drinking alcohol. It prohibits alcohol advertising,” the minister explained. Lisa recently appeared on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon , where she introduced the host to som tam and a drink made with Thai beer, soju and Sprite. She also taught Fallon to say “mod kaew”, meaning “bottoms up”, before they drank together. Pattana said Thai media outlets and social media users who reshared the footage had generally blurred the brand name and logo, which he considered compliant with Thai law. However, he warned content creators to be careful when recreating the drink. desc_original: Lisa’s overseas drinking segment did not breach advertising law Legacy Thailand’s public health minister has dismissed controversy surrounding Lisa’s appearance with a Thai alcoholic drink on an overseas television programme, saying the incident did not violate Thailand’s alcohol advertising law . title: Deaf passenger praises Thai Airways crew’s clever menu
desc: Deaf passenger praises Thai Airways crew’s clever menu Legacy A deaf passenger has praised Thai Airways cabin crew after attendants reportedly drew pictures of the available meal choices to make it easier for him to order during a flight to Bangkok. Jose Irish Pascual shared the experience on Facebook, saying it was the first time he had encountered such an approach while travelling and praising the crew for finding a simple way to communicate with him. A social media post from Pascual’s account said he was travelling from Manila to Bangkok when crew members drew the meal options and placed the illustrations beside his seat, allowing him to choose without relying on spoken communication. Pascual said he initially felt slightly embarrassed by the attention but was impressed by the crew’s creativity and how easily the system allowed him, as a deaf passenger, to understand his choices. He described the approach as an example of the crew choosing to “work smart, not hard” when communicating with him. title: Choosing the right cosmetic surgery clinic in Thailand starts with your safety
desc: Choosing the right cosmetic surgery clinic in Thailand starts with your safety Legacy Choosing a cosmetic surgery clinic in Thailand can quickly become a comparison of surgeons, procedure prices and before-and-after photographs. Those things matter, but they do not necessarily tell you how seriously a clinic approaches the part that should come first: patient safety. Safety is harder to judge because much of it happens behind the scenes. It starts with the consultation and medical assessment, continues through surgical planning, anaesthesia and the operating room, then extends into the days and months after the procedure. For anyone considering cosmetic surgery in Thailand , looking at that entire journey can reveal far more than focusing on the operation alone. Safety should start with the consultation A proper cosmetic surgery consultation should involve more than telling a doctor what you would like changed and receiving a quotation. The surgeon needs enough information to understand your health, anatomy, concerns and expectations before deciding whether the procedure you originally had in mind is appropriate. title: Lopburi minimart worker wins 12 million baht then clocks in as usual
desc: Lopburi minimart worker wins 12 million baht then clocks in as usual Legacy A minimart worker in Lopburi won 12 million baht in the Thai government lottery , but decided to keep working at his regular job, saying he would use some of the winnings to build a new home . Sompong Phusakul bought two lottery tickets from his regular seller at Tha Wung Market on the morning of September 16. Both carried the first-prize number 730640, earning him a combined 12 million baht. The 46 year old said he had not yet paid for the tickets when he bought them because he and the seller knew each other well. He then went to work as usual, cutting grass at the minimart, before later discovering that his tickets had won first prize . Photo via DailyNews After returning home in Hua Samrong subdistrict, Sompong said he was so excited that he could not sleep that night. He waited until the following morning to tell his wife, who shared the news with relatives before they travelled to the Government Lottery Office to claim the prize. title: 泰国严打灰色资本，查扣资产逾200亿泰铢
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，近日，泰国政府持续加大对灰色资本、股份代持及冒用身份证等违法行为的打击力度。总理府办公室发言人艾卡蓬表示，截至目前，政府追查“Yim Leak—Ben Smith”相关犯罪网络，已查扣及冻结资产约203.92亿泰铢。 艾卡蓬表示，在总理阿努廷的指示下，政府正整合金融交易、个人、法人、股东及土地持有等信息，从涉案人员进一步追查背后的网络及资产。 泰国商业部近期加强对企业股东结构及相关金融资料的核查，涉嫌代持的高风险企业注册数量下降约70%。进一步调查发现，约2100家公司涉嫌存在代持问题，另有超过1万家公司存在可疑情况，有待进一步核查，相关资料已移交有关部门依法处理。 政府同时重点调查外国人利用代持持有土地、违法经营以及将泰国作为跨国犯罪据点等行为。艾卡蓬强调，政府依法打击违法活动的同时，也继续欢迎合法投资及依法经营的外国企业和个人。 对于“Yim Leak—Ben Smith”网络，相关部门通过追踪资金流向，已查扣及冻结资产约203.92亿泰铢。艾卡蓬表示，此次行动已从针对个人进一步延伸至金融网络及相关资产。 针对政治人物可能涉及代持或灰色资本的情况，艾卡蓬表示，无论涉案人员是否具有政治身份，只要达到调查或追究法律责任的条件，都应接受与普通民众相同的调查及司法程序。他呼吁各政党配合执法部门，不应保护或干预调查，应依据证据和法律依法处理。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：pptvhd36） The post 泰国严打灰色资本，查扣资产逾200亿泰铢 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 泰国藤球队抵日“无房可住”，滞留邮轮大厅近一天
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰国媒体报道，近日，泰国国家藤球队赴日本参加2026年爱知·名古屋亚运会，却在抵达后遭遇住宿系统故障。由于邮轮住宿系统内没有找到泰国运动员及工作人员名单，一度无法办理入住，只能在名古屋港Costa Serena邮轮大厅等待近一天，部分队员因旅途疲劳直接席地休息。 据悉，泰国国家藤球队9月16日从泰国启程前往日本，参加第20届亚洲运动会。根据东道主安排，队伍入住停靠于名古屋港的豪华邮轮Costa Serena。抵达后，邮轮工作人员却无法在系统中找到泰国代表队相关人员的住宿信息，导致队伍无法进入客房。由于问题未能及时解决，男、女藤球队员及工作人员只能携带行李滞留大厅，长时间等待工作人员协调处理。 随着等待时间接近一天，部分队员因长途飞行及持续等待感到疲惫，只能在大厅地面休息，现场一度可见大量行李及个人物品。 随后，泰国女子藤球队运动员Jutharat Pumsawawangkaew通过Facebook发文报平安，表示男、女藤球队已于当晚顺利入住，感谢相关工作人员持续协助处理住宿问题。她同时表示，队员们理解相关工作流程，也感谢各方给予关心及协助。 泰国藤球协会随后发布视频，展示国家队在Costa Serena邮轮上的住宿环境。泰国国家队运动员Sitthiphong Khamchan在视频中介绍了队员客房、邮轮内部环境以及本届亚运会相关纪念品。 2026年爱知·名古屋亚运会将于9月19日至10月4日举行。泰国国家藤球队将参加男子团体、男子单打、女子团体及女子四人赛4个项目，力争冲击4枚金牌。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：amarintv） The post 泰国藤球队抵日“无房可住”，滞留邮轮大厅近一天 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

desc: Digital Economy and Society Minister Chaichanok Chidchob has defended the TH-AI Passport programme, saying that more than 1 million people registered during its first week, while daily concurrent users exceeded 600,000 and more than 1 million AI courses and learning materials were accessed.
title_cn: 部长为泰国人工智能护照计划辩护
summary_cn: 泰国数字经济和社会部长Chaichanok Chidchob为新推出的泰国人工智能护照（TH-AI Passport）计划进行辩护。该计划首周注册用户超百万，日活并发用户超60万，超百万AI教学资源被访问，显示公众支持度高。

title: TPC mulls expanding services to Thais
desc: Thailand Privilege Card Co (TPC), the operator of long-term foreign residency programmes, is considering expanding its services to Thai customers to expand its non-visa business over the long term.
title_cn: 泰国特权卡公司考虑向泰籍客户扩展服务
summary_cn: 经营长期外国居民项目的泰国特权卡公司（TPC）正在考虑向泰国本地客户开放服务，以长期拓展其非签证类业务板块。这一举措旨在进一步挖掘国内市场潜力。
desc_original: Thailand Privilege Card Co (TPC), the operator of long-term foreign residency programmes, is considering expanding its services to Thai customers to expand its non-visa business over the long term.

title: Household debt-to-GDP ratio forecast to decline
desc: The Thai household debt-to-GDP ratio is expected to decline to 84% by the end of this year, regardless of GDP growth, according to a study by the University of the Thai Chamber of Commerce (UTCC).
title_cn: 泰国家庭债务与 GDP 比率预计继续下降
summary_cn: 泰国工商总会大学（UTCC）研究预测，泰国家庭债务与 GDP 比率将在今年底降至 84%，这一下降趋势不因 GDP 增速波动而改变。数据显示泰国家庭债务负担正逐步改善。
desc_original: The Thai household debt-to-GDP ratio is expected to decline to 84% by the end of this year, regardless of GDP growth, according to a study by the University of the Thai Chamber of Commerce (UTCC).

title: PM issues deadline for exam inquiry
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered the Interior Ministry to conclude its investigation into alleged cheating in local government recruitment examinations by Sept 30.
title_cn: 总理下令 9 月 30 日前完成地方招考舞弊调查
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷 Anutin 要求内政部在 9 月 30 日前完成对地方政府招聘考试作弊指控的调查。该调查涉及地方招考中的舞弊行为，是政府打击腐败、维护招考公正的重要行动。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered the Interior Ministry to conclude its investigation into alleged cheating in local government recruitment examinations by Sept 30.

title: Taiwan's ALP to build B10bn smart warehouse in Thailand
desc: Taiwan-based smart warehouse and logistics provider Ally Logistic Property (ALP) is investing 10 billion baht to build the "Omega 1 Bangna" smart warehouse in Thailand, its largest facility in Asia.
title_cn: 台湾 ALP 投资 100 亿泰铢在泰建设「Omega 1 邦纳」智能仓库
summary_cn: 台湾智能仓储物流商 ALP（联盟仓储地产）投资 100 亿泰铢在泰国建设「Omega 1 邦纳」智能仓库，这是该公司在亚洲规模最大的设施。
desc_original: Taiwan-based smart warehouse and logistics provider Ally Logistic Property (ALP) is investing 10 billion baht to build the "Omega 1 Bangna" smart warehouse in Thailand, its largest facility in Asia.

title: Tie-up to protect pensioners from scams
desc: The Government Pension Fund (GPF) has teamed up with technology companies to help protect elderly people from tech-enabled fraud.
title_cn: 政府养老基金携手科技企业守护老年人防范诈骗
summary_cn: 泰国政府养老基金与科技公司联手开展合作，推出保护措施帮助老年人防范科技诈骗威胁。
desc_original: The Government Pension Fund (GPF) has teamed up with technology companies to help protect elderly people from tech-enabled fraud.

title: PM distances govt  from Vorapak saga
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has distanced his government from allegations linking former deputy finance minister Vorapak Tanyawong to Southeast Asian scam networks, saying Mr Vorapak must clear his name himself.
title_cn: 总理与沃拉帕克诈骗案保持距离
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷表示政府与前副财政部长沃拉帕克涉嫌东南亚诈骗网络的指控无关，认为沃拉帕克必须自行澄清名誉。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has distanced his government from allegations linking former deputy finance minister Vorapak Tanyawong to Southeast Asian scam networks, saying Mr Vorapak must clear his name himself.

title: Fed rate hike puts spotlight on 2027 view
desc: The Federal Reserve's interest rate hike has shifted market attention to the 2027 outlook, with persistently high borrowing costs and US bond yields pressuring Thai stocks, though a less hawkish longer-term assessment could ease concerns for emerging markets, note analysts.
title_cn: 美联储加息引发 2027 年前景关注
summary_cn: 美联储加息将市场焦点转向 2027 年前景。持续高企的借贷成本和美国债券收益率对泰国股市构成压力，但分析师认为较不鹰派的长期展望可缓解新兴市场忧虑。
desc_original: The Federal Reserve's interest rate hike has shifted market attention to the 2027 outlook, with persistently high borrowing costs and US bond yields pressuring Thai stocks, though a less hawkish longer-term assessment could ease concerns for emerging markets, note analysts.

title: Central invests $3bn in Vietnam to fuel growth
desc: Central Group is investing another US$3 billion (100 billion baht) in Vietnam to expand its retail operations and property development projects.
title_cn: 中央集团斥资 30 亿美元在越南拓展业务
summary_cn: 泰国中央集团在越南追加投资 30 亿美元（约 1000 亿泰铢），用于扩大零售运营和房产开发项目。
desc_original: Central Group is investing another US$3 billion (100 billion baht) in Vietnam to expand its retail operations and property development projects.

title: New financial literacy programme focuses on Thai youth
desc: PrimeStreet Group, a Bangkok-based investment banking and management firm, has teamed up with Chulalongkorn University to launch a new financial literacy initiative aimed at strengthening the money management skills of Thailand's younger generation.
title_cn: 新金融素养计划聚焦泰国青年
summary_cn: PrimeStreet Group 曼谷投资银行公司携手朱拉隆功大学 Chulalongkorn University 推出金融素养倡议，旨在加强泰国年轻一代的理财管理能力，涵盖投资、储蓄、风险管理等实用知识教学。
desc_original: PrimeStreet Group, a Bangkok-based investment banking and management firm, has teamed up with Chulalongkorn University to launch a new financial literacy initiative aimed at strengthening the money management skills of Thailand's younger generation.

title: Maritime talks start on 'positive' note: govt
desc: The first meeting in a compulsory conciliation process between Thailand and Cambodia over their maritime dispute was positive overall, with the process expected to take 11-12 months, according to a senior Foreign Ministry official.
title_cn: 泰柬海事谈判开局「积极」——政府宣称
summary_cn: 泰国与柬埔寨就海上争议进行首轮强制调解，外交部高官表示进展「积极」，预计整个调解过程需时11-12个月。这一争议涉及两国领土边界划分与海洋权益，是长期悬而未决的外交难题。
desc_original: The first meeting in a compulsory conciliation process between Thailand and Cambodia over their maritime dispute was positive overall, with the process expected to take 11-12 months, according to a senior Foreign Ministry official.

title: Queen Mother's cremation plans advance
desc: The government is preparing for the royal cremation ceremony for Her Majesty Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother scheduled for mid-December.
title_cn: 王太后火化仪式筹备工作推进
summary_cn: 泰国政府正为王太后诗丽吉陛下 Queen Sirikit 的皇家火化仪式做筹备工作，仪式定于12月中旬举行。该庆典规模宏大，将涉及广泛人员聚集、交通管制与公共活动安排。
desc_original: The government is preparing for the royal cremation ceremony for Her Majesty Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother scheduled for mid-December.

title: THAI launches Da Nang route
desc: Thai Airways International (THAI) will expand its network with a new Bangkok-Da Nang service and more flights on routes across Southeast Asia, Europe and China.
title_cn: 泰航开通岘港新航线
summary_cn: 泰国国际航空公司 Thai Airways International (THAI) 宣布扩展航网，新增曼谷至越南岘港 Da Nang 的直航服务，并增加东南亚、欧洲及中国等多条国际航线班次。此举便利区域商务与旅游往来。
desc_original: Thai Airways International (THAI) will expand its network with a new Bangkok-Da Nang service and more flights on routes across Southeast Asia, Europe and China.

title: Travel plan exposes 'double life'
desc: A visa application to visit China has exposed the identity of a Chinese murder suspect who had lived and conducted business in Pattaya for decades.
title_cn: 赴华签证申请揭露通缉逃犯「双重身份」
summary_cn: 一名中国通缉逃犯的赴华签证申请曝光了其真实身份。此人在芭提雅 Pattaya 长期居住经商，涉嫌多年前谋杀案。案件引发跨国刑事合作，提醒在泰外国人及当地商人警惕隐藏身份的逃犯。
desc_original: A visa application to visit China has exposed the identity of a Chinese murder suspect who had lived and conducted business in Pattaya for decades.

title: CPN bags award for festive campaign
desc: Central Pattana Plc (CPN) received an award in the community category at the 2026 ICSC Global Maxi Awards for its "The World's Great Celebration – Local Pride Christmas Trees" campaign.
title_cn: 中央零售广场圣诞营销活动获国际大奖
summary_cn: 中央零售广场（CPN）凭「世界伟大庆典——本地骄傲圣诞树」营销活动在2026年国际购物中心协会全球大奖中获得社区类奖项。该活动将国际庆典与本地文化特色相结合，获得国际认可。
desc_original: Central Pattana Plc (CPN) received an award in the community category at the 2026 ICSC Global Maxi Awards for its "The World's Great Celebration – Local Pride Christmas Trees" campaign.

title: Monetary policy ‘very accommodative’; growth outlook unchanged: central bank
desc: The Bank of Thailand's (BoT) monetary policy is "very, very accommodative" right now to support a weak economy, with growth expected to exceed 3% in the current quarter and hit around 2% in the last quarter of 2026, an assistant governor said on Thursday.
title_cn: 泰央行维持宽松货币政策 第三季度增速预期超3%
summary_cn: 泰国央行副行长表示，央行目前维持「非常宽松」的货币政策以支撑疲弱经济。预期当季经济增速将超过3%，四季度增速约2%。货币政策放宽旨在刺激经济增长，应对当前经济压力，将直接影响物价和汇率。
desc_original: The Bank of Thailand's (BoT) monetary policy is "very, very accommodative" right now to support a weak economy, with growth expected to exceed 3% in the current quarter and hit around 2% in the last quarter of 2026, an assistant governor said on Thursday.

desc: จากดราม่าโค้ชหนุ่มด้อยค่าผู้หญิงวัย 35 ตั้งคำถาม “ผู้หญิงมีค่าอะไร?” เปิดหลักฐานจากสิ่งประดิษฐ์สู่ธุรกิจไทย ตัวเลขเศรษฐกิจจริงที่ผู้หญิงแบกไว้ และแนวคิด "อำนาจอธิปไตยในการเลือกชีวิต"
title_cn: 年龄35岁和性别被用作价值衡量 经济数据揭示女性真实贡献
summary_cn: 泰国教练对35岁女性的贬低言论引发讨论。文章通过经济数据揭示女性在泰国社会中的真实价值：从创新发明到商业运营，女性为国家经济做出巨大贡献。论述深入探讨「自主选择人生」的核心权利，反驳性别年龄刻板印象。
desc_original: จากดราม่าโค้ชหนุ่มด้อยค่าผู้หญิงวัย 35 ตั้งคำถาม “ผู้หญิงมีค่าอะไร?” เปิดหลักฐานจากสิ่งประดิษฐ์สู่ธุรกิจไทย ตัวเลขเศรษฐกิจจริงที่ผู้หญิงแบกไว้ และแนวคิด "อำนาจอธิปไตยในการเลือกชีวิต"

title: Yaya、Gulf、Kao首次同台飙戏 《谎日》10月6日上线
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 9月17日，据泰媒报道，备受期待的泰剧《谎日》（Beneath the Lies）即将与观众见面。这部由泰国第3电视台推出的剧集由Yaya Urassaya、Gulf Kanawut和Kao Noppakao联袂出演，并于9月16日发布了预告片。 《谎日》是一部爱情剧情类电视剧，讲述错综复杂的情感关系，以及伴随其中的谎言，同时贯穿代际延续的仇恨，这使三个年轻人的感情面临重重考验，并进一步探讨“爱情应该属于两个人，而不是三个人”这一主题。 该剧由Maker K制作，最早于2025年11月举行的“Ch3有什么新作品”阵容发布会上首次公布，除了剧情充满张力之外，其卡司阵容也在社交媒体上引发了广泛关注，其中，两位男演员此前曾凭借电视剧《名门绅士2：淑女之心》及系列作品为观众所熟悉，三人将在本剧中展现全新的化学反应。 《谎日》将于10月6日起每周一、周二20时30分通过泰国第3电视台播出。 （编译：hansa；审核：wan；来源：TheStandardPOP） The post Yaya、Gulf、Kao首次同台飙戏 《谎日》10月6日上线 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

summary_cn: 美联储宣布加息0.25%，联邦基金利率升至3.75%-4.00%，系2023年7月以来首次加息。此举将对全球股市、汇率和黄金价格产生重要影响。市场预期美联储可能在9月16日后继续上调利率，对包括泰国在内的新兴市场造成汇兑压力。

title: Carabao brushes off jibe over 1m baht Nene Royal support
desc: Carabao brushes off jibe over 1m baht Nene Royal support Legacy Thai rock veteran Add Carabao has brushed off online criticism accusing him of riding Nene Royal’s popularity after pledging 1 million baht to help the teenage Phuket guitarist travel to the United States for the America’s Got Talent final . The Carabao frontman addressed the backlash at the Concert for Guitarking Lam Morrison 2026 at Tawandang German Brewery yesterday, September 16. He admitted that one online remark accusing him of using Nene’s fame and suggesting he was too old to be doing so had irritated him enough to swear on stage earlier in the evening. Asked later whether the comment still bothered him, Add dismissed it. “Forget it. It’s passed. Enough about that.” Nene Royal, whose full name is Rattikarn “Praew” Amloy, is a 16 year old singer and guitarist from Phuket. She secured a place in the America’s Got Talent Season 21 final after judge Mel B awarded her the Live Golden Buzzer for her performance of Soundgarden’s Black Hole Sun . She is due to compete in the final on September 22, US time, corresponding to September 23 in Thailand, for the programme’s advertised US$1 million top prize. Nene Royal at AG

title: Thai Airways expands winter schedule with 66 global routes
desc: Thai Airways expands winter schedule with 66 global routes Legacy Thai Airways will operate 66 routes worldwide during its 2026/27 winter schedule, adding a new Bangkok-Danang service and increasing frequencies on selected regional routes. The winter timetable will run from October 25, 2026, to March 27, 2027, Thai Airways executives said today, September 17. The airline will launch its new Bangkok-Danang route on December 1, with 14 return flights per week. Thai Airways will also increase Bangkok-Vientiane and Bangkok-Yangon services to 21 flights per week, while Bangkok-Siem Reap will operate seven times weekly. In Europe, the airline will operate seven weekly flights to Amsterdam, 10 to Munich, 11 to Zurich and 14 to Paris. The Bangkok-Xiamen route will also return with four flights per week. Photo via Bornil Amin on Unsplash Thai Airways said it has adjusted its business strategy to remain flexible amid global uncertainty while maintaining financial stability. The company reported a net profit of 1.537 billion baht in the second quarter. Thai Airways is also expanding and simplifying its fleet, with plans to eventually reduce the number of aircraft types in operation to four. A
title_cn: 泰国航空冬季航班扩大规模 新增66条全球航线
summary_cn: 泰国航空公司宣布2026/27年冬季时刻表(10月25日至3月27日)将运营66条国际航线。新增曼谷-岘港(Danang)直航，12月1日启动每周14班；同时增加曼谷-万象(Vientiane)、曼谷-仰光(Yangon)班次至每周21班。欧洲航线维持阿姆斯特丹每周7班、慕尼黑10班、苏黎世11班、巴黎14班。此举旨在应对全球不确定性同时保持财务稳定，公司二季度净利润达15.37亿泰铢。

title: LISA brings som tam and ‘mot kaew’ to Jimmy Fallon
desc: LISA brings som tam and ‘mot kaew’ to Jimmy Fallon Legacy Thai superstar LISA gave American late-night television a taste of home , sharing som tam with Jimmy Fallon before introducing him to a Thai-style drink and teaching him the phrase “mot kaew” during The Tonight Show. The playful food segment came during LISA’s September 16 appearance in the United States, where she was promoting her new single SaWaDiKa , upcoming EP PRESS PLAY and documentary Always Lalisa . LISA first brought out som tam, a dish she named as one of her favourite Thai foods. She walked Fallon through some of the ingredients, showing him trying dried shrimp and fresh chilli before moving on to the finished dish. title: 夺金200万泰铢，赛后7天内发放！泰国公布亚运会奖金标准
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 泰国国家体育局局长贡萨近日表示，泰国已为参加第20届亚洲运动会“爱知·名古屋2026”的国家队运动员做好各项保障及奖金准备。比赛结束后，国家体育局将按照国家体育发展基金相关标准，在7天内举行奖金颁发活动。 第20届亚洲运动会将于9月19日至10月4日在日本爱知县名古屋举行。目前，部分泰国运动员已提前抵达日本参加比赛及训练，其余运动员则继续在国内训练，并将按照赛程陆续出发。 贡萨表示，此前国家体育局已为运动员提供全面保障，包括训练津贴、体育科学、营养以及心理方面的支持，确保运动员以最佳状态参赛。在经费方面，目前不存在任何问题，包括比赛奖金在内，国家体育局已与国家体育发展基金完成相关准备。 他鼓励泰国运动员在比赛中全力以赴，无需担心后勤及奖金问题。比赛结束后，相关奖金将按照国家体育发展基金的规定，在7天内完成发放。 根据国家体育发展基金针对亚运会制定的奖金标准，泰国运动员获得金牌可获得200万泰铢，银牌100万泰铢，铜牌50万泰铢。 教练员奖金则根据运动员人数及项目类型计算。其中，个人项目或运动员人数不超过6人的团队项目，教练员可获得运动员奖金的20%，即金牌40万泰铢、银牌20万泰铢、铜牌10万泰铢。 对于运动员人数达到7人及以上的团队项目，教练员可获得运动员奖金的10%，即金牌20万泰铢、银牌10万泰铢、铜牌5万泰铢。 此外，代表相关运动项目的泰国体育协会，可获得运动员所获奖金总额的30%，但最高金额不超过1000万泰铢。 （编译：Wan；来源：dailynews） The post 夺金200万泰铢，赛后7天内发放！泰国公布亚运会奖金标准 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 赛后7天内发放！泰国公布2026亚运会奖金标准
summary_cn: 第20届亚洲运动会将于9月19日至10月4日在日本爱知县名古屋(Aichi/Nagoya)举行。泰国国家体育局宣布奖金标准：金牌200万泰铢、银牌100万泰铢、铜牌50万泰铢，赛后7天内发放。教练员奖金按运动员人数计算，个人项目教练员获运动员奖金的20%，7人以上团队项目获10%。相关体育协会可获运动员奖金总额的30%，最高不超过1000万泰铢。

title_cn: 泰国发展委员会示警：财政领域陷入危机 债务达GDP六成七
summary_cn: 泰国国家经济与社会发展委员会(NESDB)发出严重警告，泰国财政领域风险极高，仅余3-4%缓冲空间。国家债务已达GDP的67.5%，政府收入下降至15%。委员会建议在2026年中期调整中央预算支出，以保持国家信用评级。这反映出泰国经济面临严峻的结构性挑战，需要立即采取财政改革措施。

title: 曼谷拉玛三路输油管道渗漏！VOC超标，专家警告仍有着火风险
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 泰国能源部、污染控制厅及输油管道公司代表日前前往曼谷拉玛三路高架桥下方的Chuea Phloeng路一带，对输油管道油料渗漏情况展开现场检查，并加紧寻找确切泄漏点，以便进行维修，同时检查管道系统的安全状况。 泰国能源部长秘书蒂提帕表示，目前输油管道公司工程师、技术人员及相关私营石油企业工作人员，正在将设备运至现场，准备移开此前在疑似渗漏区域安装的“Sleeve”（管道外套/保护套），以检查内部输油管道是否存在裂缝，以及具体受损位置。 预计今晚将能够确认明确的泄漏点。如果发现管道破损，工作人员将立即进行维修，并开展管道清管检测，对整条输油管线进行全面检查。这条管线全长约32公里，从私人油库一直延伸至机场油库，旨在进一步排查其他可能存在的风险点或异常情况。 至于此次油料渗漏的具体原因，目前仍在调查中。初步认为可能涉及多种因素，包括管道锈蚀，以及车辆长期通行产生的撞击或震动等。 如果检查确认管道已经受损，相关方面将考虑更换新管道，并研究调整管道铺设路线。由于目前管道位置靠近桥墩，且每天24小时都有车辆通行，长期震动可能导致管道再次受损。 与此同时，泰国能源业务厅已要求该输油管道公司提供管道维护和保养记录，以调查是否存在维护不足的情况，同时检查现有管道铺设路线是否依法取得许可。如果发现违规或异常情况，将依法处理。不过，目前初步检查显示，该管道仍属于获得批准的输油管道系统。 蒂提帕进一步透露，此前工作人员发现桥墩下方存在油迹后，曾开挖地面，对约200米范围进行检查并开展测试，但当时尚未发现明确的泄漏点。因此，工作人员分段封堵排水管道，以防止油料进一步造成污染。 随后，曼谷排水部门对相关管道进行清理时，发现土壤中存在油料污染，于是进一步扩大检查范围，对桥墩附近区域进行排查，并发现了新的油料渗漏点。工作人员随后再次进行检测并发现异常，最终进一步对该区域的输油管道展开详细检查。 另一方面，泰国污染控制厅环境学专家苏梅公布了现场污染监测结果。 他表示，自事故发生以来，工作人员一直持续监测现场的VOC（挥发性有机化合物）浓度，以及用于评估着火风险的LEL（爆炸下限）指标。 初步监测发现，现场VOC浓度较高，数值超过300，已经达到可能对人体健康造成影响的水平。同时，LEL指标显示现场仍存在着火风险。 不过，在工作人员将泄漏的油料重新抽回管道系统后，VOC和LEL数值均呈现下降趋势。 尽管如此，工作人员仍需要持续进行监测。目前作业区域仍必须严格采取火花控制措施，因为现场依然存在着火风险。 苏梅表示，相较于泄漏发生的核心区域，周边居民受到的影响可能相对较小。 目前，相关公司已经在作业区域安装化学蒸气抽吸设备，用于过滤现场VOC。通过从污染源头直接控制和处理挥发性物质，可以减少这些物质向周边区域扩散。 （编译：Wan；来源：pptvhd36） The post 曼谷
title_cn: 曼谷输油管道发生渗漏 VOC超标 专家警告仍存着火风险
summary_cn: 曼谷拉玛三路(Rama III Road)高架桥下的输油管道发生油料渗漏，引发环保与安全隐患。泰国能源部门紧急赶赴现场检查，初步发现VOC(挥发性有机化合物)浓度超过300，已危害人体健康，LEL(爆炸下限)数据显示仍存着火风险。工程师正在确认泄漏点并考虑管道更换。该管道长约32公里，从私人油库连接至机场油库。污染控制厅已安装化学蒸气吸收设备进行处理，周边须严格防火措施。

title: Phuket inquiry ordered into alleged checkpoint extortion
desc: Phuket inquiry ordered into alleged checkpoint extortion Legacy A Phuket extortion probe has been ordered into allegations that officials at a late-night drug checkpoint in Thalang demanded cash from detainees in exchange for their release. Deputy Interior Minister Worasit Liangprasit instructed the Department of Provincial Administration (DOPA) and Phuket officials to urgently establish what happened, identify those involved and examine evidence relating to the allegations. Phuket Governor Chotinarin Kerdsom was also ordered to report progress to the Interior Ministry. The investigation follows reports that emerged yesterday, September 16, concerning the conduct of a team operating a drug-testing checkpoint in Thalang district. Thalang district has already begun reviewing the allegations circulated online and has been instructed to prepare a factual report. A fact-finding committee was also established, with its findings due to be submitted to the provincial administration today, September 17. title_cn: 普吉岛药物检查站敲诈事件启动调查
summary_cn: 普吉岛塘林区（Thalang）一处药物检查站涉嫌强迫被拘留人员支付现金以换取释放。内政副部长沃拉西特已指示地方行政部门和普吉岛官员紧急查证此事，调查官员是否存在敲诈行为。普吉岛省长被要求向内政部汇报调查进展。事实查证委员会已成立，将在最短时间内提交调查结果。

title: Half of Thais carry debt from age 30 into retirement, expert says
desc: Half of Thais carry debt from age 30 into retirement, expert says Legacy Thai household debt could climb to 16.5–16.6 trillion baht by the end of 2026, with around half of Thais taking on debt from the age of 30 and many continuing to carry it into retirement . Associate Professor Dr Thanavath Phonvichai, president of the University of the Thai Chamber of Commerce (UTCC), said today, September 17, that household debt had become a structural problem requiring urgent attention. Bank of Thailand data cited by Thanavath showed that around half of Thais begin carrying debt by the age of 30. By the age of 70, average outstanding debt remains close to 300,000 baht. Only a small proportion of people are also able to save according to plan for retirement, he said. Photo via UTCC Today Financial pressure has been particularly severe this year among households earning less than 30,000 baht per month. Many are living from month to month, with income failing to cover living costs and forcing families to borrow more for everyday expenses or to keep household finances afloat. Borrowing through formal channels has increasingly been used to support household cash flow, particularly through savings
title_cn: 泰国家庭债务危机：近半居民30岁起背债至退休
summary_cn: 泰国家庭债务问题日趋严重。泰国商会大学副教授塔纳瓦估计，2026年底家庭债务总额将达16.5-16.6万亿泰铢。约半数泰国人从30岁开始背债，到70岁平均仍欠30万泰铢，仅少数人能按计划存钱养老。月收入低于3万泰铢的家庭尤其困难，入不敷出，被迫通过贷款维持日常生活。

title: Kao launches school hygiene programme with CONNEXT ED in Chonburi
desc: Kao launches school hygiene programme with CONNEXT ED in Chonburi Legacy Kao Industrial (Thailand) Co., Ltd., a Japanese manufacturer of consumer products and chemicals, has launched the Kao Care & Protect School Program , its first initiative dedicated to supporting healthier school environments. Developed in partnership with the CONNEXT ED Foundation, the programme supports hygiene and environmental education while helping schools create clean and safe surroundings where children can learn and grow. The initiative forms part of Kao’s ESG strategy, the Kirei Lifestyle Plan. In its first year, the programme is being piloted at three schools near Kao’s manufacturing plant in Chonburi province: Phutthayakhom Kindergarten School (Wat Khao Bang Sai), Choomchon Wat Nong Tamlung, and Chonkanyanukoon School. Activities are tailored to the needs and circumstances of each school, allowing hygiene education to move beyond the classroom and become part of students’ daily routines. Over time, the programme aims to help good hygiene take root as a lasting culture within each school. summary_cn: 日本消费品企业花王与CONNEXT ED基金会合作，在春武里省（Chonburi）推出「关怀与保护学校项目」。该计划在3所当地学校试点，包括普提雅科姆幼儿园、农农通隆寺公社学校和尖甘努昆学校，通过卫生和环保教育，为儿童打造健康安全的学习环境，让良好卫生习惯融入学生日常生活。

title: Thailand maps 11 expressway projects worth nearly 300bn baht
desc: Thailand maps 11 expressway projects worth nearly 300bn baht Legacy The Expressway Authority of Thailand (EXAT) is advancing 11 expressway projects worth more than 296.6 billion baht across Bangkok, surrounding provinces and major tourist destinations including Phuket , Koh Samui and Koh Chang. Some routes are already under construction, while others remain at approval or feasibility-study stages, with several new projects expected to begin construction from 2027. EXAT Governor Surachet Laophulsuk said the authority is drawing up a new enterprise plan as travel patterns continue to differ from before the Covid-19 pandemic. Average traffic on the expressway network is around 1.7 million vehicles per day, below the previous level of about 1.9 million, while annual profit is currently around 8 to 10 billion baht. Two of the 11 projects are already under construction. The 18.7-kilometre Rama III-Daokanong-Western Outer Ring Road Expressway, costing 31.244 billion baht, was 95.98% complete as of August and is expected to begin trial operations on the section connecting Rama II Road with the M82 motorway this year before fully opening in 2027. desc: ‘They should go die back home, not here’: Anutin warns offenders Legacy Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has delivered a blunt warning to foreigners who break Thai law or exploit Thai people, saying those who do not respect the country should leave . Speaking at the Interior Ministry at around 8.30am today, September 17, Anutin said foreigners who make an honest living in Thailand and do not exploit Thai people are welcome to stay, but those who act aggressively, threaten or intimidate others should face full enforcement. He specifically referred to Phuket and Surat Thani, along with other provinces facing similar issues, and told governors to use their legal powers fully. Anutin also addressed religious sites and a recent request to establish a private cemetery . “You cannot simply set up a religious site on your own. Whatever form it takes, it must respect Thai society and culture. I have recently heard that there is also a request to build a private cemetery. That is going too far. “They are already fortunate to be allowed to come here. If they come, they should make an honest living. “If they are going to die, they should go die back home, not here. summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷对外国人发出严厉警告：来泰合法谋生、尊重泰国法律和文化者欢迎长期居留，但违反法律、剥削泰国人或威胁他人的必须离开。他特别指名普吉岛、素叻他尼等地存在的问题，要求省长充分行使法律权力。阿努廷还强调不能私自建立宗教场所或墓园，来泰者必须遵守现有法规。

title_cn: 泰政府11个月在线进口商品税收突破40亿泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国政府公布在线进口商品税收成果，11个月征税突破40亿泰铢，旨在缩小外国在线商店的税收优势。同时加强审查力度，防止商家虚假冒充「泰国制造」身份，有效保护本地商家权益，维护公平的市场竞争环境。

desc: “นพ.สรณ” แถลงหลังประชุมบอร์ด กสทช.ล่มครั้งที่ 11 ขอสื่อสืบหาผู้ได้ประโยชน์จากการเร่งพ้นตำแหน่ง ประกาศเดินหน้าคดี ศาลนัดไต่สวน 21 ก.ย.นี้ ด้าน “พิรงรอง” ย้อนถามทำไมลุกจากเก้าอี้ไม่ได้
title_cn: 索龙要求调查是谁欲赶出广播电视委员会董事 评议会陷入风波
summary_cn: 泰国国家广播和电信委员会（NBTC）第11次董事会会议陷入争议。委员索龙表示要求媒体调查谁从推动赶出董事会成员中获利，宣布将继续推进相关诉讼，定于9月21日在法庭进行调查。另一委员皮蓝荣反驳为何不能主动辞职。
desc_original: “นพ.สรณ” แถลงหลังประชุมบอร์ด กสทช.ล่มครั้งที่ 11 ขอสื่อสืบหาผู้ได้ประโยชน์จากการเร่งพ้นตำแหน่ง ประกาศเดินหน้าคดี ศาลนัดไต่สวน 21 ก.ย.นี้ ด้าน “พิรงรอง” ย้อนถามทำไมลุกจากเก้าอี้ไม่ได้

title: เคาะค่าโดยสารรถไฟฟ้าตั๋วร่วมไม่เกิน 45 บาท ดีเดย์ 1 ม.ค.70
desc: “พิพัฒน์” ยืนยัน 1 ม.ค.70 ค่าโดยสารรถไฟฟ้า 17–45 บาททุกสีทุกสาย พร้อมจ่อของบกลาง 5 พันล้านบาท อุดหนุนส่วนต่าง ให้กรุงไทยเป็น Clearing House เจรจา BTS ปรับ Rabbit เป็น EMV ใช้ใบเดียวข้ามสาย
title_cn: 地铁票价统一不超45泰铢 明年1月1日开始实施
summary_cn: 泰国政府确认自明年1月1日起，全国地铁票价统一调整为17至45泰铢，覆盖所有线路。中央政府拨款5000万泰铢作为补贴，由泰国银行作为清算中心。同时推进BTS修改Rabbit卡系统为EMV标准，实现单票跨线乘坐。
desc_original: “พิพัฒน์” ยืนยัน 1 ม.ค.70 ค่าโดยสารรถไฟฟ้า 17–45 บาททุกสีทุกสาย พร้อมจ่อของบกลาง 5 พันล้านบาท อุดหนุนส่วนต่าง ให้กรุงไทยเป็น Clearing House เจรจา BTS ปรับ Rabbit เป็น EMV ใช้ใบเดียวข้ามสาย

title: New AI platform to enhance government services nationwide
desc: The National Electronics and Computer Technology Center (Nectec) is upgrading its locally developed Pathumma large language model (LLM) into Pathumma Connect, an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) platform designed to move government services beyond answering questions to completing tasks for citizens.
title_cn: 新型AI平台增强全国政府服务
summary_cn: 泰国国家电子计算机技术中心（Nectec）将本土开发的大型语言模型Pathumma升级为Pathumma Connect，这是一个具有智能体功能的AI平台。该平台旨在帮助政府服务从被动回答问题转变为主动为公民完成任务。
desc_original: The National Electronics and Computer Technology Center (Nectec) is upgrading its locally developed Pathumma large language model (LLM) into Pathumma Connect, an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) platform designed to move government services beyond answering questions to completing tasks for citizens.

title: Move for digital code to transform parcel delivery
desc: The Digital Economy and Society (DES) Ministry is pushing to turn the existing Digital Post ID (D/ID) system into a shared digital infrastructure for logistics services, with Thailand Post and the Personal Data Protection Committee (PDPC) working to establish a standard that could eventually be adopted by all delivery operators.
title_cn: 数字编码推动快递物流转型
summary_cn: 泰国数字经济与社会部推动将现有的数字邮政ID（D/ID）系统转变为物流服务的共享数字基础设施。泰国邮政与个人数据保护委员会合作制定统一标准，预期最终可被所有快递运营商采用，推进物流行业数字化转型。
desc_original: The Digital Economy and Society (DES) Ministry is pushing to turn the existing Digital Post ID (D/ID) system into a shared digital infrastructure for logistics services, with Thailand Post and the Personal Data Protection Committee (PDPC) working to establish a standard that could eventually be adopted by all delivery operators.

title: Skill Bridge to train over 80,000 in targeted sectors
desc: The Skill Bridge, a national initiative aimed at developing workers' skills to meet the demands of modern, technology-driven industries, is working to train more than 80,000 Thais in targeted industries.
title_cn: Skill Bridge计划培训超8万人进入目标产业
summary_cn: Skill Bridge是泰国一项国家人才发展计划，旨在提升劳动力技能以满足现代科技产业的需求。该计划计划培训超过8万名泰国劳动者，重点关注目标产业领域的技能提升。
desc_original: The Skill Bridge, a national initiative aimed at developing workers' skills to meet the demands of modern, technology-driven industries, is working to train more than 80,000 Thais in targeted industries.

title: พลิกโฉม "หินฝุ่น-กระจกจากโซลาร์เซลล์”
desc: "วราวุธ"ย้ำประเทศไทยต้องเร่งยกระดับอุตสาหกรรมก่อสร้าง โดยใช้เอไอ เข้ามาใช้ในงานก่อสร้างเพ่ิมขึ้น ขณะที่"กพร."นำหินฝุ่น-กระจากจากแผงโซล่าร์เซลล์ เพ่ิมมูลค่าทางเศรษฐกิจ
title_cn: 太阳能电池板废料变废为宝 建筑业引入AI升级
summary_cn: 泰国官员强调需要加快建筑业升级，在施工中更广泛地应用人工智能技术。相关部门正推动对太阳能电池板产生的灰尘和玻璃废料进行回收利用，将废料转化为经济价值，实现循环经济发展。
desc_original: "วราวุธ"ย้ำประเทศไทยต้องเร่งยกระดับอุตสาหกรรมก่อสร้าง โดยใช้เอไอ เข้ามาใช้ในงานก่อสร้างเพ่ิมขึ้น ขณะที่"กพร."นำหินฝุ่น-กระจากจากแผงโซล่าร์เซลล์ เพ่ิมมูลค่าทางเศรษฐกิจ

title: New gas suppliers sought as prices spike
desc: Thailand is accelerating efforts to reduce its energy reliance on the Middle East as crude oil prices exceed US$100 per barrel and spot liquefied natural gas (LNG) prices have nearly doubled, driven by geopolitical turmoil and rising seasonal demand.
title_cn: 泰国寻求新油气供应商应对价格飙升
summary_cn: 受地缘政治动荡和季节性需求上升影响，国际原油价格突破每桶 100 美元，液化天然气现货价格翻倍上涨。泰国加快降低对中东能源的依赖，积极寻求新供应商以缓解成本压力。
desc_original: Thailand is accelerating efforts to reduce its energy reliance on the Middle East as crude oil prices exceed US$100 per barrel and spot liquefied natural gas (LNG) prices have nearly doubled, driven by geopolitical turmoil and rising seasonal demand.

title: Restaurants fear surge in costs for new welfare fund
desc: Restaurant associations have voiced mixed reactions to the new Employee Welfare Fund.
title_cn: 餐饮业担忧新员工福利基金推高营运成本
summary_cn: 新《员工福利基金》政策引发泰国餐饮业担忧。业界协会对该基金持观望态度，担心实施后会显著增加餐厅的运营成本，对行业利润率造成压力。
desc_original: Restaurant associations have voiced mixed reactions to the new Employee Welfare Fund.

title: Thai flight capacity posts  slight recovery in September
desc: Thailand's regional ranking for airline seats surged from third to second place this month, even as the country's largest low-cost carrier Thai AirAsia continued to slash flights, according to OAG, an aviation intelligence and analytics company.
title_cn: 泰国九月航班座位数小幅回升，区域排名升至第二
summary_cn: 根据航空数据公司 OAG 统计，泰国在东南亚地区的航班座位数排名从第三升至第二，标志着航空运力出现缓步恢复。尽管泰国最大廉价航空泰亚航（Thai AirAsia）继续削减航班，但其他航空公司的增长弥补了不足。
desc_original: Thailand's regional ranking for airline seats surged from third to second place this month, even as the country's largest low-cost carrier Thai AirAsia continued to slash flights, according to OAG, an aviation intelligence and analytics company.

title: Thailand warned of fiscal collapse
desc: Thailand's fiscal system could face a severe crisis within a decade if the government does not urgently undertake reforms, warns a political scientist from Chulalongkorn University.
title_cn: 学者警告泰国十年内面临财政危机
summary_cn: 朱拉隆功大学政治学者发出警告，若泰国政府不尽快启动改革，该国财政体系将在十年内面临严重危机。这一预警突显了泰国财政结构问题的紧迫性，涉及税收制度、公共债务和支出结构等多方面。
desc_original: Thailand's fiscal system could face a severe crisis within a decade if the government does not urgently undertake reforms, warns a political scientist from Chulalongkorn University.

title: Chinese man on money-laundering rap
desc: The Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) has arrested a Chinese national in Chiang Mai for allegedly laundering money for a transnational scam network linked to at least 16 online fraud cases.
title_cn: 华籍男子在清迈因洗钱罪被捕
summary_cn: 泰国中央调查局在清迈逮捕一名华籍男子，涉嫌为跨国电信诈骗网络洗钱。该诈骗团伙已被查实涉及至少 16 起在线欺诈案。此案反映泰国执法部门持续打击跨国金融犯罪的努力。
desc_original: The Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) has arrested a Chinese national in Chiang Mai for allegedly laundering money for a transnational scam network linked to at least 16 online fraud cases.

title: Forest land changes raise concerns
desc: More than 300,000 applications to use forest land, largely involving state agencies, are intensifying debate over how Thailand manages degraded forests as the government moves to widen the range of activities permitted in forest zones.
title_cn: 森林地使用权变更引发担忧
summary_cn: 泰国正面临森林地使用权制度的重大调整。超过30万项森林地使用申请（主要来自政府机构）引发了关于国家森林管理的广泛争议。政府计划扩大森林区域内允许开展的活动范围，以便有效处理日益退化的森林资源。这一政策调整引发各界对森林保护政策、生态平衡和资源管理的深入讨论。
desc_original: More than 300,000 applications to use forest land, largely involving state agencies, are intensifying debate over how Thailand manages degraded forests as the government moves to widen the range of activities permitted in forest zones.

title: Cabinet approves new oil, gas onshore concessions
desc: The cabinet has granted oil and gas exploration concessions to two companies that won the Round 25 onshore petroleum auction, aiming to secure domestic energy supply as Thailand's natural reserves continue to dwindle.
title_cn: 政府批准新的陆上油气特许权
summary_cn: 泰国内阁批准了第25轮陆上石油拍卖的获胜者——两家公司获得油气勘探特许权。此举是国家能源战略的重要一步，旨在保障国内能源供应的长期安定。由于泰国天然气储量持续枯竭，开发本土陆上油气资源已成为应对能源危机的必要举措，也反映了国家对能源独立性和经济可持续发展的重视。
desc_original: The cabinet has granted oil and gas exploration concessions to two companies that won the Round 25 onshore petroleum auction, aiming to secure domestic energy supply as Thailand's natural reserves continue to dwindle.

title: Discord in the EC boils over
desc: The Election Commission (EC)'s announcement was supposed to close a chapter: 77 people referred to the Supreme Court over alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election.
title_cn: 选举委员会内讧升级
summary_cn: 泰国选举委员会宣布将77人移交最高法院，涉嫌在2024年参议院选举中存在舞弊行为。本意是结束一场调查风波，却反而激化了委员会内部的分歧与对立。这起事件再次凸显了泰国选举制度的透明度问题和司法公正的挑战，成为当前政治生活中的焦点议题。
desc_original: The Election Commission (EC)'s announcement was supposed to close a chapter: 77 people referred to the Supreme Court over alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election.

title: Undersea art museum to open
desc: Phuket: Asia's first underwater art museum will open in this southern resort province, with the RAYA Underwater Art Museum expected to create a new diving attraction while helping reduce pressure on natural coral reefs.
title_cn: 东南亚首座水下艺术博物馆即将开放
summary_cn: 普吉岛 Phuket 即将迎来亚洲首座水下艺术博物馆 RAYA 的开放。该项目一举两得：为国际和本地潜水爱好者打造创新的旅游吸引力，同时通过将潜水活动转向人工建筑景观，有效减轻自然珊瑚礁系统所承受的游客压力，在促进旅游产业发展的同时践行生态保护。
desc_original: Phuket: Asia's first underwater art museum will open in this southern resort province, with the RAYA Underwater Art Museum expected to create a new diving attraction while helping reduce pressure on natural coral reefs.

title: Court jails former MP over proxy vote
desc: The Supreme Court has sentenced former Pheu Thai Party MP Saranwut Saranket to eight months in prison for allowing another MP to use his parliamentary ID card to vote on his behalf.
title_cn: 前议员因代理投票被监禁
summary_cn: 泰国最高法院判处为泰党 Pheu Thai 前议员萨朗武 Saranwut Saranket 八个月监禁。其违法行为是允许他人借用自己的议会证件代理投票，这是对议会程序完整性和国家廉政制度的严重违反。该判决彰显了泰国司法对政治廉洁和民主规范的坚守。
desc_original: The Supreme Court has sentenced former Pheu Thai Party MP Saranwut Saranket to eight months in prison for allowing another MP to use his parliamentary ID card to vote on his behalf.

title: Iconic Mon Bridge rafts get facelift
desc: KANCHANABURI: Authorities in Sangkhla Buri district are reorganising the floating rafts surrounding the Mon Bridge following a multi-agency agreement aimed at restoring views of the landmark and upgrading management of the popular tourist attraction.
title_cn: 孟族桥浮筏将焕然一新
summary_cn: 甘烹碧府尚卡拉武里县当局与多家机构达成协议，对环绕孟族桥（Mon Bridge）的浮筏进行整顿重组，以恢复这一地标景观的观光效果，同时升级这一热门旅游景点的管理体系。
desc_original: KANCHANABURI: Authorities in Sangkhla Buri district are reorganising the floating rafts surrounding the Mon Bridge following a multi-agency agreement aimed at restoring views of the landmark and upgrading management of the popular tourist attraction.

title: EC reports big jump in complaints
desc: The Election Commission (EC) handled thousands of election complaints and cases in fiscal 2024 and 2025, while allocating 282 million baht in subsidies to political parties, its secretary-general Sawaeng Boonmee said on Wednesday.
title_cn: 选举委员会投诉案件剧增
summary_cn: 泰国选举委员会秘书长沙灵·本米日前表示，在2024至2025财政年度，该委员会处理了数千起选举投诉和案件，同时向政党拨款2.82亿泰铢补助，反映选举程序中的争议明显上升。
desc_original: The Election Commission (EC) handled thousands of election complaints and cases in fiscal 2024 and 2025, while allocating 282 million baht in subsidies to political parties, its secretary-general Sawaeng Boonmee said on Wednesday.

title: “บิ๊กโก๋” จัดงานค่ำคืนแห่งความทรงจำ หลังเกษียณอายุราชการในวันที่ 30 กันยายนนี้
desc: “บิ๊กโก๋” จัดงานค่ำคืนแห่งความทรงจำ หลังเกษียณอายุราชการในวันที่ 30 กันยายนนี้ ร้องเพลง “รอยยิ้มนักสู้” ให้กำลังใจผู้ที่สมหวังและพลาดหวังจากการแต่งตั้ง
title_cn: 政界人士「大哥」9月30日退休举办追忆之夜
summary_cn: 泰国政界人士「大哥」将于9月30日办理退休手续，为庆祝职业生涯圆满结束，将举办「回忆之夜」特别活动，现场献唱「斗士的微笑」等歌曲，为仕途顺遂与失意者鼓舞士气。
desc_original: “บิ๊กโก๋” จัดงานค่ำคืนแห่งความทรงจำ หลังเกษียณอายุราชการในวันที่ 30 กันยายนนี้ ร้องเพลง “รอยยิ้มนักสู้” ให้กำลังใจผู้ที่สมหวังและพลาดหวังจากการแต่งตั้ง

title: Scammers ‘moving through Thailand to new base in Malaysia’
desc: Police say they have detected a network set up to smuggle scammers through Thailand to Malaysia, as they attempt to flee crackdowns elsewhere in Southeast Asia.
title_cn: 诈骗犯过境泰国转移至马来西亚
summary_cn: 泰国警方发现一个犯罪网络，专门协助诈骗分子从东南亚其他地区经泰国逃亡至马来西亚设立新据点。这反映了各国打击跨境诈骗压力日益加大，犯罪分子被迫跨国转移。
desc_original: Police say they have detected a network set up to smuggle scammers through Thailand to Malaysia, as they attempt to flee crackdowns elsewhere in Southeast Asia.

title: Ex-minister Vorapak named in US sanctions push
desc: Former deputy finance minister Vorapak Tanyawong is among 26 people and two companies targeted by US lawmakers for sanctions against figures linked to Southeast Asian financial scam gangs.
title_cn: 前副财政部长他瓦帕被美国制裁点名
summary_cn: 美国国会议员指控前泰国副财政部长他瓦帕·坦亚翁与东南亚金融诈骗集团有关，已将其与其他25人及2家公司列入制裁清单，表明美国正加强对跨境诈骗犯罪的制裁力度。
desc_original: Former deputy finance minister Vorapak Tanyawong is among 26 people and two companies targeted by US lawmakers for sanctions against figures linked to Southeast Asian financial scam gangs.

title: Tourism stimulus likely to be postponed until April
desc: The government’s planned “Thai Tiew Thai Plus” domestic tourism stimulus scheme is likely to be postponed until April next year, amid concerns that staging a promotion during the high season starting in October would have limited economic benefits.
title_cn: 泰国国内旅游刺激方案延至明年4月
summary_cn: 泰国政府决定将「国内旅游刺激方案」(Thai Tiew Thai Plus)推迟至明年4月。官方认为在10月启开的国际旅游旺季推行此项政策，国内游需求可能被出国旅游分流，经济拉动效果有限。当局将在淡季重新启动该计划以期获得更佳效果。
desc_original: The government’s planned “Thai Tiew Thai Plus” domestic tourism stimulus scheme is likely to be postponed until April next year, amid concerns that staging a promotion during the high season starting in October would have limited economic benefits.

title: จับตาประชุมเฟด รู้ผล 17 ก.ย.นี้ ตลาดคาดขึ้นดอกเบี้ย 0.25% หุ้นกลุ่มไหนได้ประโยชน์?
desc: จับตาเฟดคืนนี้ ตลาดคาดขึ้นดอกเบี้ย 0.25% ลุ้นขึ้นสั้นแล้วตรึง หรือขึ้นยาวสกัดเงินเฟ้อ หลังรคาาน้ำมันพุ่ง โบรกฯ เปิดลิสต์หุ้นได้ประโยชน์
title_cn: 美联储会议今日揭晓 市场预期基准利率上调0.25%
summary_cn: 美联储将于今日公布利率决议。市场普遍预期基准利率上调0.25%。分析人士关注当前是否为短期加息后维持稳定，还是启动长期加息周期以遏制通胀压力。受国际油价上升影响，证券商已梳理出相关受益股票。
desc_original: จับตาเฟดคืนนี้ ตลาดคาดขึ้นดอกเบี้ย 0.25% ลุ้นขึ้นสั้นแล้วตรึง หรือขึ้นยาวสกัดเงินเฟ้อ หลังรคาาน้ำมันพุ่ง โบรกฯ เปิดลิสต์หุ้นได้ประโยชน์

title: Anutin-Trump trade talks possible this week
desc: ⁠Thailand ⁠has proposed ​talks between Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul ​and US ‌President Donald Trump later this week, as the two countries seek to conclude ​negotiations ⁠on a bilateral trade deal and discuss tariff rates.
title_cn: 泰国总理与特朗普本周或启动贸易谈判

title: Chinese driver remains free 7 months after death of Thai-Swedish boy
desc: Chinese driver remains free 7 months after death of Thai-Swedish boy Legacy A Thai-Swedish couple is seeking further action after a Chinese driver, who killed their teenage son, remains unarrested seven months after the incident. The 41 year old Thai mother, Vipawee, and her Swedish husband visited Chon Buri Provincial Police Office today, September 16, to follow up on the investigation. Thai social media influencer and volunteer Thamanan “King” Taegtim accompanied the couple and pledged to help them pursue the case. Vipawee said the crash happened on February 20 on Phatthanakan Road in Nong Prue subdistrict, Bang Lamung district, Chon Buri province. Her son, Tommy, was riding a black Honda PCX motorcycle when he was hit by a pickup truck driven by a Chinese national identified as Wang. Photo via The Pattaya News According to Vipawee, the Chinese driver was reversing the pickup truck out of a car park of a restaurant on a roadside when the vehicle sideswiped Tommy’s motorcycle. Tommy suffered serious injuries and later died in hospital. Vipawee said she and her husband reported the case to Nong Prue Police Station and that an arrest warrant had already been issued for Wang. title: 泰国AI使用率飙升！超三成民众怕AI会抢走“饭碗”
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据微软最新发布的《全球AI扩散报告》，泰国劳动年龄人口中实际使用人工智能（AI）的比例，已从2025年上半年的9.1%上升至2026年第一季度的12.4%。这一增幅使泰国成为全球AI用户比例增长速度第二快的国家，仅次于韩国。韩国增长率为43.2%，日本为34.1%。 基于上述数据，AI与数据驱动科技企业Real Smart Public Company Limited（Real Smart）旗下研究与数据分析部门RealWatch Lab，对2026年1月1日至8月31日期间泰国网民在各大社交媒体平台公开发布的AI相关内容进行了调查，以了解泰国网民使用AI的行为及其对AI的担忧。 调查共发现AI相关讨论内容26,399条。其中，一般性AI话题17,414条；AI在日常生活和工作中的应用4,107条；对AI的担忧及其可能带来的影响4,878条。 [工作应用：创意工作占比最高] 调查显示，在工作中使用AI的泰国网民，主要应用场景包括： 一是创意工作，占36.01%。相关内容主要提到使用AI制作视频、制作教学素材、辅助玩《Football Manager》（足球经理）等足球管理类游戏，以及制作电商销售视频等。 二是辅助文件及文书工作，占31.07%。网民表示，AI能够大幅提高文件处理效率，也可用于撰写脚本、分析客户工作以及快速总结工作内容等。 三是优化企业工作流程，占13.61%。包括利用AI规划工作流程、辅助设计工作架构等。 四是辅助教学和学习，占11.08%。主要包括利用AI完成作业、提高作业效率，以及将AI作为快速查询资料的工具。 五是专业数据分析与处理，占8.23%。包括利用AI分析股票市场、将历史股票数据交由AI处理并预测未来价格，以及辅助修改代码、帮助建筑师进行结构设计计算等。 [五大担忧：AI取代工作居首] 调查还发现，无论是否实际使用AI，泰国网民都对AI带来的各种影响存在不同程度担忧。社交媒体上讨论最多的五大担忧包括： 一是担心AI取代人工导致失业，占33.35%。这是泰国网民最主要的担忧。相关讨论主要集中在：“AI取代人类工作后，人还能做什么？”“新老员工都可能失业”“会熟练使用AI的人才能继续发展”等。 二是担心AI的可靠性和准确性，占30.96%。部分网民认为，AI存在较多错误，使用AI时需要谨慎；也有人指出，AI仍存在无法跳出既有框架思考等局限。 三是担心AI对经济和社会造成长期影响，占15.15%。相关讨论包括AI可能被犯罪分子利用、对社会造成影响，以及AI大规模取代就业岗位后可能引发长期经济问题等。 四是担心过度依赖AI导致人类技能下降，占15.03%。部分网民担心，如果过度依赖AI，人类可能减少独立思考，“使用AI后甚至不需要动脑”，长期可能导致思考能力下降。 五是担心个人隐私和数据安全，占5.51%。主要包括担心

title: Chiang Mai homebuyer finds skeleton inside foreclosed house
desc: Chiang Mai homebuyer finds skeleton inside foreclosed house Legacy A prospective homebuyer inspecting a foreclosed house in Chiang Mai discovered human skeletal remains lying on a bed yesterday, September 15. Mae Ping Police Station officers were called to the abandoned two-storey wooden house near a community market in San Phi Suea subdistrict, Mueang Chiang Mai district, at around 5pm. The property had been seized by a bank and was due to be auctioned through the Legal Execution Department. A resident interested in buying the house had received permission to inspect its condition before making a decision. Photo via Guru Chiang Mai The house, which had previously operated as a shop, had been abandoned for several years. Many belongings belonging to the former occupants remained inside. During the inspection, the prospective buyer found a bed on the ground floor covered by a mosquito net. After opening the net, human remains, which had dried to a largely skeletal state, were found lying on the bed. title: Police raid 600 million baht tyre factory over Thai nominee shareholders
desc: Police raid 600 million baht tyre factory over Thai nominee shareholders Legacy Police arrested a Chinese father and son and two Thai nationals during a raid on a tyre factory in Samut Sakhon today, September 16, over a nominee business operation . Police also found that the son using the identity of a deceased Thai person. Officers from the National Identity Crime Enforcement Centre under the Department of Provincial Administration raided the factory and arrested four suspects. They were identified as 37 year old Chinese-born Burmese national Myo, also known as Li, his 19 year old Chinese-born Thai son Thanadon, a Thai woman named Nafa, and one of Li’s Thai employees. According to the police report, Li had fled China after becoming involved in corruption connected to a government project. He entered Thailand in 2013 using a Myanmar passport under the name Myo. Photo via KhaoSod Li subsequently established three companies in Aom Noi district of Samut Sakhon. Officers said their investigation found that all three companies were operated using Thai nominees . title: 孔敬府寺庙土地纠纷迎突破：地契正式归还寺院，30年争议落幕
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 9月16日，据泰媒报道，据泰媒报道，泰国孔敬府备受社会关注的阿杜拉雅兰森林寺土地纠纷迎来重大进展。当天，知名律师阿南猜率领“法治军团律师基金会”团队，陪同寺院住持阿杜萨拉尼泰长老前往孔敬府土地办公室，依法办理涉案土地权属登记手续。经土地部门完成全部法定程序后，涉案地契（编号61945）产权人正式由原登记人变更为阿杜拉雅兰森林寺。随着土地官员签字盖章完成，现场僧侣、信众及各界人士齐声高呼“Sathu”（意为“阿弥陀佛”），持续30余年的土地纠纷取得历史性突破。 据了解，这起土地纠纷可追溯至1990年。当时，土地原所有人签署文件，将涉案土地捐赠给寺院用于建设和宗教活动，寺院随后长期在该地开展宗教事务，并于1998年正式获得政府批准设立。然而，捐赠人去世后，其继承人与寺院围绕土地所有权产生争议，双方随后展开长达30多年的诉讼和法律程序。虽然寺院方面曾在多起民事案件中获得有利判决，但土地登记问题始终未得到彻底解决。 今年8月，案件再次引发社会广泛关注。部分继承人一方前往寺院设置障碍物，要求寺院迁离土地，引发当地社会持续关注。随后，寺院住持携带保存多年的涉案地契原件前往孔敬府土地办公室，反对有关方面申请补办地契。经官方核验确认，该地契确为原件，土地部门随即停止补发程序，并重新启动产权登记审查工作。此后，寺院律师团队又向土地厅提交100余页法律意见及最高法院判例，为办理产权登记提供法律依据。 9月16日上午，阿南猜律师团队陪同住持抵达孔敬府土地办公室，与土地部门及相关单位召开会议，就涉案土地登记程序进行最后确认。出席会议的还包括国家佛教保护委员会主席、国家佛教事务办公室官员、孔敬府佛教事务办公室负责人以及僧团代表等。 按照程序，土地部门首先在土地官员办公室召开内部会议，媒体未获准进入。随后，全体人员转至会议室，正式办理涉案地契（编号61945）的产权变更手续。土地官员依法将原登记在前村长亨·平西名下的地契，更正登记至阿杜拉雅兰森林寺名下，并完成签字及官方盖章程序，标志着该地契依法正式归属寺院。 手续完成后，土地部门将地契原件通过孔敬府副府尹移交给寺院住持，现场众多媒体、寺院委员会成员、信众及前来见证的民众共同见证这一时刻。随着住持接过地契，会议室内响起阵阵“阿弥陀佛”声，现场气氛十分热烈。 根据土地部门安排，地契原件今后将由孔敬府佛教事务办公室统一保管，寺院则保存官方副本作为法律凭证和日后管理依据。 不过，此次土地登记完成，并不意味着整个案件已经结束。警方目前仍在调查此前申请补办地契过程中，是否存在涉嫌谎称地契遗失、向政府工作人员提供虚假信息等违法行为。按照安排，相关案件将于9月18日继续进入调查程序，而其他涉及该土地纠纷的刑事案件及法律程序也将依法持续推进。 （编译：Juliette；审校：WAN；来源：thairathtv） The post 孔敬
title_cn: 阿杜拉雅兰森林寺土地纠纷落幕：30年诉讼迎来突破，地契正式归属寺院
summary_cn: 孔敬府阿杜拉雅兰森林寺长达30年的土地权属纠纷终于画上句号。这起纠纷始于1990年的土地捐赠，因继承人与寺院对所有权产生分歧而延续数十年。经过多轮诉讼，9月16日土地部门最终将地契（编号61945）的产权从原所有人名下正式变更为寺院名下，获得包括国家佛教保护委员会在内的多家机构认可。值得注意的是，警方仍在调查补办地契过程中是否存在违法行为，相关刑事案件将继续推进。

title: Bangkok plans 1,347 EV rubbish trucks to cut costs
desc: Bangkok plans 1,347 EV rubbish trucks to cut costs Legacy Bangkok plans to lease 1,347 electric rubbish trucks , with Governor Chadchart Sittipunt saying the switch from diesel could save the city about 4.745 billion baht in energy costs over five years. The project is being considered as part of Bangkok’s 2027 fiscal year budget, which is currently before the Bangkok Metropolitan Council for its second and third readings. Chadchart said yesterday, September 15, that the move would mark a major transition from diesel rubbish trucks, which Bangkok has relied on for years, to electric vehicles . He argued that the change would reduce operating costs, pollution and noise while maintaining daily waste collection services. Bangkok estimates that the 1,347 electric trucks would travel an average of about 200 kilometres per day. Based on the city’s calculations, diesel trucks would cost about 8.756 billion baht in fuel over five years, assuming diesel costs 39 baht per litre. Electricity for the EV fleet is estimated at 4.011 billion baht over the same period, based on an electricity price of 6 baht per unit. That would produce estimated energy savings of 4.745 billion baht, or about 949
title_cn: 曼谷计划投入1,347辆电动垃圾车，5年内节省47.45亿泰铢
summary_cn: 曼谷市政府计划在2027财年投资采购1,347辆电动垃圾车以替代现有柴油车。根据总督察察猜的估算，这一转换预计在5年内节省47.45亿泰铢的能源成本。柴油车5年燃油成本约87.56亿泰铢（按每升39泰铢计），而电动车电费约40.11亿泰铢（按每度6泰铢计）。此举除降低成本外，还将减少污染和噪音，改善曼谷环保状况。该项目目前正在曼谷市议会进行第二、三阶段审议。

title: 5 things to do in Bangkok this weekend (September 18 to 20)
desc: 5 things to do in Bangkok this weekend (September 18 to 20) Legacy Not every weekend plan needs a ticket, a stage or a packed event schedule. This time around, one of Bangkok’s more overlooked green spaces offers the chance to walk among live butterflies for free, while elsewhere the city is filling the weekend with travel stories, photography, experimental art and international food. The mix moves from a quiet morning in Chatuchak to a creative workshop built around a miniature theatre, with plenty in between for anyone looking to do something different from the usual shopping-centre circuit. Here are five things to do in Bangkok from September 18 to 20. title: Chinese gambling suspect arrested in Chon Buri
desc: Chinese gambling suspect arrested in Chon Buri Legacy Thai police arrested a Chinese man at a luxury house in Chon Buri after locating him while he was wanted under an Interpol Red Notice over an online gambling operation in China. Chon Buri Provincial Immigration Bureau launched an operation targeting foreign criminals hiding in Thailand and identified the 37 year old Chinese man, Lee, as a wanted national. Police said he was a key member of an online gambling network operating in China. According to police, Lee managed the agent system and finances for gambling websites based outside China . The offences date back to late 2021. Police said the network operated through more than 300 agents, who reportedly encouraged more than 1,000 Chinese nationals to use the gambling websites. Photo via Amarin TV Lee reportedly coordinated with the agents and supervised commission payments to senior members, and the agents worked for those members. Police estimated that the accounts linked to the gambling network had a turnover of more than 1.5 billion baht. title: 中国籍贪腐嫌犯在泰落网，利用代持经营6亿企业
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 ，据泰国媒体报道 9月16日，泰国警方联合内政部行政厅、反洗钱办公室及地方行政部门展开行动，抓获一名中国正在追捕的涉腐嫌疑人。该男子涉嫌逃避中国腐败案件调查后进入泰国，以缅甸籍身份活动超过10年，同时涉嫌通过泰国人代持股份经营企业。 此次案件源于泰国警方打击违法外国人的专项调查。警方发现，一名自称缅甸籍的“Myo”涉嫌利用泰国人代持股份的方式设立3家公司，3家公司总部均位于北榄府Krathum Bean县Om Noi镇1组，注册资本合计约1.91亿泰铢，名下7宗土地，总面积约45637.6平方米，相关资产总值约6亿泰铢。 调查发现，Myo本人直接持有3家公司股份并担任3家公司的授权董事，而登记为泰籍股东的人员实际是一名自由职业出租车司机，过去曾为其中一家企业运送货物，但从未实际投资或持有公司股份。 警方随后通过移民局的人脸识别系统发现，Myo疑似与一名中国籍男子Li某为同一人。移民局与中国警方联络人员核查后获悉，Li某是中国方面正在追捕的嫌疑人，涉嫌参与、协助政府项目中的腐败行为。 据调查，Li某在涉嫌犯罪后逃离中国。2013年至2016年期间，他曾持中国护照累计14次出入泰国；自2018年起则改用“Myo”身份及缅甸护照，此后又累计48次出入泰国。 泰国警方在收集相关证据后，向北榄府法院申请逮捕令，指控其涉嫌利用泰国人代持股份以及违反相关法律从事商业活动，并对其关联的3家公司展开搜查。 警方在现场查扣多份重要文件，包括土地所有权证及一份价值900万泰铢的买卖合同，以进一步调查相关资产及资金来源。 搜查期间，警方还发现其涉嫌让儿子冒用泰国公民身份取得身份证，并计划将相关资产转移至儿子名下。Li某的儿子出示的泰国身份证显示出生于泰国并具有泰国国籍，但警方进一步核对指纹后发现，其指纹与一名中国籍男子Ji某相符。 警方调查显示，Ji某此前曾持中国护照出入泰国，而其首次办理泰国身份证是在2023年。相关办理过程还牵涉一名前行政部门官员，该官员此前已因涉嫌协助外国人冒用身份办理泰国身份证而被捕。 警方因此将Li某及其儿子Ji某一并控制并依法调查，同时采集两人以及一名在户籍资料中登记为Ji某母亲的泰国女子的DNA样本，以核实三人的实际亲属关系。警方表示，如调查证实相关人员知晓并参与冒用身份取得泰国身份证，将依法追究责任。 此外，警方调查Myo的相关记录时，还发现其涉嫌曾对名下公司一名中国籍女员工Lu某实施严重暴力行为。据警方掌握的信息，Myo曾用脚踢L某头部，将其笔记本电脑摔至损坏，随后持刀威胁并强迫她签署一份价值1500万泰铢的债务确认文件。 警方还指称，Myo曾闯入Lu某住所，盗走多项财物及重要文件，用透明胶带捆绑其双手，以塑料袋套住其头部，再用透明胶带封住嘴巴，阻止其呼救。 据调查，Myo随后涉嫌继续对Lu某实施暴力，包括将其头部按入水池、使用燃
title_cn: 中国逃犯在泰利用代持股份经营企业获利，伪造身份后被逮捕
summary_cn: 泰国警方逮捕一名中国通缉贪腐嫌疑人，其利用泰国人代持股份设立 3 家公司，资产总值约 6 亿泰铢。该男子持中国护照后改用缅甸身份掩盖身份超过 10 年，涉嫌让儿子冒用泰国公民身份，并对中国籍女员工施暴。警方已采取法律措施。

title: Thailand signs up to global minimum tax agreement

title_cn: 泰国加入全球最低税率协议
summary_cn: 泰国已正式加入全球最低税率协议框架，签署国际税收信息交换协议以支持补充税（Top-up Tax）征收。该协议是国际税收改革倡议的重要组成部分，旨在确保全球企业按统一最低税率缴税，防止税收套利。对在泰经营的国际企业具有重要政策影响。

title: อีซูซุลุยสับเปลี่ยนแบตฯรถบรรทุกไฟฟ้า 7 นาที เปลี่ยนเกมโลจิสติกส์ไทย
desc: อีซูซุจับมือพันธมิตรเดินหน้าทดสอบโซลูชั่นส์สับเปลี่ยนแบตเตอรี่ สำหรับรถบรรทุกไฟฟ้าในภาคธุรกิจโลจิสติกส์ไทย
title_cn: Isuzu 推动电动卡车 7 分钟快速电池更换，革新泰国物流业
summary_cn: 日本 Isuzu 与泰国合作伙伴联合推进电动卡车快速电池更换方案的实地测试。该技术突破使电动卡车仅需 7 分钟即可完成电池更换，相比传统充电方式大幅降低停工时间。这项创新有望显著降低物流企业运营成本、提升运输效率，为泰国物流行业的电气化转型树立新范本，推动整个行业绿色升级。

title: Alibaba launches agentic AI tool to help SMEs expand
desc: Alibaba.com, the firm's business-to-business arm, has launched its agentic artificial intelligence (AI) tool Accio in Thailand to help small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) expand exports, as demand from European and Southeast Asian buyers creates new opportunities for Thai suppliers.
title_cn: 阿里巴巴在泰推出智能 AI 工具助力中小企业拓展出口
summary_cn: 阿里巴巴国际站（Alibaba.com）正式在泰国推出智能代理 AI 工具 Accio，这是其全球化战略中的重要一步。该平台专为中小企业（SMEs）设计，致力于抓住欧洲及东南亚买家需求增长的机遇。通过 AI 赋能帮助泰国供应商精准对接国际市场、扩大出口规模，是数字贸易赋能本地企业的重要举措，也反映出泰国在全球贸易中地位上升。
desc_original: Alibaba.com, the firm's business-to-business arm, has launched its agentic artificial intelligence (AI) tool Accio in Thailand to help small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) expand exports, as demand from European and Southeast Asian buyers creates new opportunities for Thai suppliers.

title: One Map plan to boost response
desc: The government will develop a nationwide "One Map of Water" to create a shared database for monitoring floods and other water-related disasters and improve emergency response.
title_cn: 泰国推出「一张水灾图」计划，强化灾害应对能力
summary_cn: 泰国政府计划开发全国统一的「一张水灾图」平台，构建水灾及相关水文灾害监测的共享数据库。通过整合气象、水资源等多部门数据，建立实时监测和预警机制。这项举措有助于大幅提升紧急响应速度、改进灾害预警精度，是泰国应对洪涝频发挑战的重要基础设施建设，意义重大。
desc_original: The government will develop a nationwide "One Map of Water" to create a shared database for monitoring floods and other water-related disasters and improve emergency response.

title: EIC downplays political risk for the local economy
desc: Following the Election Commission's (EC) recent resolution on the alleged Senate election collusion case, SCB Economic Intelligence Center (EIC), the research arm of Siam Commercial Bank, expects political factors to have a limited impact on the Thai economy through the rest of this year.
title_cn: 泰国经济智库下调政治风险，预期全年影响有限
summary_cn: 泰国选举委员会（EC）就参议院选举串联案做出决议后，暹罗商业银行（SCB）属下经济情报中心（EIC）发表乐观观点：预计政治因素对泰国经济今年余下时期的冲击将受限。这项评估反映市场对泰国政治局势逐步稳定的乐观预期。政治风险下降将有利于提振商业信心、吸引外资、维持经济增长势头，是泰国经济前景的积极信号。
desc_original: Following the Election Commission's (EC) recent resolution on the alleged Senate election collusion case, SCB Economic Intelligence Center (EIC), the research arm of Siam Commercial Bank, expects political factors to have a limited impact on the Thai economy through the rest of this year.

title: Revived Mice sector valued at B200bn
desc: Thailand's Mice (meetings, incentives, conventions and exhibitions) sector is steadily transitioning into recovery mode and is expected to be worth 200 billion baht this year.
title_cn: 泰国 MICE 产业复苏，年度市场规模达 200 亿泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国会议展览业（MICE：Meetings, Incentives, Conventions and Exhibitions）正稳步进入复苏期，预期今年市场规模达 200 亿泰铢（Baht）。在后疫情时代国际商务往来恢复、企业商务活动需求回升的背景下，该行业展现强劲增长势头。MICE 产业是泰国服务业的支柱产业，其复苏成为推动整体经济恢复的重要驱动力，发展前景看好。
desc_original: Thailand's Mice (meetings, incentives, conventions and exhibitions) sector is steadily transitioning into recovery mode and is expected to be worth 200 billion baht this year.

title: Banpu mulls move into LNG market
desc: Natural gas as an economic driver and the rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) data centres remained in focus on the second day of the 2026 Gastech seminar in Bangkok, with energy conglomerate Banpu Plc announcing it was considering a move into the liquefied natural gas (LNG) business.
title_cn: 邦浦公司考虑进军液化天然气市场
summary_cn: 在曼谷举办的 2026 Gastech 能源论坛第二天，能源集团邦浦公司（Banpu）宣布正在考虑进入液化天然气（LNG）业务，以应对天然气作为经济驱动力和人工智能数据中心的快速扩张。
desc_original: Natural gas as an economic driver and the rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) data centres remained in focus on the second day of the 2026 Gastech seminar in Bangkok, with energy conglomerate Banpu Plc announcing it was considering a move into the liquefied natural gas (LNG) business.

title: Cause for cheer in Thai PISA results
desc: The Equitable Education Fund (EEF) says aggregate gains are encouraging, but the gap between the highest and lowest performers has yet to narrow.
title_cn: 泰国 PISA 成绩传来好消息
summary_cn: 教育公平基金（EEF）表示，泰国学生在国际学生评估项目（PISA）中的整体成绩有所进步，令人鼓舞。不过，最高成绩与最低成绩之间的差距尚未缩小。
desc_original: The Equitable Education Fund (EEF) says aggregate gains are encouraging, but the gap between the highest and lowest performers has yet to narrow.

title: New centre to combat invasive fish
desc: Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Suriya Juangroongruangkit has established a centre to coordinate efforts to combat the spread of blackchin tilapia, calling the invasive species a national concern and promising visible results within three months.
title_cn: 新中心应对入侵鱼种
summary_cn: 泰国农业与合作部部长苏里亚（Suriya Juangroongruangkit）建立专项中心，协调对抗黑嘴罗非鱼（blackchin tilapia）入侵的工作。这一外来物种被列为国家关切议题，部长承诺在三个月内交出显著成效。
desc_original: Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Suriya Juangroongruangkit has established a centre to coordinate efforts to combat the spread of blackchin tilapia, calling the invasive species a national concern and promising visible results within three months.

title: Nation 'must act' as birth rate tumbles
desc: Thailand is being urged to mount a concerted effort involving the government, academia, private sector, local authorities and the public to tackle the country's low birth rate crisis, covering the entire lifecycle from having and raising children to preparing them for work.
title_cn: 泰国须应对出生率下滑危机
summary_cn: 泰国被敦促采取协调行动，政府、学术界、私营部门、地方当局及公众需齐心协力应对国内出生率低迷危机。这项努力应涵盖从生育养育到为下一代准备工作机会的全生命周期。
desc_original: Thailand is being urged to mount a concerted effort involving the government, academia, private sector, local authorities and the public to tackle the country's low birth rate crisis, covering the entire lifecycle from having and raising children to preparing them for work.

title: National Telecom, USTDA ink feasibility study pact
desc: State enterprise National Telecom (NT) and the US Trade and Development Agency (USTDA) have signed a grant agreement to support a feasibility study for the new Thailand–US (THUS) international submarine cable system, aiming to strengthen Thailand's position as a regional digital connectivity hub.
title_cn: 国家电信与美国贸易署签署可行性研究协议
summary_cn: 泰国国营企业国家电信公司（National Telecom）与美国贸易和发展署（USTDA）签署赠款协议，共同支持泰美（THUS）国际海底光缆系统的可行性研究。该项目旨在强化泰国作为区域数字连接枢纽的战略地位。
desc_original: State enterprise National Telecom (NT) and the US Trade and Development Agency (USTDA) have signed a grant agreement to support a feasibility study for the new Thailand–US (THUS) international submarine cable system, aiming to strengthen Thailand's position as a regional digital connectivity hub.

title: Data centre rules near completion
desc: The government expects to finalise a framework and minimum standards for data centres within a month, focusing on preventing projects from affecting surrounding communities, National Economic and Social Development Council (NESDC) secretary-general Danucha Pichayanan said on Tuesday.
title_cn: 数据中心管理办法月内敲定
summary_cn: 泰国政府由国家经济和社会发展委员会(NESDC)主导，预计一个月内完成数据中心框架和最低标准，重点防止项目对周边社区的影响。
desc_original: The government expects to finalise a framework and minimum standards for data centres within a month, focusing on preventing projects from affecting surrounding communities, National Economic and Social Development Council (NESDC) secretary-general Danucha Pichayanan said on Tuesday.

title: Cabinet backs national disaster insurance scheme
desc: The cabinet has approved a national insurance scheme providing disaster coverage for about 30 million households from Oct 1, in a move aimed at speeding up compensation and cutting state relief costs.
title_cn: 政府推出全国灾难保险方案
summary_cn: 泰国内阁批准全国灾难保险方案，自10月1日起向约3000万户家庭提供灾难保险覆盖，旨在加快灾难赔偿速度并减少政府救灾开支。
desc_original: The cabinet has approved a national insurance scheme providing disaster coverage for about 30 million households from Oct 1, in a move aimed at speeding up compensation and cutting state relief costs.

title: B95bn irrigation project gets nod
desc: A six-year irrigation project worth 95 billion baht has been approved to improve flood management in the lower eastern Chao Phraya basin and protect communities and economic areas across eight provinces, including Bangkok, said the government.
title_cn: 95亿泰铢灌溉项目获批
summary_cn: 泰国政府批准耗资95亿泰铢、历时六年的灌溉项目，重点改善湄南河(Chao Phraya)下游盆地洪水管理，保护曼谷及周边七省的社区和经济区域。
desc_original: A six-year irrigation project worth 95 billion baht has been approved to improve flood management in the lower eastern Chao Phraya basin and protect communities and economic areas across eight provinces, including Bangkok, said the government.

title: CIB uncovers ex-abbot's millions
desc: The Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) has uncovered more than 300 million baht in bank accounts linked to former Wat Phutthaisawan abbot Atichot Tanprasert and his close female associate as it widens its probe into suspected financial misconduct.
title_cn: 中调局查获前普陀寺方丈3亿泰铢资产
summary_cn: 泰国中央调查局在调查前普陀寺(Wat Phutthaisawan)方丈阿迪乔·坦帕瑟特涉嫌财务不当行为案件中，发现其名下及其女性关联人控制的银行账户中有超过3亿泰铢资金。
desc_original: The Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) has uncovered more than 300 million baht in bank accounts linked to former Wat Phutthaisawan abbot Atichot Tanprasert and his close female associate as it widens its probe into suspected financial misconduct.

title: SEC proposes changes to stablecoin transfer rules
desc: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is tightening oversight of stablecoin transfers, proposing a 5-million-baht cap as it moves to crack down on money laundering, cybercrime and attempts to use digital assets to circumvent international money transfer rules.
title_cn: 泰证交所拟限制稳定币转账额度
summary_cn: 泰国证券交易委员会收紧稳定币转账监管，提议设立500万泰铢转账上限，目标打击洗钱、网络犯罪，并防止利用数字资产规避国际汇款规则。
desc_original: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is tightening oversight of stablecoin transfers, proposing a 5-million-baht cap as it moves to crack down on money laundering, cybercrime and attempts to use digital assets to circumvent international money transfer rules.

title: Private equity trust offers funding for new tech firms
desc: Thailand is launching a 1-billion-baht private equity trust (PE Trust) to provide growth capital for new economy businesses, with the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) planning a pathway to bring promising firms to the bourse through the LiVE Exchange and Market for Alternative Investment (MAI).
title_cn: 泰国推出10亿泰铢私募基金信托扶持新兴科技企业
summary_cn: 泰国启动规模10亿泰铢的私募基金信托（PE Trust），为新经济企业提供成长资本。泰国证券交易所（SET）计划通过LiVE Exchange和另类投资市场（MAI）为优质初创企业提供登陆交易所的途径，促进新兴产业融资发展。
desc_original: Thailand is launching a 1-billion-baht private equity trust (PE Trust) to provide growth capital for new economy businesses, with the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) planning a pathway to bring promising firms to the bourse through the LiVE Exchange and Market for Alternative Investment (MAI).

title: Anutin files defamation lawsuit against iLaw chief
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has filed a defamation lawsuit against iLaw director Yingcheep Atchanont over remarks linking him to alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election, insisting the legal action is not intended to silence his critics.
title_cn: 总理阿努廷对人权组织iLaw主任提起诽谤诉讼
summary_cn: 总理阿努廷·查瑞瓦拉库尔向人权组织iLaw主任英奇普·阿查农提起诽谤诉讼，指控其涉及2024年参议院选举串通的不实言论。阿努廷强调此项法律行动并非压制批评声音，而是维护个人名誉和法律权益。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has filed a defamation lawsuit against iLaw director Yingcheep Atchanont over remarks linking him to alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election, insisting the legal action is not intended to silence his critics.

title: One Bangkok eyes 10% visitor increase
desc: One Bangkok Retail, part of One Bangkok's mixed-use development, is targeting a 10% increase in visitors in 2027, building on the 40 million visitors in its second year of operation.
title_cn: One Bangkok零售项目瞄准2027年客流增长10%
summary_cn: 曼谷标志性混合开发项目One Bangkok旗下零售业务One Bangkok Retail，以第二年度4000万客流为基础，目标在2027年实现客流增长10%。该项目已成为曼谷主要商业地标，持续扩大市场吸引力。
desc_original: One Bangkok Retail, part of One Bangkok's mixed-use development, is targeting a 10% increase in visitors in 2027, building on the 40 million visitors in its second year of operation.

title: กทพ. หารือ BEM ลดผลกระทบประชาชน ก่อนปรับค่าผ่านทางพิเศษประจิมรัถยา 15 ธ.ค. 69

summary_cn: 泰国交通运输部与高速公路运营商BEM公司进行协商，在2026年12月15日调整斯里拉查-环城特快道路（Sri Racha-Ring Road）收费前采取措施减轻公众负担。根据特许经营合同，过路费每5年调整一次，单次幅度为15至35泰铢。

title: Accused senators vow to fight charges
desc: Senators accused of irregularities in the 2024 Senate election have vowed to fight the charges after the Election Commission (EC) decided to refer cases against 77 people, including 26 serving senators, to the Supreme Court.
title_cn: 被控参议员矢言对抗指控 最高法院将开庭审理
summary_cn: 因2024年参议院选举违规被控的参议员表示将坚决对抗指控。泰国选举委员会已将涉及77人的案件移交最高法院，其中26人为现任参议员，参议院选举丑闻将进入司法程序阶段。
desc_original: Senators accused of irregularities in the 2024 Senate election have vowed to fight the charges after the Election Commission (EC) decided to refer cases against 77 people, including 26 serving senators, to the Supreme Court.

summary_cn: 泰国最高检察院（AILAO）继续推进第26批特别案件的调查工作，向公众详细报告了案件的最新进展，并涉及多位证人的作证陈述。此次公开报告体现了司法机构的透明度和依法办案的原则，有助于提升公众对司法程序的了解和信任。

title: Use of banned ‘red meat’ chemicals in cattle uncovered
desc: Thai authorities have arrested a chemical supplier after finding salbutamol, a beta agonist used illegally as a “red meat” enhancer, in nearly 1,000 cattle in an eight-month investigation spanning five provinces.

title: 泰国严管“减肥针”！今天起须凭医生处方购买
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 泰国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）宣布，自2026年9月15日起，GLP-1类注射药物正式列为“特殊管制药物”。民众购买包括利拉鲁肽、司美格鲁肽在内的GLP-1注射药物，必须持有医生处方，并由药剂师负责配发。 FDA秘书长苏帕特拉·汶森表示，GLP-1受体激动剂主要用于治疗2型糖尿病，部分药物也获准用于肥胖患者的体重管理。近期发现，有人在未经医生评估和指导的情况下将其用于减重，同时市场上还出现假药、来源不明药品及通过网络非法销售等问题。为此，泰国卫生部出台《特殊管制药物》第58号公告，加强对该类药物的监管。 新规实施后，药房销售GLP-1注射药物必须凭医生处方，由药剂师审核并交付。FDA还将通过Track & Trace药品追踪系统加强监管，逐步追踪药品从进口、储存、流通到最终交付患者的全过程，以防止药品流入非法渠道，并及时发现假药及未经注册药品。 FDA提醒，无处方销售特殊管制药物、无证售药或销售未经注册药品，均可能面临监禁及罚款；违法进行药品广告宣传，最高可罚10万泰铢。目前，FDA正在进一步制定药品销售和流通的具体标准。 FDA强调，新措施不会影响真正有医疗需求的患者正常用药。经医生诊断并在医生指导下使用GLP-1药物的患者，仍可正常获得药物，同时药品来源和流通渠道将更加透明，进一步提高用药安全。 民众购买GLP-1药物后，可通过泰国FDA官网的Track & Trace产品序列化追踪系统，输入药品包装上的Serial Number，查询该药品是否获得许可。若查询不到相关信息，或网站信息与药品包装不符，应立即停止使用，并拨打FDA热线1556或通过Oryor Smart Application举报。相关渠道全天候开放。 （编译：Wan；来源：泰国食品药品监督管理局） The post 泰国严管“减肥针”！今天起须凭医生处方购买 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

Bang Pa-in Police Station officers received a report at about 2pm yesterday, September 14, after the 43 year old Thai woman, Salinya, was found dead in her bedroom. Officers estimated that she had been dead for about three days. An initial examination found wounds apparently caused by a sharp object on her neck, face, cheek and left arm. Her neck also appeared to have been broken. Police found a blood-stained mobile phone and a pair of scissors near the body. Blood was found on the floor, while bloody footprints led towards a bedroom window. Photo via DailyNews Salinya’s mother, 63 year old Samlee, told police and media outlets that she lived in a separate house and became concerned after not seeing her daughter for three days.
